I have to constantly change the data to show "today" when checking my nutrients and macros because it defaults toweek.

author: Ari
text: my calorie total for the day is accurate if I'm on the individual day food log, but in week view it's saying 10,000 cal more on that day. this never used to be an issue, what is happening?? everytbing is up to date. I deleted and reinstalled, used a different account. also, despite being connected to my garmin, it stopped showing exercise related caloric intake needs. this app used to be spot on even just last year, kind of meh now. hope it gets sorted, I know I'm not the only one having issues

author: Shake
text: The latest update is buggy. It adds the meals properly, but shows 0 calories for most of the protein. I meal prep and most of my days are the same. It was a lot easier to copy the full day prior to the update. Now I have to do it meal by meal. Update: the app IS NOT counting the calories of the meals I had saved. it totally defeats the purpose of tracking.

author: Sheryl Drobny
text: I have had this APP for years. My subscription was coming due. Thankfully, my credit card company declined the charge. When I checked where it came from it was from MFP. It was $30 dollars more than the amount they had been notifying me of. Their subscription has skyrocketed over the years and they just hit my limit! Trying to slip it through my credit card on the next level of annual subscription is really what caused me to cancel. Beware.

author: Brian D
text: I've been a premium member for many years and love the app, but the only thing I dont like is that I can no longer edit the meal times. I used to plan and enter my meals into Myfitnesspal the day before so I know exactly what and how much to eat each meal to meet my macros, and then I would edit those meal times to "current" as I ate them. I cant do that anymore.

author: Anthony Paradiso
text: For a long time, the app worked well. I enjoyed logging my meals and trying to keep them under the calorie counts. then recently the app stopped working. Every time I open it, the app brings me to a loading screen that for a split second looks like it's letting me in and then back to the loading screen. can somebody help? Regarding your response, I can't open the app so I won't be able to contact you through it. thank you.

author: Ken
text: Loving the improvements I've seen over the years returning to this app. Now it's a daily habit. It's great for motivation. *UPDATE- 5 down to 3 stars. No longer as great. paywall and ads. Also used it for 10+ yrs and one thing that's always bothered me is that the weight progess graph isn't more user friendly. gimme a slider! *2ND UPDATE- 3 down to 2 stars. kept logging me out every 2 weeks, even when I would use it every three days or less.

author: Andrea Byrne
text: editing my previous 5 star review to 1 star. the new update and user interface is horrible and frustrating. you used to be able to see all of your meals for the day on one screen, and now you have to click into each meal to see it. copying meals used to be easy and now takes several pointless clicks. it's the same for erasing meals. you can no longer see the nutrition/macros page from your diary page. I'll be switching to a different meal tracking app unless mfp reverts course.

author: Patty Smith
text: I used this years ago before getting a fitbit & switching to their app. I loved it back then. Just re-downloaded due to Google rolling out their half finished Health app to replace fitbit. After seeing that the barcode scanner is no longer available in the free version, I have deleted this without logging a thing. It is all but useless without being able to scan. Both of these apps I used to use and love have eliminated so many features I might as well long with pen and paper.

author: Kris Kmak
text: I've been using this app since 2011. I currently have a 2,327 day streak. I can understand making some features paid, like barcode scanning, net carbs and other things. Have to make some money. However, this recent user interface update is awful. Has completely ruined the app imo. You got rid of the diary button, replacing it with what looks to be some Ai slop paid feature. You can no longer edit meals, allowing you to copy to another day, or even save certain things. Just completely awful.

author: DQ Ton
text: I love this app. if you are dedicated and willing to put in the work, this app will help you keep track of your calories. I like it. The only complaint that I have is if you add something to the food menu and you make a mistake, there's no way to correct that, at least no way that I've seen. For instance I added a meal to the menu and I forgot to put the calories in but had all the other information correct, however I didn't know how to go back and either delete that entry or correct it.

author: Casey Shackelford
text: I am a 10-plus year user of this app. As if it isn't bad enough that the bar code scanner is behind a paywall, and a lot of the green checked verified foods in the search menu are often incorrect when it comes to calories and macros, you roll out this terrible update. Please consider going back to the former UI, and please consider making the barcode scanner free or you need to deep dive into the search and clean up the incorrectly verified items. I may go to another app and start over.

author: Andrew Rivera
text: Lots of clutter, constant ads, and pushing to buy premium. Getting worse over time, more and more pop up stuff. I don't need you to pop up a screen congratulating me for using the app every day. update: moved to one star. somehow they made it even worse. navigating through your food diary is way clunkier, added more steps and doesn't show all the food unless you go to a separate screen. no easy way to flip between days and see your diary on previous days. slower and more button pushes needed.

author: Marc R
text: Long time user. I rarely complain about redesigns, but this new design update is horrendous. I just want to have some basic info on one screen: everything I ate that day, how many calories I've consumed, and how many I have remaining. Everything requires so many clicks now, it's so much harder to use for logging. I will likely switch to a competitor, even though I'm not happy to lose so much historical data.

author: Justin Lottes
text: before the latest update, the app was very useful. there were issues, but at least it was useful. post update... almost completely useless. very hard to find the chart with my weight. unable to easily see my calorie usage for the day. doesn't show me exercise calories. entering food is very cumbersome. will be using this app a whole lot less. considering removing.

author: Kevin Johnson
text: During the brief periods between glitches and malfunctions it is okay. However, there persists regular system glitches: saved foods and meals disappearing or getting multiplied 20+ times in the list. Currently deleting certain foods from saved meals list daily, not transferring calories for some foods, cannot enter new foods due to unit of measurement not working. These types of glitches are a regular part of using this app. The highest absurdity is that they expect you to pay for it.

author: Asraar
text: Long time user: This new update's UI makes nearly every aspect of the display and logging worse. You can't see all the logged items at once unless you click on the day specifically. Can't swipe to different days anymore. Annoyingly located pop-up under meals to copy meals from different days, which when accidentally clicked, has to be deleted individually. The summary dashboard is less easily digestible. I recommend finding an alternative food tracker at this point.

author: Keith Johnson
text: the most recent update for this app is terrible. there's now more things to click through to get where you want and the UI is just generally more difficult to view information. Viewing macros left for the day is also problematic, as when you go over macros there is almost no visual difference, so it's easy to miss. This app also doesn't keep previously logged foods in the history very long. I paid for premium but it's no longer a premium experience.

author: Shawn Stallings
text: If I could rate negative I would. Not a user friendly app. not useful as a free app, wouldn't allow a free trial, and if a product (such a pre made meal prep service) doesn't have a bar code you can spend 10 minutes searching for the meal to view every other meal in the database at least 4x. In less than a week this went from a potentially useful product for tracking macros to a constant headache and a great way to increase stress and encourge people to stop tracking

author: Virginia J
text: The latest update is absolutely horrible. This is not the MFP that's been so user friendly for a decade+. Can't even see my entire day diary in one place anymore. Everything takes a bunch of clicks and I can't just get a simple view of my day. Awful. Adding: I reached out to support Before writing this review and they weren't helpful. They basically gave a "change is hard" patronizing as hell response. I want my annual subscription that I paid last month refunded for this bait and switch!

author: Carol Chase
text: I've been using this app for over 2 years. I use it daily and it has motivated me to lose weight by being aware of and keeping track of how many calories I'm putting into my body and how many I'm burning each day. Update: 4/24/26 I've been using this app for 10 yrs. I wasn't happy when I could no longer use the bar code reader w/out a large fee but continued to use the app. This week the app changed. It is no longer user-friendly and I don't like the changes at all. Looking for a new app. Sad.

author: Hudith SC
text: 4/25/26 I can no longer use the app to track my foods, because after the latest update, it has a non-user friendly interface, and no longer displays the data necessary to plan my meals for the day. All I can think, is that people who don't use the app, and have never seen the prior app's layout created something out of fever dream, without consulting any of the paying users.

author: Alan Morgan
text: so until this month, the MFP layout hadn't really changed much in the eight years I've used it. and apparently the app designers had to justify their presence in the office. I'm not one to complain about every little change, but now it takes more clicks to add my weight, more clicks to track my meals, more clicks to delete things, and it's way easier to add repeat meals on accident. all that and it looks worse somehow. what were y'all even going for? literally fire whoever pitched this

author: Addy Torres
text: What happened to this app?? You can't do anything without paying for it. Adding a recipe manually, it changes everything you write. Then allows you to edit and still it's wrong. If you give up and want to just add the macros at least to have something, it only allows you to add calories, no carb, no protein, no anything. This used to be a good app now, NO WAY. UPDATE: Please if you intend to respond to reviews then at least respond with an actual response, not some stock reply with a link.

author: Tiffany Taylor
text: Well you guys finally did it. Ruined an app I've been using for well over a decade to the point I will have to find a replacement. I need the ability to make a customized start date for my tracking week, i.e. Friday - Thursday. This is non negotiable. It is how I manage weekend/weekday calorie averages for the week. Extremely disappointed I will now have to take time to shop around for apps that do what I need and I will lose a decade of logging data.

author: Danny
text: I've used this app for almost ten years, and I've slowly watched it deteriorate into garbage. I dealt with not being able to scan food anymore. I've also dealt with what seems to be an issue with steps/calories getting logged incorrectly from Samsung Health. But now with the new, terrible UI update, and with what appears to be a bug that's causing sync issues and has wiped my food logs, I don't think I can deal with it anymore. It's way too much of a hassle and not worth the headache.

author: Mississippi
text: The new layout update is perfectly designed to allow for overeating. I won't recommend it for anyone who has trouble with sticking to a calorie deficit. All details which were previously very clear and concise to help understand your patterns and food weaknesses, now are hidden away and no longer visible for clarity. I don't believe the app is catered towards identifying meaningful lifestyle changes that can help in losing weight and keeping it off.

author: Reyna Hernandez
text: This is still probably the best app for tracking because they have such a large amount of entries to choose from and it's free. However, I really used to like the way this app worked and looked, but now the user interface is so much worse. Harder to navigate and find where things are. Additionally, the default when you look at your nutrition breakdown is set to weekly and there's no way to permanently make it default to daily like it used to be. That's not a big deal but it is annoying.

author: Jane Hylton (Janie)
text: I am terribly disappointed with the most recent "upgrade" and I will not be renewing my paid subscription. I target calories, carbs and protein BY MEAL and was very satisfied with how the prior version displayed these. The new user interface strips away the immediate data and forces me to click around to get data I need, which previously was visible at first glance. Other changes also create more steps for user. It had bern ideal for years! Disappointed.

author: Hat T
text: Was a really good app, but they changed it just to change it and now nothing is intuitive. You can accidentally add all the logged foods from a previous day to a meal with one tap, which you then have to delete 1 by 1. Calories remaining is so small, you have to squint to read. you can't see everything in 1 day anymore, you have to tap individual meals and then go back to see calories logged. so clunky now.

author: Tasty Cheddar
text: Used this for a decade...New UI changes are AWFUL and will finally force me to leave for another app. I wouldn't use this for free in its current state. Can't view the entire day anymore, everything is hidden in sub menus. Nutrient info for the day is three menus deep instead of easily accessed. Can't swipe back to previous days either, have to go through the calendar to a specific day. I'm out.

author: Carole Koudsi
text: Every time MyFitnessPal does a so-called "upgrade" it's worse. I have an Android phone and now I can't access any of the Community pages. The new food diary interface is horrendous. Save yourself a LOT aggravation and find a different app. I'm letting my Premium membership expire. Once it does, I'm gone. On the plus, side their food database is huge.

author: Em
text: Woah. The app updated and it's actually awful now. not only does it look bad and is cluttered as heck but it ruined basic features. There was a popup saying it was to put the diary front and center, but it already was??? I could see all my logged foods easily and now I have to click in to each meal to see everything. There is a giant button for logging yesterdays food today where today's foods used to actually be and I keep accidentally hitting it. No usability testing clearly.

author: Tiffany Thomas
text: the app was helpful for a while but they keep going back and forth with new updates that are terribly user UNfriendly. If consistency is key to weight management, their inconsistency and inability to allow for consistent, easy tracking is not helpful at all. Although if you are the type of person who loves it when your grocery store suddenly rearranges everything for no reason, then this app might be for you!

author: Andrea Young
text: the new user interface was not designed with the user in mind. We want to see a comparison of our macros, our meals laid out, and our water intake at least. The new UI is oversimplified so you can't really get any data out of the main view without clicking into each category. The designers should remember the "why" of the app when doing the design.

author: Michelle S
text: I do NOT like the update. Would give zero if I could. I am a paid subscriber. I don't like the new layout. Don't like that I can't see the projected weight more than once after I click finish diary for the day. I don't like that when I go to see Protein, Carbs, Fat it defaults to weekly #s instead of that day. It's terrible. Put it back the way it was.

author: Kevin Heine
text: Excellent for those of us who are serious about losing weight, or just generally improving health (as of 02/16/2017). However, of late, I have noticed a significant issue with this app. It used to auto-sync my workout logs from MapMyWalk and MapMyFitness (including importing my step count from my walk logs); but no longer does so. Correct this immediately, please.

author: Paula Otteson
text: Have used this app since 2015 and it helped me lose weight (and keep it off) but the new update is horrible. I have to click twice as many times to get to the same screens as I did before the update. The "home" page does not show details of my diary at a glance like the old version did. My exercise from MapMyWalk does not transfer over like it used to and like it should. Please go back to the old version!

author: Brock Southwick
text: Not sure what's happened in the last few weeks, but the application won't open on my phone anymore. Stays frozen on the loading screen. I've uninstalled and reinstalled the application multiple times, restarted my phone, and checked for OS updates on my device with no progress. Would gladly rate it 5 stars if it worked for me again!

author: Lorie Truhe
text: The most recent update is horrible. I'm hoping they actually review the posts and revert back. It is no longer user friendly. You have to click so many more times to add food and then many times to go back to the main screen. It's much harder to see where you're at with your daily macros. I am planning to check if I can cancel my membership with money back and will be trying another app. It was worth paying for but I no longer feel that way.

author: Ray 3460
text: New UI is bad, not that the old UI was good, but the new one is genuinely terrible. I can no longer swipe between days, I need to scroll back to the top and tap the exact day I want or use a dropdown menu and pick a day from the calendar if I want to quickly see or edit what I ate yesterday or the day before that. The new UI also forces you to constantly need to scroll back to the top to see how many calories you have left, because of the new rounded look combined with the multiple ad spots. BOO

author: Jessica Moon
text: I have used this app for over 12 years, paid for premium for the past 6, and this new update has made me cancel within 1 day of usage. As a nutrition professional and scientist this has become inefficient and now lacks what once made it so great. A simple, easy to navigate diary, where one can access daily logs without seven button clicks. The passive aggressive, unnecessary commentary on macronutrient intake is inappropriate and will have negative implications for those new to tracking.

author: Angeline Catalano
text: I've been using this app off and on for years, it's always been reliable, until the new update. The update added so many extra steps, why when I got my nutrient and macro page does it automatically show weekly average? It makes no sense for me to have to change it to show just today, today should be default. The diary used to be very neat and easy but now there's so much extra scrolling involved. I will likely be switching to Lose It.

author: Kathy B
text: Haven't used it in a while and don't even recognize it now. It was so SIMPLE for the things I needed to do. Now it's visually VERY cluttered and the greed is on full display: a lot that was free is now "premium," and the upsell is more aggressive than a used car dealer!   What used to feel like it supported MY goals is much, MUCH more about supporting theirs. PRIVATE EQUITY RUINS EVERYTHING, and what a great and thorough example MyFitnessPal has become. Don't like it, wouldn't recommend it.

author: Carmela Schmitz
text: The new update is huge step backwards. Way too many clicks to do simple logging (even water), no daily overview without more clicks, exercise (calories out) is completely separate from calories in. Android users cannot view or post in Community Forums in app, just get a blank screen. Today I realized the food and exercise I logged yesterday just disappeared, like it never happened. 10 year MFP user here.

author: Paige Twidell
text: Randomly updated out of the blue to where it was so confusing/impossible to use. Majority of the time I would add recipes and meals and it would track as 0 calories. So I refreshed the app thinking something was wrong and was rn I reopened the app, it had deleted all of my food and meals I had planned for the last two years straight. 2 years and 100lbs of data lost because they are trying to squeeze a few bucks out of my wallet to get premium, with this update. Disgusting.

author: Rian Grotberg
text: Used the app for a long time now (10 years or so off and on). Works well for tracking a lot of basics in the free version. However as time has passed more pay walls are added for features that used to be free, pop ups appear almost every time you open the app, and this most recent update made the visual navigation in my opinion far less user-friendly which is what's finally pushed me to write a review. This used to be a five star app, 3 because it still functions for basics or it'd be lower.

author: Katie Hayes
text: The most recent update has been very frustrating. 1)Can't see total calories by meal, 2)can no longer conveniently see the entire formula that computes remaining calories, 3)On the calories chart there is no option for 7 rolling days, 4)cannot delete more than one item at a time, 5)on the Today tab, it is visually difficult to see at a glance which meals I've logged as each meal has the option to copy prior meals.I've been on this app for over 5 years and it keeps getting worse with each update.

author: Jacquelyn Wenneker
text: This works okay, but ever since they moved the food scan option behind the "premium" paywall the service seems to be less consistent or user-friendly And why this new design?? It's more complicated to navigate, harder to select only certain foods or food groups to copy or share and there is no clear breakdown at the top of the calorie goal, how much has been used, how much earned through activity and what remains for the day. Or it's not as readily visible.

author: Cait O
text: I dont understand what happened? was there an update? because I had been logging food just fine for years and now it can't find a single food I type in.. kind of rendering the app useless. guess I'll be looking for another app to use to track. update: the issue has been fixed. changed my rating but still not 5 star. when I first started using this app I was able to scan barcodes. it sucks to watch greed takeover and see apps make what used to be free features something you now pay for.

author: Jeff Hoenig
text: Last update sucked. The new format makes everything more confusing. It's gotten harder to go back and log things you've forgotten without getting the days mixed up. It's too easy to inadvertently log yesterday's meals on today's log. The counter for your calorie allotment was much easier to read at a glance. Seems like a huge format change that improved nothing.

author: Wanda Daniels
text: I don't like the new updated version of My Fitness Pal. If you close the app and open it again, it goes to whatever day you were last looking at. So you can accidentally log food on the wrong day. When you open the today tab, you see your calories on top and have to scroll to the bottom to see exercise. There's no way to take a screenshot that includes both at the same time. The old version was easier to use.

author: Paul Sharp
text: The new update looks great, however a few things that could be better 1. I had each meal setup with a specific amount of calories. You can no longer see how many calories per meal are available until after you start logging your meal. 2. There should be a quick add for any recent meals, not only the same meal from the previous day 3. There should also be a multi-select delete option for meals. When you accidentally copy a meal from the previous day, need to delete each item individually.

author: Sean Lantto
text: the new layout is not as helpful and intuitive as it was intended, the version prior to this one has everything for the day easily visible , had to do fewer clicks. best case add an option to choose layout, worst case; make it so all the foods are visible in the diary without clicking on a particular meal, I'd rather scroll down the list then click into something, next add the orange bar and the counter to calories remaining to show calories burned instead of just ticking the calorie limit

author: Isaac Smith
text: Genuinely crashes more than any other app I have ever used. This is a silly, poorly designed calorie counter... Why exactly does this crash more than any game I've ever tried? If I got a dolla for every time it failed, crashed, shut down, or did some other stupid glitch, I'd have anough money for a liftime membership... Just bad, try something else. Forget the UI change! Fix the app first! still crashes all the time!

author: Josh Highnam
text: I've been using this app since 2010. The macros aren't even correct lol. Yet another company that probably has record profits and qualitative decline to the point of their product being unusable. Like I'm at sub 100g carbs today, and it keeps showing me over my allotment. Does using this app add calories now? The UI, like so many products, is downright unfriendly and nonsensical. Way to go, yall played yourselves. Goodbye and good riddance.

author: Jhanae Coker
text: I signed up for the free 7-day trial for the premium plan. Even scheduled a text reminder for 6 days later to remind me to access if I liked the features enough to commit or cancel. Well, I was shocked to see next day I had been charged. I submitted request through Play store for a refund and they denied me. I'm going back to using Lose It app and disputing this charge with my bank to get my money back smh. Not a good experience and I don't recommend based off the customer service I received.

author: Arya Nuada
text: The new UI update is AWFUL. It is not intuitive to be able to log food and exercise. It visually is also a lot more difficult to view the stats for the day. And to see everything you used to is more clicks, which makes it extremely unfriendly for neurodivergent users. You can't swipe between days. Just awful. I wish there was a way to uninstall the update. Otherwise, I'm looking for another tracking app which isn't so allergic to accessibility. The old UI was perfect.

author: Linda
text: The new update to MyFitnessPal is not as user-friendly as the previous version. The one thing I like....the the food diary screen is the default. The log vs. +symbol... to make an entry is confusing. I know there is a learning curve, but the older version only needed a few tweaks, not an overhaul.

author: casey murphy
text: This app has helped me easily keep track of my calorie carb intake. it's helpful to keep track 👣 of everything I'm eating along with a log of my daily exercises. helepd me lose 30 lbs 3 times in a decade. My problem is getting off track. gaining lots of weight then working hard to lose it again. that is all within my fault. the losing weight can definitely be credited to this app through the years. easy to use. tried and true.

author: Kayley Weston
text: Been using MFP for 15 years. The UI update is awful. There are so many extra steps to log water and see my nutrition breakdowns. When I click nutrients, it defaults to week view instead of day now. It's clunky, all the text is too large, and everything is hard to see and look at. I am seriously considering switching to a different macro tracking app, which is sad since I have 15 years of data.

author: Nicole Champine
text: I have been a dedicated user of the premium version for 8 years. While I wanted to love the recent updates to the interface because it looks fresh - the functionality has suffered. It's difficult/impossible to see an entire day at a glance. Copying meals from day to day isn't seamless and I always end up with things entered on, or copied to, the wrong day. The app feels cumbersome with extra steps needed to log food and meals.

author: Jennifer Reed
text: Do not like the new format. Trying to find some of the older features are gone or no longer offered with the basic subscription. Yes the food logging is right there to remind you but being able to adjust the home page was nice as users could decide what is important to them. If it's not broke, don't fix it to something worse.

author: Brad Reese
text: Did an actual human being test the latest redesign of this app? Nothing was actually added, things were just moved around to make basic functions now require extra clicks. Having to use a calendar to copy a previous meal to "today" is wild. Making the Nutrients tab default to weekly instead of daily is also unhinged. I finished adding items to my daily log, why would I be more likely to want to see a weekly nutrition average rather than TODAY'S nutrient total? Can't imagine paying for this app.

author: S Hall
text: EDIT: App not syncing my Exercise data. It's been working fine, now it's not. EDIT: I log my food every day, yet I get notifications each day that I haven't registered my meals. What gives? Plus, I set my macro percentages but the app fails to adjust to my settings. The daily calorie goal set by the app is way above maintenance for days where I'm less active. Sadly, there's no way to vary this number to coincide with my training schedule.

author: Aris Holic
text: I've had this app for 3 years and have been a premium member. it was great. Today they changed the layout and it is clunky and borderline unusable. I suggest you try another app unless you wanna take 30 minutes to log a meal and fight to see what you've logged for a meal. what a shame. Update: I raised this from a 1 to a 3 star because while the app is now a headache to use, it still provides the good information it always has if you are willing to dig for it.

author: Bill Abercrombie
text: I originally gave 5 stars in 2018 but have to drop it to 1 star. This year it stopped syncing to the web so friends couldn't see my diary anymore. Then the new UI came out which made it less user friendly. Then it stopped updating with Garmin. Then recipes stopped saving. Today I noticed entire weeks of my logs from earlier this year have just disappeared. The company has turned a nice product into one that isn't even usable. I recommend looking into the many other options out there.

author: Britt D
text: I was annoyed with MFP because I feel like their barcode scan feature got worse after they started charging for it, but the newest update is garbage. I miss having a separate diary, it's harder to navigate between days and individual food items logged are now in giant bubbles of their own that take up way too much space and means you have to scroll instead of seeing it all at once. Also hate that you have to click around to find some features that used to be separately labeled in the diary.

author: Nolan Chamberlain
text: I've been using this app for almost 2 years. It is extremely laggy, it has also logged me out countless times while I'm tracking my food, and it will add a food to my meal multiple times instead of the one time I clicked on it. It's a very difficult app to use at times, and the recent update made it much more confusing to navigate.

author: Jon Snurka
text: How do you have a known bug, one that was created by an upgrade, for over a month? Been using MFP since 2011. always has been good but the issue of not synching with the website is a big deal. Logging on the phone is simple but I also need to log on the website because I'm sharing with others. I end up having to manually log a few days there at a time. Not convenient and it doesn't help that logging on the website doesn't overwrite what was entered in the app but duplicates it.

author: Theresa Maricevic
text: Terrible update! I used this app for over 10 years and loved it. In a matter of 3 days I deleted it and will never use again. This update is not user friendly at all, logs me out for no reason, password doesn't save, won't let me scan anything, won't give me appx weight goals. It's like you don't want anyone to use the free app. Bye.

author: renee stegmueller
text: I'm editing my review. I've been using this app for about 2 weeks and I've been impressed with how much they have in their food data base. It be great if they had different options for premium . As of now it's 19.99 monthly or 79.99 yearly. both seem a little steep for a trial run . 29.99 for 3 months would be nice doable median . even if it was only allowed once. More people could try it and perhaps get more future user's. because as of now ,20 bucks is just too much money to try something

author: Ben Zeigler
text: This app used to be quite useful to track caloric intake, exercise, weight, etc. now it doesn't load beyond the startup splash screen unless I clear the app's storage, and even then I'm unable to add food to the dairy. this issue has been ongoing for a while now, and attempts to get help from support have been useless.

author: Marissa
text: I love this app. I've been using it for years with 125lbs lost. I've never had a problem until the past few months. food logs disappearing, doubling logs, inaccurate weekly calorie numbers. it's been BUGGING. I'd love the old MFP back :( I can't go through every week and readd things or remove things.

author: Lore Pagan
text: I've used Myfitness Pal for years. It was always so easy to use. This latest update is horrible. It feels like using a complete new app. You can't see your whole day of meals without clicking on each individual meal. I'm seriously considering switching entirely to a different app. I understand the need to update, but why not keep some of the same features that users like and are used to.

author: Michael Thompson
text: They have done it again! This latest update has made the app more useless. You now have to go through a maze to see your full day, and you don't even see calorie totals by meal anymore. A key part of managing your health (what this app USED to be about) is consistency; making wholesale changes that disrupt how people do that is absurd. The app has taken another step towards garbage. After nearly 10 years, I will be looking for a less confusing app to track my calories.

author: Jakob Orkin
text: Update May 2026: 👎 New forced user experience is lackluster and requires more effort both to log your food and to see what you've logged. Not being able to see the foods in each meal without clicking into each one adds time to a process most people want to streamline as much as possible. Spacing between rows has ballooned. It's too easy to accidentally click the "log previous" button and then have to correct it by deleting the rows of food one by one. I'm now looking for alternative.

author: Y B
text: Love this app been using it at least five years, lost fifty lbs charting and documenting my food and exercise, peer online support also. They've made changes to the site over time, but it still works for me and it's the free version. What's wrong with the app, latest update and I can't comment on community post not even opening. I can post my food after figuring it out. I'm not new to MyFitnessPal, this latest update sucks and I won't be using it if not fixed

author: Ibrahim Semih Dogan
text: Scanning barcodes, using AI, etc. are on one side, what's the point if I can't even enter a meal's macros manually (not just calories, but the rest)? The free version is useful only if someone else has already added your meal to their database. I like the app, but I deleted it after seeing this greediness.

author: Ang H
text: I don't like the new format. I specifically like to see the whole day all on one screen, the way it was before. I don't like that you have to click on each meal section. It's just too many extra steps. Just a personal preference but the font was better before as well. Also, the little emojis on the side are unnecessary and distracting. Simple is better.

author: Michael Johnson
text: New dashboard/diary layout negatively impacted the way I interact with the App. Personally, I found it to be a detriment to how I use MyFitnessPal, and the lack of an option to stick with the previous layout is disappointing. Older versions were more succinct and fit my routine. This change will influence my decision to renew my membership, as I personally don't find value in the new layout or user experience (though others may disagree).

author: Darque Dreamer
text: This latest update may just be the nail in the coffin for this app. Myfitnesspal, you need to backtrack this one if you want to keep users. This new interface is AWFUL and not user friendly. I can't easily move around to look at different dates. I can't multi delete food items. I have to individually click on each meal to see every item listed under it. This is bs. Worst user interface ever.

author: Aaron Kramer
text: I got the paid version years ago, and I muddled through the constant decline after the Under Armor acquisition. I dealt with the crashing, the slow query speed and the random duplication (sometimes triplication) of my entries. This latest UI change is the last straw for me. I'm getting MacroFactor once my sub is up and I suggest anyone looking for nutrition tracking do the same, or at least some other app. MFP is trash. When looking at the reviews, filter by "Latest Version".

author: Jeff Schoenberger
text: Really liked the app but the recent update was a step backwards for UX. I can no longer see all of my food in my diary without clicking on each meal separately, making it hard to verify if I've actually tracked everything I meant to for the day. On my diary, I wish my total calories for the day stayed visible at the top even as I scrolled down through the meals.

author: Jacob Lovdahl
text: I have used this app for years and loved it. New UI update this year is terrible. It is easy to accidentally log a copy of yesterday's meal instead of a new item. When this happens and you need to delete, you only have the option to delete one option at a time. It is now super clunky and I'm surprised this update was actually pushed through.

author: Dan Does Game
text: The new update is horrible. Garmin fitness watch app no longer links to it, adding calories burned for exercise never stays, the extra steps for adding food just made the app worse & viewing daily macros automatically goes too weakly, so you have to manually swap to see how much you consumed on a single day..... i have been using this application for years. It didn't need to be updated

author: Kelly L
text: This app used had the best interface for busy people and meal prep. The previous version let me see total daily calories and all meals (with all food items) on one screen without excessive clicking. The 2026 update is a major downgrade. It requires far more clicks and removes important functions: I can no longer select and copy individual food items (only entire meals), and I can’t delete multiple selected items—now I must delete them one by one. This makes copying and editing meals inefficient.

author: A.
text: Today's update created more clicks to log and track food daily, views are convoluted and it's hard to see what day you're on when navigating. App still does not log water correctly since it does not allow you to adjust amount and has a low goal that causes dehydration, and still does not connect to apps that it says it will like mapmywalk, etc. If it claims it's connected, the apps do not sync.

author: Philip Montesinos
text: With the latest update, there's too many clicks. I want to see everything I ate for the day on one screen, like before. Also, we lost the ability to navigate to today's Nutrients. There's way more clicks now and it defaults to the week's Nutrients, not today's Nutrients. Please bring this ability back.

author: Caitlin Quinn-Kimball
text: I've been using mfp for years to track calories and used to enjoy the simple layout and ease of use. The new UI has completely ruined my experience. Everything takes 1-3 more clicks than it used to which makes tracking take longer and it is less intuitive. It has seriously made it so that I would rather move to a different app if I don't see an improvement in UI within the immediate future.

author: Tori Gersonde
text: The new interface is awful. It's seriously so bad that I've told my partner to turn off auto updates so he can avoid it. I've been using this app forever, but I'm searching around for an alternative. I don't know whose idea this change was, but maybe get some beta user feedback next time you do something so drastic and terrible? I'll definitely be canceling my subscription if it doesn't change.

author: A Google user
text: This application is inaccurate and lately has been offline more often than not. Quick update to the review, this application used to be at least reasonably convenient. However, with the latest update (April 2026) it has become more inconvenient and, more importantly, WILDLY INACCURATE. I would be extremely careful about trusting any data from this application for any purposes. The rating remains one star only because the system doesn't let me go any lower.

author: Mike Misuraca
text: So far so good. I've only been using it for a couple days for calorie counting, but it works great for that. Look up the food/brand in the daily log and enter the amount of calories in the particular product. What I also like is how if I'm in a hurry or sometimes it doesn't have the particular foods I'm trying to log in the app I can do a "quick log" and just enter the calories I've just eaten. Definitely, worth downloading if you're looking for an app to track calories.

author: Alex A
text: This "new" update is absolutely HORRIBLE! I've been a MFP for over a decade. it keeps getting more and more expensive, the food data is wildly spill over the board, more and more options, like taking fiber are now behind Premium, which was free. MFP, you've lost me as a customer. not that you care. I'll be going to LoseIt!

author: Dustin Stapp
text: The ui suffers from too many ads and poor placement of those ads. It'll interrupt you mid entry to tell you about the ad, and you'll have to restart. Also, during entry, the cursor will just randomly flash back to the beginning causing you to type things like "enchick". Oddly, I use this both on an iPhone and an android and the ui is different. Everything is moved around and inconsistent. 5/5 app and usefulness, 1/5 UI.

author: Tom B
text: With the latest update It's not as easy as it was to keep track of what you've selected . I've used this app for awhile and when it works it's great. They keep updating it and many of these cause more issues. The latest update does not correctly total calories. constantly not correctly adding calories to the total often just adding zero when the app correctly displays the calories for the food. After all that's the only reason I use the app is to keep track of calories.

author: Ray Oliver
text: This was a great app until they changed the format with a new menu for daily tracking. Now it takes multiple swipes to enter a meal and you cannot see what was eaten in previous meals from days ago. The harder it is to use or the longer it takes to enter a meal. The easier it is to not use! Go find an app that is easier to use!

author: Adam Schmidt
text: I really was satisfied with this app for nearly a year, helped me get on and stay on my path to have lost 20% of my body weight during that time. unfortunately about 3 days ago when I tried to open it just kept spinning and would never open. I updated the app twice, paused it and restarted my device then unpaused it(worked in other malfunctioning apps before) and nothing. I'm tired of hoping this gets fixed so deleting and switching to a different app.

author: Antonio & Marisa
text: This app used to be great, but the new interface is horrible. Great job in making everything less efficient. Did anyone even try this out, or get user feedback before launching this flaming bag of poop update? Everything takes far more clicks to get to...zooming in on the day's details defaults to week view which has to be changed every time, seeing your full day needs a click to expand, the long press on a food now doesn't allow you to move it, etc. Bring back the old UI, or give the option

author: Jeroen Witte
text: 2025 update: support doesn't respond. App is now deleting logged food at random. it's ridiculous that issues like this exist. Old review: My created meals keep getting deleted randomly. Often during or right after creating them. The whole app itself is full of clutter, i just want to track food. The scanner is pretty good. Edit 2026: deleting whole saved meals now. updating app deletes all logged food.

author: Alissa DiNarda
text: this latest update has ruined this app. there are more glitches and issues now than before. If I try and go back to see what my macros are it gives me some random set of numbers. I have to close out the app and reopen every single time. not to mention that toggling back and forth between the screens is super annoying. I'll start typing in a food and the cursor jumps back to the first letter. When pressing the add button it takes 10-15 seconds to update. that's just what I can remember at the mom

author: Ricky Bobby
text: Overall a decent app, but there are a few annoying bugs. The main issue is that when I delete a food from my diary, sometimes it'll magically reappear a while later. When I add a food to my diary, sometimes it'll randomly add the food twice. The "add a recipe" tool is also broken. It won't let me manually input ingredients. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app, but that didn't help. Other than these issues, the app is a decent way to track your eating.

author: T RF
text: Full disclosure, this app has a significant glitch with respect to Android OS, whereby it does not sync with their web portal/cloud. This means that if you lost the data on your phone, or purchased a new phone, you would be SOL as none of your data would be able to sync because it does not exist anywhere else other than your phone! For me this is a big deal, but the developer is aware of it and is taking steps to remedy it. Other than this, I give this app a 4/5 (free version:)

author: YOSHI Corcoran
text: Great for tracking food, but the past few weeks hasn't synced between the app and the website, which means it doesnt update with any other apps synced. Tech teams advice: just update on the website. I dont have the time to sit down and double log all my meals, why not just fix a repeatedly raised issue?? Plus it constantly pushes for me to get premium despite all the issues.

author: Avinash N
text: Absolutely horrendous app on Android. I can never use my previously logged food when logging something new in my diary unless I manually change a setting every time I log. as suggested on the website, I reinstalled the app to see if it fixes the issue, but it erased almost all my history. weird thing is that it didn't lose everything - just a few bits and pieces from every meal, which is even more odd. There is no easy way to contact support either and super disappointed with the user experience

author: Jill Whitelaw
text: Love my fitness pal! Been using it for years but unfortunately I cannot recommend this without the ability to barcode scan! Ridiculous this is part of the premium package that you have to pay for now! For someone like me who has ADHD, the ability to scan barcodes and add food quickly has been a huge plus. I don't have time to search and log food now. Gutted to be saying bye to this app! Hope this is revised in the future

author: Natalie Ball
text: Used this app for years to track my weight and food intake, I came back to it again recently to start being more serious about tracking my food again and they have taken away the scan bar code on the free version and the yearly subscription is a rip off just so I can scan bar codes. I'm going over to the Crono app instead as they have scan and are much cheaper. Sad that these apps are just turning into money grabbers all of a sudden when we are in a cost of living crisis.

author: Karen Langley
text: No barcode scanner anymore as it wants you to pay for it. Doesn't have netball as an exercise, which is bizarre as it is a massive sport so that is inaccurate. Doesn't sync with any app whatsoever, again defeating the point. Will keep using it for a bit but tbh it's regressed since becoming popular and as an app will probably cease to exist in a couple of years.

author: Sue
text: Finally, I upgraded to Pro. 😆 I'm convinced with the help of this app that I will be back in shape by the end of this year. Lost 10 lbs thanks to tracking and adjusting. I wanted to try out the Intermitting fasting because of the many benefits. Picked the 16/8 time slot. Somehow, the eating hours are set to 4 hours, and I think this is an error, 🤔 as I can't set the eating window to 8 hrs. I'm not doing the 20/4 version 😅. That would be too hard for me. Please fix this ASAP. 😉 Thanksies 😊

author: B McGregor
text: Truly this used to be a great app. Now upon reinstalling it I've come to find they've removed the barcode scanner for free users and you now have to pay. I refuse to pay for an app that does not work and the glitches this app has does not make me want to pay for it. The Fitbit steps sync up great for a few days and then they don't work anymore and no amount of uninstalling or reinstalling will change it. Customer service is so hard to get a hold off. Not worth my money and perhaps not my time

author: Gail Cruickshank
text: Generally an excellent app I've been using this app for nearly 10yrs and I've never really had any major issues. As with other reviews I agree that when searching for a product there can be too many choices with very varied nutritional info which can take time to find the one that matches the info on the tin, you might say. Biggest bug I have found is that the progress has changed and instead of my most recent weight being at the top the oldest one is displayed first. Hopefully this get fixed

author: Tishelle Tobias
text: MFP really helps with mindful eating. At the start, it takes some time to get used to tracking your intake, but the habit builds healthy intuitive eating. Love it and highly recommend! I also got the premium version, and the barcode scanner is such a game changer. Suggestion to Devs: Create the option to customize the nutrition the user wants to track. E.g. tracking magnesium/vitamin B etc.

author: Chivas Baliguas
text: I love the app, it helps me track my daily calories and helps me achieve my goals, however it seems to have an issue with the exercise tab. It wount let me build or create a routine, and the previously saved routines can no longer be accessed. The app freezes. Is this a bug with one ui 7? Will change the rating once it is fixed. Thanks

author: Kip
text: Seems solid, haven't used it much yet. The first thing that happened was that I changed my intake units for fluids to millilitres but on the watch it's still set to cups. Creating meals with specific items in it feels unintuitive, at least trying it out for 10 minutes without a tutorial... But hey, at least half of the app is ads

author: Benjamin S
text: This is a great app as a free option to log and track calorie intake. It does feel like that is where it stops though. The app has potential with recipe listings, tips for weight loss, and meeting goals; however, there is no way to get a great experience with personalization unless you buy the premium version - which is way too costly for me personally. It is laid out nicely and very easy to search, log, and track your food. The app itself isn't overly busy or clunky.

author: Dan Semal
text: Missing basic features It's a great idea to offer a database full of foods but when there is no option to correct nutritional values, it undermines the entire system. No one expects every food to be correct, that would be a neverending task, so where is the functionality to easily edit the data? e.g. fresh orange juice allegedly has 0% vitamin...

author: Nicholas Le
text: The log in problem has been fixed. I like the app and how it can track stuff even if you're not using the premium version. The only actual critique I can give is if only there was a way to implement measurements in grams for ALL food types. I like the different measurement options but I feel like to be precise and have some sort of credibility, there should always be an option to use grams (or ounces) as a measurement.

author: HENRY SLAMAKER
text: very glitchy app. I have trouble signing in. the dashboard is blank if I go to diary and then want to return to dashboard. It won't let me connect my fitbit app as it says an account is already connected when it isn't. I went on fitbit and disconnected every app connection it had. still won't allow me to connect. I won't even entertain paying for it while it is this glitchy.

author: Vicky Lawley
text: Yesterday I could see all my logged food without having to expand each meal & easily see how I was doing against my goals for my chosen macros. Today that has vanished; all I see is how many grams total and the percentage split of my macros, without doing the maths manually (which kinda defeats the object) I can't now see how many more grams of protein (for example) I need to hit my goals. Looks like a downgrade rather than a useful update, I'm on a free premium+ trial and now unlikely to pay

author: Josiane Van Dorpe
text: Nice app to track calories. Lots of food in their database with complete information. However I have the premium version and some things are just lacking or not working well. Ex: We need a list of favorite foods. There are recent and frequent lists, but I have items that I know I use quite a bit and are in neither. I need a list of favorites i can search in. Also my steps dont sync well with Health Connect despite many refreshes everywhere, and I can't input steps for previous days manually...

author: Emilia Peters
text: Been really helpful to track my diet. However recently it doesn't seem to sync with Google fit very well. It's never been amazing, you need to make sure you visit Google fit app and MFP at the end of the day for it to sync properly but it was fine, now it doesn't seem to sync at all at the moment which is a shame

author: Nancy Bernier
text: I've been using MFP on and off for over 8 years now. It's very easy to use, I love being able to see all nutrition (especially now that I have high cholesterol). I don't usually use the recipe finder feature but I appreciate it's available! 4 stars because I miss that you can't scan barcodes for free anymore.

author: J
text: Large database of items, but incredibly buggy. The update dialog is constantly bugging out, you can't close it and it covers everything. Closing and reopening the app doesn't solve it either. Random errors whenever you try to do things like update your goal as well.

author: A Google user
text: Health Connect keeps duplicating or triplicating my workouts. I have Garmin connected to MFP and they keep bouncing workouts back and forth until it looks like I've burned thousands of calories that I haven't. I can't turn it off without disconnecting Garmin which I prefer to track my workouts. Fix it, please! Google Pixel 6

author: İdris Tuğrul Gülenç
text: I would definitely not pick this app to track my calories if I could go day 1. It just logs me out with no apparent reason. When you just want to log some food, you have to remember the password, and most probably recover it. Genius! Adding a recipe is time consuming and at the end I got 'Try later' message multiple times. After spending that time! I am looking for a more useful alternative now!

author: Pedro Werneck
text: Changed my review from 5* to 1*. If I could put 0*, I would. I've been using this app for 15+ years to religiously track my calories. lost 11 kg using it. Being adding my log of foods all this time. The UI was perfect and easy to use. This new update made it horrible. Awful to navigate and to use. You can't see all your information on the diary tab and have to open sections inside sections just to see basic information. Change to the previously UI or you will lose a bunch of customers.

author: Viktoria Wollweber
text: I loved the app before the update came out. Now the user interface is horrible, not user friendly at all. You need to click through a lot of submenus, you can't permanently change the weekly overview back to a daily overview, the water tracking feature is pretty hidden, you can't swipe through the days anymore. And worst of all, you can't see the individual items of your logged meals now, no overview of your day and so much clicking. Thinking about using a different app unless there's a change.

author: Marcos Aldarondo
text: I hate the new way the front page looks, it's really hard to figure out the days I'm on now, I can't scroll left or right to go to other days, and the way the food you add looks is just annoying, if I enter all I see is "and one more" instead of showing me the that is with the other one. I have been using this app for years with no complaints, so sad I had to make this one.

author: Knowellyn
text: The calories left/over NEEDS to be bigger, bolder and clearer. The diary needs to be all on one page, smaller, easy to see at a glance and meals showing on that page how many cals. Instead we have to clock on absolutely everything to get that information and it takes 5x as long as before. I hate this updated version of yours. Bring back the old one.

author: Pinteresting Stories
text: Great app, just wish you could track steps from any step tracker. I use step counter - pedometer which I find better since it's free and runs in the background. Would also be good if you could search for recipes with specific nutrients (I'm anaemic) or by calories but other than that it's a really great app! No complaints, the food tracker and graphs to showcase what you've done are great for visualising, the exercise logging is brilliant, and finding the food/meals is really easy, I love it!

author: Roman Bischof-Vegh
text: I have been a paid subscriber for many years and until a day ago, this was a very useful app for tracking my meals. With the new design, it has become much harder to switch between days and get a quick overview of all food items logged. There are more clicks needed and all the elements on the pages now look the same, making it harder to find ingormation. I wish there was a way of switching to the old layout. As it is, I'm not sure I might have to check out alternatives.

author: Daph Daf
text: finally I want to delete it ,looking for an alternative one because since few weeks is working too badly, goals with no sense changes, I get more weight and they allow me to eat more, etc... BAD ok It was just to let you know about this issue, at the end I have found an alternative way to be able to put the exercises. the app is still fine.

author: AlinonMo
text: Yesterday it would have been a 4 star. After today's update 3. Used to see a nice summary of calories at top of page. Goal, less consumed, plus burned = deficit/surplus. Now you see calories used vs total calories available. Calories burned is sent to the bottom of page. Note, I only use calorie tracking, rest of app is irrelevant for me. Why does it always feel like developers in general just make changes just for the sake of change or to look busy rather than to actually make things better?

author: Emma
text: Unfortunately had to change my review from 5 stars to 1. Have been a premium user for almost 3 years now and it has helped me lose 28kg but this new UI is beyond frustrating. It is very unintuitive, everything is hidden behind submenus and you can't see in one go anymore what you've logged for the day. I will be looking for an alternative. Feel free to reach out to me once substantial changes have been made.

author: Nicholas Lim
text: Edit: The new update on Aug 2026 eas completely unnecessary and unhelpful, the previous version was much easier to operate and navigate! It also automatically averages out your weekly calories instead of showing what was consumed in the day, which is what it's supposed to do as a calorie tracker! Developers, just take the feedback here and tell the team directly! You are wasting user's time by making them log in yet again to make their feedback heard!

author: Shawna Hack
text: I've been using this app for as long as I can remember. It used to be so good and simple. But over the last couple years, it has been regularly logging me out, denying food item entries, forcing me to input my own made up food because the food database isnt accessible anymore. Has it turned into a paid service? Either way, it makes me sad not to use this once great app. It just isnt reliable anymore. :(

author: Negin K
text: Your product team must be deaf. this is the longest paid app I have ever had. I've used it for almost a decade. But it seems that the user experience is the last priority on the new update. I have to click through so many items, can't see the logged foods impact on my daily total, unless I come out, I can't see nutrients as easily and it's just genuinely awful. I'm sadly going to uninstall and add a new app for this. so disappointed

author: Caroline “C000H000” Hennessy
text: Recent changes to the layout are not good. You can't swipe from day to day like before which was great for easy access.The ability to copy individual foods from one meal as opposed to all foods from a meal and adding it to the next day is a feature I used every day, now that is also gone. I have made the mistake of pressing the present day meal by mistake and copying yesterday's over when I didn't want to do so... so many other new features that are not access friendly. Do not like it.

author: Scott M
text: I find this app works amazing when you manually enter your own food and save meals or recipes. Lots of weird user interface designs that can make it confusing. You have to adapt to how the app does things, which is not intuitive. Can be frustrating and inaccurate finding a matching food. I feel like they need to do a serious database clearout and delete old inaccurate entries.

author: Mary Merrington
text: Great aid in monitoring weight loss as well as for affirmations. Also a great tool for learning about the caloric values of various foods but it would be better if one did not have to pay for the addition of info on one's nutritional valued intake. Also, there is no way of deleting entries put in by error like previous versions of app.

author: Stefano Guerriero (Gintokyo)
text: I have been using the app for nearly a decade. In the last couple of years became very clunky, started deleting food I have logged for the day randomly, at times. Now, with the new UI it got veeeery bad. hard to understand what is going on and I already mistakenly pressed "copy previous meal" multiple times. At least, before this update it was easy to read.

author: Jarrad Finlayson
text: So the food log is quite good, but the Exercise log completely and utterly sucks. If the food log auto tracks my calories and macros, then I should be able to also easily input and specifically modify the workouts I log with an output of rough calorie burn based on my weight, intensity, type of exercise etc. But no, for strength I only get to input sets reps and weight, and this doesn't allow for me to include warmup sets or variations in the 1 logged exercise, which is dumb.

author: Sergi Insomnia
text: After more than 10 years using MyFitnessPal, this update is absolutely disgraceful. You DESTROYED the Diary interface. Swiping between days is gone, the full food diary is gone, and now I must open the calendar and expand every single meal just to see what I ate. This is not an improvement. It is a horrible, infuriating downgrade. I work with software and, in 40+ years, I have rarely seen such a disastrous UI decision. You are forcing longtime users like me to look for alternatives.

author: Tuan Anh Nguyen
text: It was great while it lasted. What MFP needs to do is optimize the primary user flow for efficiency, minimizing clicks and cognitive load. There is too much interaction with the app UI for a high frequency task such as logging calories. Most just need calories and macros logged FOR THE DAY. no clicking through the choice between breakfast or lunch. useful change would have been to go into the search bar instantly. instead they update the app around features nobody needs.

author: Stan Cates
text: I came back to this app after several years of not using it and everything sucks now. Conflicting information, settings/goal randomly reset, exercise calories count against available calories instead of toward it. It says macros are only available on premium in one of the seemingly endless layers but show up in another. Features that used to be included are now only premium. The search options are a nightmare for basic foods; an apple is an apple for crying out loud.

author: Robert Molini
text: From 4 down to 2 stars, because the latest update removed an essential feature: Users can't select and bulk transfer combinations of foods of a diary day anymore, e.g. to copy over to another or the same day (e.g. you eat the same sandwich again). Now, only all foods recorded for a meal name (e.g. "Breakfast") can be copied as whole... and if that happens by mistake, you have to delete every SINGLE food separately. Creating Meals for anything you eat again is NOT a workaround.

author: Ollie Hill
text: the UI has gone to utter rubbish making it much more tedious to log and track meals / days. the text is now huge and surrounded in massive bubbles meaning that I can't only see 4 items I've entered into my diary at a time without scrolling down the whole page. this is awful when entering in home cooked meals with more than 5 ingredients. what happened to be able to see the entire day at a glance.

author: Kevin
text: I dislike aspects of the new UI. It's so much harder to get an instant view of how many calories are left for the day after excluding exercise. The old UI made it very clear with the different colored circles, idk who thought getting rid of the clear distinction was a good idea but it wasn't. I'm considering finding an alternative if the colored bars with the new UI aren't implemented. Other aspects I like, such as the quicker way to log meals, just wish it didn't take away the exercise calories

author: Brandon Boisvert
text: They absolutely ruined this app.. I've been using it for about a decade now, and ever since they've rolled out the latest "update", The app has become horribly difficult to navigate, they've completely rearranged every single button unnecessarily, in a way that's actually very inconvenient. because of the way they've laid out the app, it's almost impossible to not continuously be pressing wrong buttons, or accidentally pressing a quick button that loads up a meal with foods that you didn't eat..

author: Erin Fourie
text: I'm still hoping that at some point this will be taken on board: short-term/milestone goals. I'd love to be able to set milestones against my long-term goal. I can't say I'm a big fan of the latest update - the interface has completely changed,and while some of the things are good overall, it's also reduced other functions - I have calorie goals per meal, and I can't see what they are anymore unless there is food logged in the respective meal.

author: Frantisek DANDA
text: After the most recent update: 1) The customizable dashboard is gone. 2) The new, uncustomizable dashboard displays only some of the information the previous one did. 3) If you log in new food by using the default tool, it doesn't ask you which meal you want to add it to. Once you log a food to a group (e.g. lunch), you can no longer move it to another group like in the previous version, or, the food doesn't log at all. Never happened before. Steps synch still glitches. Please, fix this.

author: Somaye
text: Most of the nutritional information is incorrect. I guess this is because that information is entered manually by users. I think there's a way they could just scan the nutritional information from packets and add them automatically (as other apps do that). Also even though I've connected my step counter to the app, it's always incorrect 🤷🏾‍♂️ It's definitely not worth paying for Premium

author: Ujvári Gábriel
text: The new UI is much harder to understand and instead of showing how many calories have left it shows the consumed amount which is destened to cause confusion with users. The food logging did not get harderit is just different in my opinion. The calory counter needs to be adjusted to show the remaining calories! i had to change my 5 star to 3 because of this and it will stay like that untill it gets fixed. I am sorry!

author: Kayla
text: Not sure what they've done, but this app is infuriating now. Every time I open it, it prompts me to log in again. But not even straight away, the app will open into my account, and then after 5-10seconds, logs me out asking me to login. Every. Single. Time. Will be changing to a different app.

author: Philipp Schulz
text: The new UI is terrible: - Individual foods are hidden behind the different meal-categories. - Changing the date cannot be done via swiping left or right anymore, instead via a dropdown at the top. - Display for amount of calories changed from a large dial to a small bar, making it much harder to read at a glance. - The weight chart is now hidden under the weight tab, which you have to scroll down to. Considering other Apps as alternatives right now to change to.

author: Kirsty J
text: I've just recently returned to tracking, and while there have been some minor improvements, it feels like most of the page is now ads. I can't see at a glance what I've tracked already without clicking into each mealtime. It's also easy to think you've tracked a meal only to realise it's showing yesterday's meal (in case you want to add it again) - they look similar and there's just not enough room under each mealtime now. I'm almost done with this app, it's no longer fit for purpose.

author: Sara Cameron
text: I've had this app for many years, and always loved the robust database that allows me to save my own recipes. This past 6 months or so though, suddenly the app keeps freezing/crashing. I've tried uninstalling and such, eventually figured out that logging in on a computer and using that clunky interface to enter some things can "reset" and allow me to log in to the app again... for a little while. The new update didn't fix. The app has become a frustrating time suck, sad to lose all that history!

author: James allen
text: The app works fine, is realitivly user friendly and has a lot of things on it. however it's riddled with adds, often has nutritional information not matching what your using, and or it's impossible to find your item. So much so that the app has made me want to quite the diet numerous times. While three free versions perfectly accessible, it's malicious in it's attempt to get you to buy the $29/ month premium... which is what you'll need for the scan btw.

author: Leanne T
text: overall very useful and works so well, especially compared to other. there are a few issues. 1 when you scan a barcode and the nutritional info and portion size is wrong, it lets you submit new nutritional info but not a new portion size, so you just have to create a whole new one. 2 when trying to setup the meal plans it won't let me proceed without reviewing 5 recipes, but it shows me no recipes instead just a sign saying I've reviewed them - I can't use the meal plan area as premium payer.

author: hel
text: I've been using mfp for years. while I like the UI and the big database, I miss scan the barcode function that used to be in the free ver. + would've been nice to be able to add photos of your meals. I did like the recent feature of weekly average kcals. but today, it randomly messed up my previously logged days by adding calories on its own, duplicating meals and ruining the stats, for MONTHS into the past. can only fix it manually, I don't have the patience for that. hence the rating.

author: Kevin Haaboja
text: 1 star just to get your attention. Creating meals is still broken. When I add foods to a meal, it randomly empties itself. Sometimes right away, sometimes later. This bug has been coming and going for over a year. Are you ever going to fix it? Also the ads are annoying. They pop up after the screen loads and push the content down, which causes accidentally miss the buttons or whatever.

author: Chris B
text: Nutrients when looked up in the app wrong so often, a huge amount of work to enter foods. And when I report a food wrong, with all the effort of entering the right values, I can't then use that entry, only the incorrect entry. Great app, it's just a lot of work to use it properly. UPDATE: new UI less intuitive, nutrients still wrong too often, down to 2 stars. UPDATE: constant streak popup really annoying 1 star. UPDATE: scan foods gives wrong food far too often

author: Rebekah Holt
text: App has become entirely unusable and seems to have spontaneously forgotten my account, now I can't log in or use it. It seems they've also locked the barcode scanner behind a pay wall, which definitely puts me off using it even if I do manage to regain access to my account! I used to recommend this to my friends, but I'll be warning them all to avoid now.

author: Nicolas Luna
text: Great app with a huge food database and excellent Garmin sync. However, it misses a few basic features: 1) Let me copy a single food item from a previous day instead of a whole meal. 2) Recipe duplication should work in the mobile app, not only on the web. 3) Meal Scan needs more accurate portion estimates. Fix these and this would easily be a 5-star app.

author: Rob Mongar
text: awful- the entry system is inconsistent and seems to rely on other people previous in puts. example- you add carrots. but instead of saying- "how carrots and letting you choose the measurement, no! it's a list of everything people have ever added with the word "carrot" in it. could be in cups could be a brand of carrots could be an arbitrary measurement. how long is a large carrot anyway? never been turned off an app this fast in my life!

author: f. 28
text: App used to be good but now is trash! Spent hours entering everything I ate but back up is messed it all up. Weeks have been deleted out of nowhere. Days have been combined and past enteries were repeated which messed up all the data and my averages are now out of wack. I've been using this app for almost 15 years, but it's all going down hill, and I think it's time to jump ship. edit:I contacted support for this problem, and they couldn't help. Even the website is messed up. So no point

author: Michelle Gardner
text: Rubbish if you use Garmin in track exercise. It used to work absolutely fine but since the change of layout it just doesn't want to connect to Garmin Connect for steps or exercise so i'm now having to use Garmin Connect to track everything. So frustrating. Building receipes is also really glitchy now. It can take ages to save and then the receipes disappear. Some times they are there using the search but other times they need re-inputting. when my subscription ends i wont be renewing.

author: TB
text: prefer usability prior to recent update. Easily add/move foods to different days. Current process isn't as effective. Mobile app not as easy as it was. pressing buttons i don't want as close to the 'log yesterday meal' button I accidentally push. Prefer a tab for diary log like prior. Barcode scan prompt too intrusive over screen and premium banner.

author: Alice
text: Bug in meal creating function and lots of wrong entries. When adding items to a meal, a bug causes the entire meal list to be replaced with the most recent addition. I've lost carefully curated meal lists due to this which is frustrating and time consuming. Also, so many wrong entries. There should be a voting/thumbs up option for entries so users can push the globally agreed correct ones to the top of the list. Many of the entries need to be deleted and cleaned up - don't be lazy.

author: Karin Ghosh
text: Paid for Membership. Dsappointed to not easily tweak saved recipes & adjust portion sizes of meals. Obviously not going to have the exact same amount of ingredients every time I make it. The recipe's the same but ingredient portions might change & there needs to be a setting for it. Also why can't I favorite meals I have regularly instead of searching for it? I have a coffee & greens drink daily, but have to spend 5 mins daily to add it? Barcode scanner barely works. Pls fix it.

author: Theresa “Thao” Le
text: The latest UI/UX update is absolutely horrendous. They've sacrificed usability for visual minimalism. It's annoying to use, and requires additional taps to see my diary for each meal. Much preferred being able to see the whole day in one page (which used to be on the second tab that I now keep pressing out of muscle memory but takes me to Plans). Navigating through the calendar and days is also clunky. Wish I could go back to an older version.

author: Vedran Lucic
text: App makes mostly cosmetic updates or brings new (unnecessary) features, slowly becoming bloatware. Simple improvements, for which users asked multiple times, are still ignored so you still can't delete food from your saved meals, nor you can name or give note to "quick add" calories. MyFitnessApp was solid choice decade ago, but if you are starting now to count calories try other apps before you get locked in (i.e. invest too much time in this app).

author: Shreya Nair
text: The new UI has ruined everything for me. I've been using this app for more than 7 years now and I had liked it because of its simplistic UI and had gotten used to the calorie noting experience. why change the UI into something nobody asked for? i can't see the calories properly and need to click on so many random buttons to even log one food properly. please switch it back to the old UI or I would have to switch to a new app. it's already hard to count cals, pretty sure nobody likes the new UI.

author: Fede Oliv
text: the app resign makes it too hard to view your entire day's food. while before with a single tap you could view your entire day and log food seamlessly, now logging several meals at a time is harder than ever. as a longtime user (5+ years) this redesign makes it terrible and for the first time I'm honestly considering switching to an alternative app with a better layout. having a specific "diary" button that took you straight into your whole diary with each meal made it much faster to log.

author: Soraja
text: I like the app and use it for a few year now.
