It helps me a lot with eating healthier and don't go over or under my kalories. since the new update you can easily copy a specific log to another day, thats fantastic, but the new design make it unnecessary hard to dwitch from date to date and log food. for me the former design feels much more natural to handle, maybe you can give the option to decide which on to use. would be wonderful

author: Gavin Tweddle
text: The latest Version is not user friendly. The sudden change in the user interface is TERRIBLE, you can't switch between days easily, copying meals between days takes twice as long. this latest user interface version is just BAD and I have been using this app on and off for over 10 to 15 years and this change has to be the worst ever.

author: Martha Skourteli
text: The best app for counting carbs and calories! Sadly the latest update of August 2026 is horrible. It used to be so easy to log food and water and check nutrients' totals per day, now you have to click and click and click to get where u want. Would be good to go back to how the app looked before!!

author: james brown
text: I've been using this app for years almost 10 years, and now they suddenly decided to change the UI, it would made sense if it was easier to navigate than before, they did the opposite, I had go through multiple layers to find the log rather having it on first thing like before, it was much simpler before....

author: Paula McBride
text: I love MFP. but it is very buggy at the minute, if you are copying meals across, it decides to multiply some of the ingredients, this can be so subtle at times it takes a while to notice, other times it doubles your ingredients. I shouldn't have to keep checking to see if it's right. Get it fixed for goodness sake!

author: Me
text: Every time there's an update you have to enter your details again, which wouldn't be a problem if you could save the info to a password manager but because it isn't recognised you have to reset forgotten passwords. happens way too often. EDIT: Trying to reset the password now leads to recaptcha errors. So even if you do work past the inconvenience its now impossible to log in. Maybe lay off the vibe coding, do some real testing. you're actually losing customers from this.

author: Nix C
text: Been using MyFitnessPal almost since it launched, but this update has ruined it for me. Hiding the food diary behind this new UI makes logging meals on the go a pain, which defeats the whole point of the app. I've put up with the ads for years instead of paying for Premium, but this is the final straw. Uninstalling, deleting my account and going back to Cronometer. Have you guys fired your developers and trying to use Claude Code to be cheap? Goodbye, MyFitnessPal.

author: Eryk K
text: New UI update is a downgrade, pretty sad to see that instead of listening to user complaints they tell you "navigating the new UI may take time!". Well of course I can learn to navigate it, but one issue is that it no longer lets me see the exact foods I logged for each meal in one glance - it is just a less comfortable experience. I'm switching to another app.

author: Valérie Aubin Dumas
text: I just changed my review. For an app pushing routine and consistency, I don't get the whole remodeling and changing things around. Sure, tweak some stuff that doesn't work, but changing the whole layout?? I absolutely hate this, makes it harder to log food. quite honestly, if i had not paid for premium a little before the update, i would have dropped this app. And I have used it and loved it for almost a decade.

author: Shawn W
text: New user to the app, only thing is I tried the 7 day free trial but since I cancelled lost access to the barcode scanner, would be great to be able to access it again, but love using this app all the same. Has the most comprehensive range of foods and great in Aus. Thanks for this app but if there were a way I could access the barcode scanner would be great then I could give 5 stars 🤩

author: Angus O'Callaghan
text: The UI changed, and now I can't easily see a list of the foods that I've added in for the day in one clear list. Can you please change it back? You are hiding crucial food logging content behind a series of screens now. Used to take 1 click. For some reason you have replaced the daily food log view, with a button which takes me to a 'Progress' screen. For an app whose primary user goal is logging food, this feels like an incredibly bad UX update! Please revert or give the option to revert!

author: Ross Mackenzie
text: The latest interface changes are horrible. They used to to have a quite functional interface - don't know how they could get it so wrong. eg The little stars celebration every time I log data for a new day are just plain childish. The week view on the 1st day of the week only includes 1 day, and the start of the week is a Sunday. I've possibly logged 500 - 1000 of days of data, but coming back to this version was quite a shock. Very dissapointing, considering I renewed an annual subscription.

author: Nasmatic Smith
text: This app help me lose 20 kilos, I never thought watching what I eat would be this easy. thank you... EDIT: opened the app after a while and the new layout is just terrible. the core of the app is still great but the new layout is just to promote whatever subscription or niche they're selling. log are hidden under a few clicks. tabs switched around. man if it ain't broken dont fix it!! shame.

author: Margaret Arroyo
text: Trying to contact support for a refund because I wasn't supposed to renew my subscription, but I only get support tickets every time I follow-up. The app is good but for some reason I can't use it anymore. Google Play has this Backup Payment Method, that's when they deducted the amount on my other account that was not the primary payment method. I just hope I can get money back 😢

author: Kyra van de Wetering
text: So they've gone and updated the app and it's the least user-friendly ever! I can only think they want people to subscribe but I'm not subscribing to an app that doesn't do nearly half of what it used to do, can't even get a good daily overview of my meals & calories for each which is the whole purpose of the app.

author: curt
text: Generally works ok but will randomly log me out. This morning I logged one food item for breakfast then a second later it logged me out before I could add the rest. Will be randomly logged out every week-month with seemingly no pattern. Also disappointed by inconsistency compared to the mobile site, eg. no ability to "quick add" calories, and won't give weight forecast for less than 1500 calories per day (my target) but mobile site has minimum set to 1200.

author: Alegria Peters
text: Sometimes there's no option for a specific food that has the correct number of calories, and there's no way for me to edit it so that my calorie count is actually accurate. I've never been able to accurately log a meal in this app, which is frustrating. I'd rather use a pencil and paper to track at this point. Ridiculous.

author: Becky Gray
text: have used the free version for years and now you have to subscribe to scan barcodes. The new updates are not user friendly and the app kicks you out all the time having to re log back in. You're constantly being reverted back to the premium membership page which is annoying. I'll be deleting this app and finding another one.

author: Andreea Ssd
text: I've been using this app for years, i currently have premium+ and a 2160 days streak... overnight the UI was changed massively, the new UI is awful and unintuitive. It requires more taps to do or see certain things, in the old UI i could see at a glance the calories for all the things i ate in a meal because they were stacked neatly at the right of the screen, now they are under the food, the old UI was perfectly functional and actually GOOD. please give us a way to switch back :(

author: Erica S
text: the new UI is really BAD!!! it's was great for years. I've been using MFP since 2014! and it's always been the best app to track. the new UI is difficult to use and really really bad to to navigate across days!!! it's terrible! you didn't need to fix a problem that we didn't have!!!! CHANGE IT BACK

author: Saber Bunny (Bunny)
text: This used to be a good app, recent updates over the last few years are designed to make it "iPhone" pretty, aka absolutely junk as far as functionally. I came back to find it's changed yet again and it's basically worthless now. I'm looking for another app, even if I have to pay. This one is convoluted and moved many features behind a pay wall, I will not pay when the free version can't even do the basics it used too. Save yourself the headache and use something else.

author: John Holbrook
text: New UI is trash, can no longer see everything I've eaten/need to eat in a day. Instead I now have to open each mealtime to see what I'm eating for that period. App randomly logs me out and when I log in I lose everything previously logged which is useless for cals and macros for progress reviews.

author: RJ
text: too many notifications about upgrading from a paid premium account to an even more expensive premium plus account. I can't disable those notifications that come up every other day. you guys are already collecting money from me, but you want more for an upgraded experience? I'll be requesting a refund and finding another app.

author: Matthew Benson
text: Overall I think this is a really good tool for tracking food and macros, however, I strongly encourage using either the app or the website on a computer but not both together. This app positively struggles with staying in sync with changes made online via a computer.

author: Ivan Dilov
text: This is one of the best calory tracker out there with the best data base I know. I lost 15kg in 4 months using it with Garmin Vivofit 3. 9 years later, after last update the interface is awful. Usually one makes update for improvement, but you guys, you did it to earn your salary 😄 It's annoying to scroll through different menus to reach what you want. In the old interface everything was at glance. Petty.

author: Terilynn Bench Harris
text: Overall a really helpful tool. There are a few glitches related to tracking fasting (if you start after midnight you lose the ability to track for a full day) and some of the information is hard to decipher, but otherwise it's good!

author: Jorge Urías Peña Escajeda
text: there is a problem with the latest update. It seems that there's a disparity with the total consumed calories in a day compared to the total macros, when I do the math myself the numbers don't add up and the total calories falls short. This is ia Problem when 200 cal make the deficit.

author: Emma Downey
text: Have been using this app for so long I can't even remember how many years. The new update is sooo bad!! Way harder to use, logs foods on wrong days, takes way more time to log meals, so annoying. Why has it been changed was way better before. Will have to find a new app ... very poor

author: Robyn Scott
text: Ads are slow to load and cause the page to shift just as you're about to touch your screen. Audio in ads is annoying and takes over other audio. Otherwise, this is the best tracking app I've ran across, but I won't recommend it until the ad issued are gone.

author: Grace Chen
text: The new UI is extremely difficult to use. previous features that were great included a scroll view of the whole day of eating, instead of meals being segregated into their own screen. also being able to swipe left or right to change days. this new UI is so many more clicks for the same functionality, and the food logging takes up a lot more screen space than previously. to change which meal a food is in, I now have to click on each food and manually change, instead of holding to change. awful UI

author: Chase Mann
text: The free version is good for tracking macros. Unfortunately there are a lot of features behind a paywall and I do not believe the cost of the features is worth paying the hefty premium, but the base app works great and I would recommend it to family and friends.

author: Matt Fink
text: Going downhill fast recently the way they are playing games with changing the buttons to take you to different things to see their stupid ads! a few years ago when I wrote this review about how this app continues to go downhill I'm very disappointed it continues to go downhill to this day it moves around it makes you hit on ads I am so disappointed I cannot be less disappointed I wish I could give less than one star maybe it's just an Android thing maybe thisis an app that gears tword apple.

author: Denis genest
text: constantly logs out, especially mid adding items to daily tracking, makes no sense. the search has also gotten way worse and seems to lag or time out... like i just got no results for peanut butter. The app has slowly been getting worse over the years and I'm finally uninstalling:(

author: Brian Vega
text: I've been using it for years; I even got the Pro subscription. It was working fine until the last update. I didn't like the latest UI changes on Android; the screen seems overloaded. I ended up re-logging the food from the day before by mistake all the time. Perhaps it's time to switch to another app 😞

author: Jack
text: this app would be so much better if there wasn't AI in it, but that's like asking the government to stop spending money on wars. probably not going to happen. Anyways the one star is for the amount of AI garbage there is on this app. I will be happy to change my review if the developer can address this, yet with how much money their company is "saving", I doubt any significant change will come soon. It is a half decent app for counting calories. So theres that.

author: Rowdy Aurora
text: I like being able to keep an eye on my calories. It was better when I could just scan the barcode. Then they made it a pay feature so I have to try to guess some of the other calories. It just take a little bit more time to type things in

author: Cari Cruse
text: WHY does the app keep logging me out? The worst part is it does it soon as I finish entering a whole meal, asks if I want to log in, I do, & the meal isn't there. Has happened on several occasions past few weeks. Cancelled Premium! New UI is horrible mess. Have used MFP 13 years.

author: Yhomo Hutchinson
text: Great app if you want to focus on losing weight and/or add muscle mass. The option to track your macros and the ease of finding foods or adding new food is a breeze. Also love the option of being able to add my 3rd party programs like samsung health for activity tracking and renpho scale for weight monitoring so I don't have input any of those data manually😁 August 18 update MFP, this new interface is horrible imo & not user-friendly

author: Jonathen Le Roux
text: this is a really great app, I've compared this to macrofactor and I've lost more weight tracking using my fitness pall than what I lost using macrofactor, on caveat though, I would like to choose the start date on the weekly view. other than that it's a pretty great tracking app.

author: Jan De Luyck
text: This used to be a good, functional app for tracking calories. With the new dashboard they've unfortunately managed to make the process of adding food to your diary very unintuitive - a complete pain. with the latest redesign you'd hope they learn, but instead of better they manage to make parts of it worse.

author: Daisy Ferri
text: The new interface is horrible: when you display the full day the calories remaining disappear, the detail of calories used for each meal is no longer there, and it's not possible to scroll between days anymore. Come on guys, what is this?

author: Aleks Malakhovsky
text: New ui is awful and I will not be renewing my subscription seeing that the app only become more broken with every update. My fitness pal was previously the king of calorie tracking but the app has really been falling behind and becoming more and more frustrating to use.

author: Vishesh Vishnu
text: The new August 2026 update is horrible. Can't see all the foods, no quick add calories option, it's clunky and difficult to navigate. I'll switch to another app if it isn't changed. I've been using this since 2012.

author: Trauts Rellaw
text: All good things must come to an end. The recent interface update is not as user friendly as it was before. The day selector is horrible. More clicks to see my whole day diary. Landscape view to see macros is gone. A lot of the changes seem to be unnecessary.

author: Daniel Pena
text: The updated UI is horrible. It takes more clicks to do the same thing and the information displayed is not organized like before. I pay for premium and will not be renewing my subscription. Sucks because I have a very long streak.

author: Kobus Vermeulen
text: tried to use it for the first time in a while, simply refuses to log in. one screen says I don't have an account another that e-mail already associated with one. log-in with Google just hangs. have uninstalled and reinstalled. used to be an easy light weight app but has just become a bloated hunk of junk

author: Roz T
text: Dropped another star as the lack of capability to set/update timestamp is unique to android. On iOS you can update timestamp for the meal or the food. The developers clearly know how to do it...just not a priority to enhance the android user experience. The 2026 update broke timestamps, at least for premium users. 'Use last time' no longer recognizes the last time. Why can't we just set the time of the meal? There are other issues with the update, but that's the one that made me drop a star.

author: Heinrich Joubert
text: Absolutely terrible update! absolutely terrible! why can't I view all my food logged for the day as one long list without having to tap twice? why can't I tap check boxes to bulk delete items from my list?! who the hell made this update?! yea any update on fixing this?! Literally have to delete every individual item at a time for it to work properly

author: Ross
text: i downloaded this app based on features that are free on my partners phone. (barcode scan) for ease of tracking my food. It was premium only on my device so there is no point me using this app, so I removed it straight away as it took the ease away from the whole thing

author: Christopher
text: Causes significant background battery drain on Oppo Find X9 Ultra. Despite updates the issue was not fixed, MFP was the #1 battery drain on my phone despite me only using it for a couple of minutes per day, in the end I had to uninstall it because it became so bad.

author: Aberlure
text: Previously 5 Stars New appearance and UI are atrocious. Updated Design is inconvenient and uselessly bothersome. Provide an option to change back to previous design or you will see me switch to Yazio in about a week. Please update so that users can choose between the old and new version. New seems to bothersome and an overhaul nobody (or at least I) never asked for.

author: Simone Vernikov
text: User for years. The new UI is TERRIBLE. It's extremely unfriendly, takes multiple steps to log food, it's less clear what you are logging. Bring back the old interface, otherwise I'll switch to a different app

author: Mohammad Darwish
text: I've been using myfitnesspal for 10 years. Last update ruined the whole app. Can't use it like usual and everything seems unnecessarily complicated and difficult to access. I really look forward for the team to fix the recent update as the old one was way better.

author: Julia Jenks
text: I used to use this app before there was a premium version, and now it has ruined my experience. Locking barcode scanning behind a pay wall is awful. $20 a month to scan barcodes???? I will be uninstalling and telling people to use something else.

author: Maik
text: Been using the app for over a decade and the UI is getting worse every update. In its current form everything seems to be layered in multiple sub menus, requiring multiple clicks what previously took 1 click. Can not recommend this even as a free app anymore.

author: Glen Corder
text: No need to pay for subscription if you understand macros, works great Edit: 11-30-23 app constantly adds deleted foods when I manually change them, puts me in situation where I still have to mentally remember everything and constantly recheck information...👎8-27-26 app is like a beta tester and is as bad as can be👎👎👎👎👎

author: Zach M
text: Tried this app again. It failed on the first day. Cannot remove food once logged. I work nights and to properly keep track need to enter all my food on one day. This app is incredibly difficult to do that with.

author: Paul Glatte
text: Paid subscriber since 2018. This new (May 2026) UX is atrocious. You turned simple tasks into 4-5 clicks instead of 1-2. Tracking food should be fast, not a scavenger hunt through menus. A Classic View option would have kept longtime users happy. Instead, after years of paying, I'm now shopping for another app. Sometimes "new" is simply worse. begging you guys to consider going back or giving the option . If not it's just as easy to click click click over to another fitness companies app.

author: Ruby Rosenberg
text: I am a paying member and new UI is awful, cant delete multiple items together anymore so if you accidentally enter the wrong saved meal you have to delete each item. so many more clicks for same info as before. not a single improvement, many downsides to this update

author: Mike Márquez
text: the last update ruined the UI, it "looks" good but isnt user friendly at all, many steps to do the same thing you did before, it doesnt show the info you want. perhaps its time to jump ship to another app

author: Katie Wood
text: really good app I don't like nowadays they charge money to use the barcode scanner I think that was scummy of them. I do have an older account and I'm glad I never deleted my old account as I think it has better features then nes accounts though overall good calorie tracker

author: Christina H
text: I used to like this app. They continue to be more restrictive on the foods you find in the free version to log in your diary. Essentially trying to force you to pay for a version you don't want or need. All I want are the basics, and now that is becoming limited. Time to search for a new app to track my food diary.

author: Vipul Uchil
text: app is more or less unusable after the latest update, which is definitely vibe coded because some MBA decided to fire all the UX professionals at the company. they took a perfectly intuitive and functional app and destroyed it for no reason at all. the new app is not user friendly in any way, actively prevents you from finding information, prevents you from quickly logging food. why would you ever use a food logging app when it takes you forever to log a single item of food? use cronometer.

author: Adam Reid
text: paid app has become unbearable to use after almost 3 years. who asked for this change anyway? now it keeps forgetting my macro preferences. takes forever to login in. boots me out of my profile to have to log back in daily. the streak badge EVERY, SINGLE, DAY! cant be disabled. proof that change for the sake of change isn't a good thing. canceling my annual subscription in a month. Sadly, its the end of an era

author: Ahmad Alhukail
text: The app has a lot of bugs. I subscribed using Google Pay and it didn't even reach the app so I paid but I have no Pro subscription!. There are a lot of ways that they can make the app better but they do not. The only good thing about the app is the database they have compared to other ones. Switching to MacroFactor is the way...

author: Tristan W
text: please incorporate the option to where somebody can go on a certain date like April 28th and copy the whole day to a future date. it used to be so much easier and a lot of the other apps give us this option to do except for MyFitnessPal. now there's just too much work involved. I'm not sure why you guys got rid of the option to copy the whole Dave's plan compared to now we have to do it by each category.

author: Gav H
text: Difficult. Barcode scanning is hit and miss. Could benefit from some simple interface changes to make things more intuitive. Mostly trying to push you down the paid route. looking for better elsewhere to just simply track calories.

author: Kailie Shatzer
text: I actually used this app before they started charging for it (YEARS AGO) so I know exactly what they're charging for and it's definitely not worth what they're charging for. I use the free version and they should only be charging for probably half of what they charge. I would definitely pay a monthly fee of maybe $7 like I do the Guava app. They definitely need to rethink cost versus features. I only use this maybe a month at a time.

author: Andreea R
text: Newest version gives AI-made unfinished start-up project vibes and NO ONE asked for this. The old UI worked specifically because it was so simple and distinctive from every generic tracker app. You can't even do basic stuff like SETTING THE BEGINNING OF THE WEEK now. Long-time user but this might finally be the cue to switch. The massive DB is the strongest feature but ultimately a good DB can be built elsewhere if enough people contribute to it. Even pen and paper would be better at this point.

author: Brittany Tyler
text: I loved this app when I started my weight loss journey! It helped me stay on track with how many calories I was taking in during the day, plus how many I was burning after my cardio workouts. I lost 63 pounds altogether in a year. This app has a spot for you to type in food and how many calories it carries. It has workout videos and programs to try. I did the free version and I recommend this to anyone trying to lose weight.

author: James Long
text: Update 8/12/26 - Please go back to the interface and functionality that was in place between 2014 and 2017. The interface was usable, functional, and informative. This new interface sucks. It's beyond horrible. It's a classic case of trying to do too much. I just want to log my food everyday, see my caloric intake, and tap on Complete Diary to the 5-week projection of my weight. Please fix it.

author: Bri W
text: ive used this app for 6 years and i dont intend to stop but they have got to do something about how glitchy it is. half the time, typing in foods takes forever to pop up if at all, the app randomly logs out even in the middle of navigating the app, the updates make it even less user friendly.

author: Adam Taglini
text: The new visual interface has absolutely ruined this app. The new app requires much more clicking around between pages to check my meals and is severely less user friendly. It is much less attuned to the habits of people who track their meals and seems to have just had a new design which didn't solve any issues and simply added more complication. They have made the app significantly worse to use while dressing it up in some new designs. Never thought I'd find myself giving 1-star to this app.

author: Phil Ellis
text: 1★. Changing serving sizes doesn't update nutrition totals until the app is restarted. I planned my meals based on the numbers MyFitnessPal displayed, only to find out after restarting that the totals had changed. A nutrition tracker that can't reliably recalculate calories and sodium after edits isn't trustworthy. Fix this.

author: Pete Driver
text: Latest version makes the diary, the whole reason for the app, nearly impossible to log food. Duplicates. Can't search. It's unreal that they could mess it up so badly.

author: Yves Amar
text: Previously 5 star but it has become utterly unbearable to use. Constantly loses connection to your profile requiring you to sign in every time. Now RESETS daily calorie and macro goals, no matter how many times you set them.... NEVER an issue before in over 7 years of being a premium member, unusable in the past month. Fix

author: Joyce Manalo
text: They removed the "Nutrient View" dashboard where you choose which nutrient to display. I track Protein Carbs and Fiber. I don't track fat. I can't do that anymore. I will not be renewing my Premium unless Nutrient Dashboard is returned.

author: Carli Whaley
text: I've been using This app for several years And I used to really love it but I feel like The paid version is overpriced for how I use it. I'm literally just paying for the scanner at this point. the recipe Discovery and the meal planning portion is garbage for way more reasons than I have room to say why here LOL. I'm kind of mad at myself for paying it again I'll probably Look for something else before my next renewal.

author: Adam Leighton
text: I did rate this 5 stars in 2017 and have been using it since before then. But ever since their update in 2026, which has made it less user-friendly, more clicks to get to things, hiding information and many other downgrades, I am actually uninstalling. I didn't think I would see the day. But when the app becomes a barrier between me getting to eat my meal because Im spending more time logging my food, its a no from me. There are other alternatives to use now on the play store.

author: Mark Flahant
text: I highly value MyFitnessPal. However, I am unable to endorse the current version due to the exclusion of the barcode scanning feature from the standard offering. It is my understanding that this functionality is now exclusively available as part of the premium subscription, which I find to be an unreasonable change. It might be time for a free alternative.

author: Richard Page
text: the app itself is great, really helps track your meal logging well, probably the best I've used. since some recent update however, the notifications are horrendous. things like ' The truest horror story - you not logging your meal' or 'Not logging your meal? you'll make us sad'. paraphrasing, but theyre SO try hard, it makes me think about wanting to uninstall. it doesn't have to be quirky, just a generic meal logging reminder is enoough

author: Chris Iliff
text: I haven't yet found a better app... but I've down graded from 5 stars to 3. Two reasons... the new UI is horrible in my opinion. little things like swiping left and right for days have gone. It's harder to see what you've added when you're adding multiple ingredients... it's just... meh. Secondly and more importantly the foods need a really good clean up. There's so much 'noise' with user added values it's really difficult to actually find the food with the right nutritional value now. Shame.

author: Nathan Locke
text: Awesome app, good for tracking all your macros in one place (with premium of course). What I'd love, is folders within the "My Recipes" section so I can create breakfasts, lunches, grilled, fried, chicken, beef, soup etc so it tidies up the list. Would make it a bit nicer! Edit: I'd also love to be able to set my calorie target by week, so if I go over on a Monday it adjusts the rest of the week accordingly - would also be useful for calorie banking if I was planning a big weekend.

author: K-IX Athletics
text: Disappointed keto person here. I decided to go premium so I could adjust my own macros (less than 20g of carbs) and to be able to track fasting. Well part of intermittent fasting lifestyle is to be able to do longer fasts once in a while but this app will not let you log a fast longer than 24hrs! this means I still need to use another app for fasting tracking. I dont think I will be renewing the premium. Otherwise its a decent app that I have used for many years.

author: Jason Lawrence
text: very happy with the app for recording calories, but be aware that when using the free version that some of the ads are from known scam/data collecting companies. Not purely illegal, but certainly something users need to be aware of. Be wary of the ads. Would love to have the scan barcode available again in the free version too.

author: Bernadine Vincent
text: This app used to be a great, free way of logging your food without any nonsense, now its an absolute mess with this new format & horrible to use! I updated & went to log my food & now can't find anything. The daily journal page with the days at the top & huge banners are off putting, the right swipe to move back to yesterday is gone now you have to click the date at the top & then remember to go back into today otherwise it'll stay on the other date. 10yrs of simple, no BS food tracking gone.

author: George Bower
text: I used this app for years without missing a day, it was incredible, so user friendly, after the latest update it is an absolute unusable mess, if it does not return to it's former state or something resembling it they have lost my premium membership renewal

author: y. Reddy
text: Editing to respond to the developer: When the 'free' experience is frustrating and ineffective, yes you should be sorry. This app is like using a calculator that makes you pay for the total after you hit 'enter'. You decided to put basic nutritional information behind a paywall because of greed and nothing else. Your free features are useless I forgot why I deleted this app years ago. Putting everything from protein onwards behind a paywall is a gross cash grab and you should be ashamed.

author: Mihail Nita
text: App is mediocre at best but I have bought a full year subscription so have to use it. AI Photo engine works in limited circumstances to identify foods but is absolutely useless when it comes to quantities. It cannot distinguish from a small yogurt worth 60 calories and a full cup worth 250 calories. essentially you will end up logging everything by hand and there are free apps for that...

author: Rohan Houf
text: solid app but for 3 days in a row I had to re-create a meal cause it does not save it. steps are also constantly miscalculated even when all apps are synced. Good for the basics but not enough if you want to take it serious and not want to use the pro version.

author: Nick Dillard
text: Its really good and offers everything you need in the free version, but there is a bug when searching up food items where you'll press space and it makes you start typing at the beginning of the text, which can be frustrating because you need to delete and retype. Other than that it has been pleasant

author: António Pereira Barata
text: The app was good, but the new UI is a major downgrade. I can no longer see my total and remaining calories, macros, and all meals in one view. Opening a meal only shows that meal’s macros, making it much harder to plan around my daily allowance. I pay for Premium, but this change removes the app’s main value for me. Please add an option to switch back to the old UI.

author: Kirsten Spear
text: This is the best app I've used for counting calories to manage weight loss. I cook most meals at home, so the recipe building option is really helpful. Also, you can use HSA money for the yearly subscription. The free option works, but if you use it regularly the ads are too annoying.

author: Rania Badawi
text: The new UI is very limiting. Please roll back to the old UI experience, it was clearly showing each meal, total calories for each and was way easier to read. This one isn't too great and missing a lot of information about each food item one normally needs to see in the same screen.

author: Yulianet Garrido
text: I love that even with the free version of MyFitnessPal, you can search for and find the exact brand of food to log without having to pay for the barcode scanner feature. It's so easy to track what you eat, and the food database is amazing. I absolutely love MyFitnessPal!

author: Afiya Brown
text: I have used the app & have premium services for close to 6 years. I'm not happy with the new "update." It's more time-consuming. Logging meals & making slight adjustments are no longer simple. I will be looking for another app. Very disappointed!! UPDATE TO DEVELOPER - I & millions of other users just want the app to go back to the way it was. Why do companies who have probably never used the app think they should make changes without asking the people who use it?

author: Bo Bowen
text: Frustrating and unintuitive to use now after the update. It's super easy to instantly add a bunch of food to a meal and then you have to go in and manually delete every item one by one if you accidentally click the button. I might switch to a different app after all these years. 👎

author: Gordon Matthewman
text: Latest updates make this app really efficient and easy to use. The only update I'd like to see would be an option to input the Steps count manually. With every fitness app continually updating it doesn't collect Step data from my phone anymore and obviously that affects calorie intake.

author: Policy
text: I'm not able to search up food anymore. You would think for an app to help count your calories it would be useful to, you know, actually be able to search up food. Now I may not be a genius but I'm fairly certain that tacos exist. Funny how the search thinks otherwise.

author: Mahdy Berriri
text: The app was working pretty fine for its entire lifetime But for whatever reason, you decide to make a terrible and pointless update !! The app is almost unusable now!! I used to navigate it very easily, but now, all that muscle memory is lost A lot of horrible user experience features as well. Why on earth would I want to copy what I had for breakfast yesterday in today's diary ? that's a pointless feature ! it's also one click away so it's very easy to make that mistake Why ? just, why ?

author: Ādams Kopštāls
text: The redesign is woeful. Its much harder to see entries at a glance, it's annoying to move through days of the week, and I can't even find some of the basic fuctions like quick add calories. The app has been butchered.

author: Kelly T
text: Used to be Way Better. I strongly dislike the new layout, i often accidentally "log the same as yesterday" because of where that option is. also recently there have been video ads with audio, which I absolutely fkn hate. need at least an option to mute all sound in the app.

author: Filipe Badaró
text: The new UI is absolutely atrocious, making the basic functionality (adding food intake) far more annoying and less intuitive. I've been a user for a decade and this is so bad that for the first time ever I'm considering moving to other apps.

author: Samit Babbar
text: The latest version has some worthwhile improvements but one feature I'm missing now is ability to quickly swipe between dates (left right swipe). is there any way to activate it? Also, the meal logging is somewhat cumbersome now.

author: Reema Thakkar
text: its so rubbish that people have to pay to use the barcode option. I used to love my fitness pal and I had lost so much weight but now I don't enjoy it was much and don't use it as much. Its a shame to be honest that I am having to write this review 😕

author: Kar Law
text: The recent update killed this app. It's not easy to navigate (alot of clicks), time consuming to enter, the macro adjustment is so hard, everything is hard to read and follow. I gave myself time and tried the update too, and I still hate it after months. Please dumb this down, make this easy to enter and read. You are making this overly complicated!!!

author: Fran Henderson
text: This app is a great tool for keeping people on track with their healthy eating and exercise goals. 8/16/26. Beta tracker for GLP-1 needs to add a pill option.

author: Manpreet
text: MyFitnessPal remains the absolute king of calorie tracking for one simple reason: its massive database of over 14 million foods. Whether you're scanning a barcode on a packaged snack or logging a home-cooked regional dish, the app almost always finds the exact match instantly. The 'Recent Foods' list makes daily logging take less than two minutes. It takes all the tedious guesswork out of managing your nutrition. An absolute 5-star app for hitting weight goals!"

author: James Procaccini
text: Sorry but.... the new UI is terrible. Please revert back to the previous version of the app while you work on the changes requested by the users. Literally, there is nothing in the new app that makes it easier to use when compared to the previous version. The character limitation of this review box is not large enough for me to list all of the shortfalls. Again, sorry!

author: Pedro Colmenares
text: The latest update does not synchronize your calorie goal with the home menu. i set 1500 as a goal but the main menu shows 2035. makes no sense. EDIT: Issue persists. I can upload images of the issue if needed EDIT: i am putting a 4/5. turns out the app was tracking ny calories burned through Samsung Health on my watch. suggestion: keep my original goal and in patenthesis the exercise-adjusted goal or vice versa. the one with the 🔥 emoji.

author: Kei Agajani
text: Been using this app for over a decade. I dropped off between 2023 til now because it just became useless with the features it had. Came back to it this week and I see awesome improvements like actually showing net calories and counting net calories throughout the week! I had to do that in spreadsheets before. Great job!

author: Lisa Steffen
text: Update for the dev team: I LOVE the recent update to fasting start time! TY! TY! TY! .......... This app is a lot better than it was a few years ago, some great dev had happened and overall I'm impressed. I have one ask: let me add my fast the day in going to finish it and set the start date for a time the evening prior. Sometimes I forget to start it on the app, but if it's the following day you can't say you started the previous day at 8pm. Would love to see a fix.

author: Roslyn Menezies
text: Updated June 2026 I originally gave this app 5 stars in 2015 because it was simple, reliable and easy to use. Unfortunately, over the years it has become cluttered, harder to navigate, and increasingly focused on paid features. Since the recent update you can't see your full day on a page, it's harder to log, each food item goes over three lines. Can someone please invent a simple Aussie app so I can escape this trauma???

author: ManfromtheRedRiver
text: Integration with Garmin is nice. Can be difficult to find the right foods with the right details. Also interrupts me with annoying pop-ups that cover the entire screen when I'm trying to log food to congratulate me on the fact that I'm trying to log food...

author: Randall Montgomery
text: Great experience with this app. I would like to track my other micronutrients like magnesium along with the other micros you already have on there. Additionally, I would like to create recipes with specific serving sizes like, tbsp. It also crashes if you take too long to add said recipe.

author: M. Spoor
text: Can't add anything that I haven't previously saved as a meal. Any time i search for another food, I get a "network error, please try again later" message. Meanwhile the exercises STILL don't sort by most recent, despite developer saying they're working on it months ago.

author: عبدالرحمن النويصر
text: I’m experiencing a lot of issues with the watch. It only worked properly the first time after it was installed. Since then, it hasn’t synced with the phone data at all. Retrieving logs from the watch is also very slow, and sometimes it doesn’t work either. Overall, this has been a very disappointing experience, especially considering that I’m paying for the premium subscription.

author: Adele Evertsz
text: This app is so reliable, because it helps you with tracking how your lifestyle is. with every intake of your personal tracking information of movement and eating you will feel better. But you have to do it manually and consistently otherwise it won't work. try it out for yourself and let me know.

author: Chelsea Walls
text: Pretty good app, but I wish there were more meal tabs to keep things organized. Even just a meal tab named supplements would help with tracking nutrients. I wouldn't have to track down which meal I ate them with and could copy it each day if I didn't make any changes.

author: Adam Hsieh
text: The most common complaint you see everywhere on the internet with MFP...they offer integration with third party apps to sync weigh ins from connected scales...however - none of it seems to work. Or if it works, it doesn't work consistently. Zero support from MFP on this other than an unhelpful FAQ.

author: Lauren Hinde
text: Not having the ability to scan in free mode is killing me. I've used other free apps that at least allow for some more basic functions and look more engaging and interactive. Not willing to pay to advance what is available with how the free version looks/functions.

author: Anssi Yli-Leppälä
text: App just got UI update and it is way more clunky versus earlier UI. I have been using this years and I hope I could use the old UI. But I give it a chance and update my review if I gey firm grasp on it. But overall big thanks to MFP! I have lost over 30 kg weight over the years because of MFP and counting calories. 😊

author: Jay M
text: After the last update I'm no longer able to search for the foods through the extensive library. I used to be able to do this and now with the free version no matter what food I put in it tells me no search results available. super disappointed because this was a really good app.

author: John Corbett
text: I used to love and rely on this app, but they have changed the interface. it's unusable and frustrating. I reached out to the support team who disregarded any feedback I provided in an unpleasant way. That experience was even more frustrating. I'm canceling my subscription and uninstalling.

author: Paul V
text: food data sharing makes it easier to track. there should be a way to show both calories and kilojoules (at the same time without adjusting settings), as places like Australia use both. saving custom meals and macros helps. just unsure why the daily calorie intake keeps changing each day. good app

author: Colleen
text: I tried to come back and give it a chance, but what used to be the BEST nutrition app has been completely destroyed. I used this app religiously for over a decade and never questioned paying for premium. The updates from last autumn completely killed it! I used to track everything nutritional here and export to other apps, but I've settled for logging directly into multiple mediocre apps instead. MyFitnessPal is a heartbreaking disappointment. Don't waste your time or money.

author: Megan Feller
text: I'm getting used to it. I like the widget that shows my macro totals for the day. HATE that I can't use the barcode on the free version- that really may be the reason I use another app. allow it to be on the free version, that's just a basic necessity

author: Crystal Middents
text: The old version was loads better. I absolutely can't stand the new interface of this app. Ypu can't view the log on a given meal from the day before by tapping it, without it automatically logging that days food. It is so annoying. I wish they would go back to the old app.

author: David Ogston
text: It's an awesome app for counting calories and Macros. The only down side is when you are exercising and it automatically changes your calorie goal. To stop the calorie goals changing you need the premium version. The calorie goal changing should not automatically change. Other than that it's an awesome app

author: It's Me
text: Have had this app for years and liked using it on and off. But I'm not a fan of the new layout for logging food and its annoying that im constantly having to sign back in to my account.

author: Maeve Carey
text: Trying to get used to new version (26). I can't see a way of easily deleting all meals in a day and copying over meals from another day. New version feels very disjointed and not as user-friendly. Web .. food item appearing in meal which should not be there so web is incorrect even after sync.

author: Mila-Rose Osher
text: I love myfitnesspal and have the subscription. However, the steps no longer sync correctly and I've already added and re-added Health connect, Uninstaller, cleared cache, and wish it would just work like it used to. Wish we could hide the premium meal planning if we choose not to purchase it. If someone can help w/steps correctly syncing from SHealth & Oura, please let me know!

author: Tom E
text: UPDATE 7/5/26: STILL TERRIBLE and, additionally, other apps fail to sync any longer, even after uninstalling and reinstalling, emptying cash, etc. This app is no longer useful. New update is so entirely terrible. I now have to press about 3x as many buttons to complete the same task.

author: Bonnie Scott
text: I have been using this app for years. It's easy to use and it's the easiest way for me to keep track of my food. It has helped me lose 32lbs and keep it off! You can personalize it to fit your specific needs: low carb, high proteins, sugars, intermittent fasting - it tracks it all! I love this app.

author: Megan Lutz
text: useful and pretty accurate for tracking food and meals, but the update to the UI is unintuitive and makes it harder to interact with (adding water, too easy to accidentally copy a previous meal, too easy to change previous days' entries when trying to copy to a future date).

author: woodsy2206
text: Dropping the review from 5 stars to 3. Still a fantastic calorie tracker but the UI update makes it more difficult to quickly see what's been eaten at a glance. Too blocky and cumbersome to use. Much prefer the older design for it's functionality than the newer version because it's prettier.

author: Johan Laursen
text: I pay for premium to not have ads and get extra features. Instead this app goes out of its way to annoy with notifications and pop ups about streaks like the most annoying ads possible. Cannot recommend until the developers learn basic common sense and atleast provide the option to remove usage streaks.

author: Luca Miller
text: It's very helpful. Today I am encountering issues logging food, things I add are showing up as 0 calories. I clicked 30 calories of grilled broccoli, and it appeared to add, but the log showed grilled broccoli, 0 cal. The same happened for other parts of my meal. Could I have help with this please?

author: Pam G
text: For the weekly calories and nutrient charts, It would be helpful to be able to change the default start day from Sunday to whatever day of the week you have a weigh-in. example, if you weigh every Friday, the current display will only show progress starting on Sunday instead of Fridays.

author: Matthew T. Price
text: I don't know why, but sometimes this app syncs with my Samsung smartwatch and counts every exercise twice. some days, it doesn't count the exercise at all. there's no manual way to force it to sync. this is unusable and I don't recommend it to anybody

author: Toni
text: The latest updates to the app have removed the ability to view the macros od each food item logged. This was previously possible to view (on android) by turning the phone onto landscape. It no longer provides the content I need, even as a premium member so to will not be continuing use or buying a premium subscription.

author: Mimi Nguyen
text: I do like it overall, but every time I type out food to log, my letters suddenly get moved around to the front of the text box so I have to retype the food I was trying to log. I hope this gets fixed as it does it at least twice a day

author: AJs Fire
text: App not loading. Nothing on device changed in the past 12 hours. Cleared cache, restarted, did full un-install/reboot/reinstall and still nothing. MFP indicates no issues. To watch this app go from something incredible to this over the years seems appropriate considering each "update" made things worse for the user experience.

author: Sankhyapriyo Dey
text: I have been using this app for a really long time till now I have lost 30 kgs of weight it was a little Janky that's for sure, birthday it got an update and that changes a lot of things, and by saying a lot I mean a HELLA LOT of things the way they are utilising the data to give out stats is absolutely amazing, there is literally no need of a paid alternative this became the gold standard, i love the new update

author: Joshua Wagner
text: I don't like the update, I miss how simple it was and how I could see what I ate for meals without clicking on the meal tab. edit: remember when we used to be able to scan barcodes without premium? Good times before corporate greed took over

author: Janelba Perez
text: Need Better Fasting Tracker. The existing tracker doesn't allow for 18:6 fasting or free form tracker for extended full days of fasting. I was doing a 48 hour fast and the existing tracker shut off at 24 hours. Not being able to track in real time was very annoying and discouraging.

author: Leon Hughes
text: The free side of the app is so difficult to use. Finding the right amount is impossible with out spending alot of time adjusting everything. Why would I want to purchase this when it's so frustrating to use.

author: Caitlin Simmons
text: I was randomly logged out of this app several days ago and can't log back in. I've attempted to reset my password, but no password reset email arrives in my inbox. I emailed support but haven't heard back. I pay for a premium subscription to this app and I am about to cancel since I can't access it.

author: Leanna Wolf
text: I like being able to create meals, but I've noticed a bug recently where when I add certain foods to meals and log the meals, the calorie count for those foods shows up as 0 in my diary. Please fix this! I otherwise enjoy the app

author: Ricky Christensen
text: **Edit** 07-02-26: It has a tough time tracking calories in the pre-made meals- even with their "verified" / "green check marked" items. You can have them added, but it wont show the calories or add them. Pay attention!!

author: NormalAntipathy
text: (Edit as of 6/26/2026): While trying to load the app, it attempts to cycle into the main screen for a split second then goes right back to the loading page. Issue was resolved by deleting the app and redownloading. (Previous rating ⭐): I can't adjust my goals in app (calories and macros).

author: Sarah Locker
text: lowering to 3 stars... I HATE the latest update. Made the food diary SUPER ANNOYING to use. CAN'T see your list of logged food without extra clicks. So it takes longer if you accidentally click something twice or need to edit it.

author: Michael Ficocelli
text: This app has a number of excellent features, and at one point was super easy to track your eating and share your meals with family. But now it is so clogged with useless or paywalled features, and absolutely INFESTED with ads, that it takes a very long time to load any page or interact with the tools.

author: Mark
text: I hate the new update. I have the paid premium version so I should have a choice of what version to use. It's like buying a car and the dealer can change the car at any time they want because they think what they're giving you has improvements. Is there a way I can go back to previous interface? I want to be able to see a breakdown of each meal and how many calories were in each food rather than having to click. Also where did calorie goals per meal go??

author: John Smith
text: I haven't used the app for ages so I don't know when they redesigned it but the new version is terrible. Before you could quickly and easily swipe between days and add things intuitively. Now changing days is very clunky and annoying, you can easily accidentally re add previous meals. The old design was much smoother to navigate and use.

author: Ricky
text: Is there seriously no way to move a food item over to a different day? That's just wild. I spent like ten minutes answering all the meal planning and profile questions just to be brought to a page saying, "Oh we can't upgrade you here. You have to go to the website." If I don't upgrade all of the progress of answering questions is lost?

author: Stephanie Anderson
text: What's also "new" is that the app is no longer allowing me to view my weekly Nutrition figures. PLEASE FIX. Hopefully this is not something that is now going to be yet another premium feature which used to be free :(

author: K Shaffer
text: I've had this app for nearly 10 years. and after whatever update was made, my experience took a nose dive. My 1200 daily calorie intake jumped to 1290. My husband's 2k calorie went to 1290 as well. It now won't even read Mapmywalk, which it has for years. I also deleted it an readded it in an attempt to fix it. to no avail.

author: shelly
text: Been using this app for ,6 years now. I don't like the new interface. it's so bad. All the food entries are not visible for the day. And it's difficult to enter new food . Please change it back. please.

author: Lygia Pampaka
text: The app was great but removing the ability to set the start date in the weekly nutrient/calorie view was unnecessary and makes it less functional as well as making it harder to track calories over weeks.

author: Kat Wiese
text: Great for macro tracking, not good for workouts: I wish this could integrate with Hevy and other apps, or I wish you could just input your workouts/calories burned without duplicating. There should be an import function.

author: Dan Indalow
text: New UI ruined simplicity and info at a glance ease. Now extra clicks have been added in order to beautify the UIA at a cost of added friction. The main goal of habit / log apps is to minimize friction for the user. 3740 days streak user. Considering swapping apps. - Can't swipe the diary to different days. Need to click at the top. Having one food item and X more isn't useful. - Can't glance at the entire day and scroll for info. Need to click each meal. Should be auto expandable. And more...

author: Julia Cocking
text: The new UI interface is terrible. I bought premium specifically so I could customize my dashboard to show ONLY protein, fiber and sugar. The new update took away this feature for no damn reason. Now I'm stuck with a year subscription. Willing to bet they've taken away these features so they can bring them back at an added cost. Corporate greed is disgusting.

author: Olga Shinalskaja
text: Great UI, easy to use. One suggestion would be to make a visual kg lost progression. Maybe a circle showing how much is lost and left, the same as calories. That is easier and more motivating than having to subtract manually.

author: Thomas Schjødt
text: The new diary view is a lot worse than the old one, there are a lot of added button presses to add food or get an overview of your day. Why collapse the different categories. Why when you want to add food is all my old logged food move to another menu

author: sam
text: 2026 edit: I've used this app for a decade in May, and it just got the worst UI update they could've possibly come up with. The diary was great, now I can't see all of my logged food on the basic layout or add it as simply as before. After a 3400+ day streak of logging in, I'm going to be uninstalling. There was nothing that needed to be changed, so frustrated. 2018: 655 days later, I still sign in every single day.

author: Lisa Smyth
text: Useful app but not a fan of the re-design. Is there a way to change back please? It's impossible to see your whole day's food log at a glance. when logging the button isn't noticible to add food. I have to go in separately to each meal (breakfast/lunch/dinner). I used to like completing my day to see prediction but it won't show unless I've added 1200 at least. this wasn't the case before. for example, now I have to find a remaining 17 calories worth of food just to see a prediction.

author: Bernadette K
text: Multi-year Premium subscription: I find this app much clunkier and user-unfriendly than it was previously. Even simple things like logging food are less visible, and making changes is harder. To add a food, there is a choice of private, friends only or public. It seems impossible to change this after setting it up. I chose private, as I wanted to test it out, but then I couldn't add in a recipe or meal... Nor could I change it to public. Definitely feel I am getting less for my money.

author: Charlie Thornton
text: After using this app for 4739 days, the latest "NEW MYFITNESSPAL" is a terrible change. Each item you enter doesn't stay in the order you enter it. Meal item times take on the entry time, and if you are altering the meal time, you have to edit the time for each item. It's not rocket science to know that all meal items will have been eaten at the same time. There is so much more I could complain about, but time and characters are running out. It is simply a terrible mess to a good app.

author: Solveig Felton
text: Why, oh why do app developpers keep changing the interface of their app, and when they do, they generally make it worse? Myfitnesspal is a case in point: The diary used to display all your logged foods under different meal headings, showing total calories per meal, and at the end any exercise completed. The new version lists the foods per meal, but no sum of calories per meal and you have to go to a different screen to see the exercise. Far less easy to keep track!

author: Bobby Popaz
text: I am extremely disappointed with the new app experience overall. It's not about "taking time to get used to", it's that the app's main focus, the food diary, has been ruined by being removed from its own tab, converted to a list of gigantic, space-consuming cards, and relegated behind a pointless "view all" button. There isn't a single time when I wouldn't want to view my entire diary at once - it's the only thing I'm interested in seeing when I open the app. At the very least, condense it!

author: Fiona Sansom
text: I do NOT like the new layout! I want to see at a glance what the meal was, not have to click to see the items! Bad design. Not happy!!! It is also too easy to hit the 'add previous days meal'. Then you have to laboriously delete each item singly (why can't you swipe to delete? You should at least be able to delete multiple items in one go. It is also to easy to find yourself deleting your history, not meal items.

author: Colm Tierney
text: Very poor user interface. clunky operation and, in some cases, just does not operate. takes a stupidly long time to input food/meals, which it shouldn't as the app is based on being hassle free. saving meals is potluck if it will actually save them. The vast majority of nutrition information is incorrect, and even when you correct it, it still reverts to the incorrect option. dont bother going premium, as I did, and only use as a very rough guide of calorie intake as it's usually wrong.

author: James Baggott
text: I've been using the App for years. the latest update is a total reverse engineer in terms of simplicity, easy of use, and far more clicks to achieve adding daily food. I don't use meal planning or guides, I know what I want to eat and enter as I go. The process is a chore now for quick click data entry. stop over thinking problems that really aren't there.

author: sarah ware
text: Used to love mfp, have used it since 2010. I've seen it change so much over the years, and not for the best. Function after function put behind a paywall, the loss of the barcode scanner never sat well with me but this latest update is the final straw. It's barely usable! Terrible layout, no info at a glance. I'm off to look for alternative calorie apps!

author: Erin Donovan-Sharpe
text: Previously I rated the app 5 stars and have been using it happily for years. However, the current bug of the app not syncing with the online version is beyond frustrating! The web version is what syncs to other tracking platforms, and so I've been forced to switch to this instead of using the app. Searching for food on the website is frustrating, it's poorly set up for use on mobile and trying to add new foods can sometimes fail. Please fix this. It's been at least a month now!

author: JD GP
text: I'm joining the chorus of people complaining about the new interface. If you want to see what you ate, you now have to access each meal individually (or access the list with one extra, useless tap) because all it shows is one item + x more instead of the full list like before. No one asked for this. It's just making things more tedious for no reason. I don't mind the other changes so much but PLEASE, let me see the full list at a glance.

author: Mike Caprii
text: Update to now 23 April 2026.. Why is it, that someone in there decides let's update to our app and stuff it up. Each update becomes less usable. You just drive away customers. This is a perfect example. You want more money. $130 for one year. What a joke. I was using this app from the beginning so it's just another one I've watched slowly decline. I'd pay a reasonable amount to just have a simplified version with just the diary and nothing else. Like it used to be

author: Vanessa Praça-Correa
text: At first it was tricky to set up the definitions to get data from other sources, but it started to work well. Now, it’s a mess. Capturing activity and exercise data takes ages, it deletes data for no reason, and it duplicates, triples, and even quadruples meal entries on the same day and on previous days. I’ve spent hours deleting duplicate entries across 67 days out of the 72 I’ve been using the app. If these errors aren’t fixed, I won’t be renewing the subscription.

author: M P
text: Overnight the layout of the app changed completely. I cannot enter my diary as I did before. It's confusing. Nutrition view now defaults to a weekly summary rather than the daily view. It's frustrating as it removes our ability to easily see our present daily macros and calories while logging, leading to mistakes. Creating recipes and trying to edit them is another nightmare. I doubles ingredients, can't edit, wrong nutritional values. What happened to My Fitness Pal? Used to be good.

author: Stephen Wood
text: This app was a decent app to track. it was visually easy to use and you knew exactly where you were at a glance from the home screen. They have recently updated it and it has gone backwards in my eyes. Tracking is harder to understand and the weight and exercise parts are all now individual parts that you click on but gives you as much useful information as a blank piece of paper. In today's fast paced environment when you literally want to enter, review and go is now hard work. Please revert!

author: Kent Yousif
text: I've had non stop issues for years. I've also contacted support many times as well and issues never get solved. I've been a paying customer or 4+ years. EDIT: I reached out and it's been a month and a half of not being able to sync from my phone. What's the point? They won't extend subscription despite it being on their end and awknowledging it. 0/5 stars. Requesting partial refund from Google since they won't even extend the subscription for the time lost (currently over 45 days)

author: Nicholas Hutchings
text: The free version has been defeatured, and represents less value. I understand and support the need to charge, but the price point is to high to merit the cost. If you want to use this to help with weight loss, maybe you can justify the cost for the short term, but those of us who want to just track, see the impact of choices etc ... The cost is too high. Particularly in this changing world where expense matters.

author: Luke Whiting
text: This used to be the gold standard of diet logging but it's become a buggy, user hostile mess. Sync has been broken for 2 months now (Acknowledged as a "known issue" on their site) but no updates, no sign of a fix. I get constantly blocked and told to upgrade to premium when trying to scan a barcode (A free feature in the UK) only for it to work if I exit & go back in. The database is now littered with incorrect entries, entries missing pack or portion sizes. I just can't recommend it anymore.

author: Daniel
text: it's just a bad , clunky app. The home page should be the hub for me to quickly enter food and recipes, instead of having to navigate into 3 other menus. The UI is littered with premium features that are behind a pay wall, if you are strapped for cash, at least don't make it look so desperate guys. It struggles to get the data off my linked devices. I am uninstalling .

author: Zivile J
text: For years, I used FitnessPal, even for my prep competition, and never had an issue. So, since last year, I started to have issues for tracking my weekly calorie, macros intake. Also, before, I didn't have to scan the same product twice to record it; now I have to scan it everytime same product! Time Wasting! I've loved this app for years, and I wish it could be the same! But I have to find another app because I don't have time to wait for weeks to fix this. I still have to track my meals!

author: Mark Watson
text: I don't normally leave app reviews but the last update has made the app so much harder to use. Everything takes more clicks to get to the same places as it did before. You also can't see what you've eaten for your meals at a glance without having to open each, where as before you could swipe between days and see at a glance. Now you can't swipe between days. Logging water intake it's now multiple clicks too and so is looking at your nutrients. It's far less user friendly than before

author: Chris Harvey
text: In my opinion the latest app update on Android has made it worse and less user friendly. I can no longer see the food that I've consumed for a day in one screen. I cannot delete individual meals from a day, I cannot change the order in which the foods list in my meals, it's very irritating. I think that it's still the best free app that I can find but that it's poorer after the update.

author: Darren W
text: Since starting to use this app this year, I have lost almost all my logged food entries. While the app shows it syncs successfully, this was not true. I discovered this purely by chance, when on their website, and saw no entries in my Food Diary. I reset the app, it worked for 2 days, then again stopped syncing. Their support isn't helpful, and told me I should log my food through the website to ensure it is saved to my diary. This defeats the point of having an app to do it!

author: Mike
text: Archaic interface and unreliable. I tried a couple of calorie counters and they were excellent, quick to use and add food to. I used MyFitnessPal many years ago and it hasn't changed. Slow, clunky interface, thousands of badly entered foods, US measurements come first, their approved foods aren't reliable for nutritional values and the occasional crash makes using it a painful experience. Update: there's a new look, with an increased number of taps to log food. 🤦🏼‍♂️

author: Colin
text: Update: provided feedback to their support and got a 'read our FAQ' response. The app is trash. Download Cronometer instead, other MFP users are moving to there. Wow way to ruin your app with the latest update. The calorie/fat/protein trackers are so small you can't even notice if you're making progress. Also, having to click on a meal to now see what you log in your diary, and then having to scroll the list several times just makes it more labour intensive to use this app.

author: Sam Mawson
text: The recent update to the UI has made me go elsewhere for calorie tracking, I've been using this app for years and never had an issue. Some of these changes are minor like no longer being able to change the start of the week, considering that you used to be able to I don't understand why these kinds of things are removed. I'm not a fan of how the main page and diary have merged and the constant mistakes of adding yesterday's food because of a misclick is incredibly frustrating.

author: Genevieve Beauchamp
text: It's a good app to track calories, I have been using it for years -- HOWEVER, be sure to check the labels even when you scan the item. LOTS of items have erroneous nutritional info even when it says 'verified' (green check mark). Also the new interface is very impractical, and I am very disappointed with the changes! 🥺🥺🥺

author: Robert Warnock
text: Why change the interface??? It was great, now it's rubbish, confusing, not so simple, overwhelming... Finally upgraded to pro at the start of the year and this has annoyed me!!! For something that helps such a huge range of people getting something so difficult and overwhelming under control, you've now buggered that and it feels like change for the sake of changing something. Hate it. You could've put the time into improving the barcode reader and other bits that were already there.

author: Jason Willier
text: I'm joining the club on this latest update being bad. My daily calories randomly changed, allowing me 500 extra calories out of nowhere for the same targets I had pre-update. That doesn't make any sense at all and will likely give people improper results, which would be extremely frustrating if you're relying on the app to help you with your weight goals. Interface is bloated and difficult to navigate. Hopefully it gets revamped or reverted back soon!

author: Karen Ng
text: I prefer the old UI. I like the copy meal from yesterday and copy to feature, but having to perform multiple taps before getting to see how much calories for each meal is troublesome. I prefer to see all meals for each day like before,in a single pane of glass. Nutrition macros can be hidden until I need to see it, which I don't mind more taps to get to it.

author: N O
text: I used to love this app,now they have destroyed it. You can no longer look at net calories for the past week as of today's date, which is a critical function for anyone who is tracking calories since overall consistency is the most important thing. You now have to delete items one by one instead of the bulk checkbox way before. You can't properly tell which day you're on. Very disappointing. After 2,273 days streak of using myfitnesspal I will have to move on to a different app! Very sad!

author: Laura Kendall
text: The new version of the app is a step backwards in my opinion. You can no longer move foods from one meal to another on the same day, the exercise section provides less information - it used to show you which app the info had come from (i.e. strava or garmin) but no longer does - and you can no longer see all your foods for the day in one list - you now have to go into one meal then come out of it and go into another meal to see individual foods. This has made the app much less user friendly.

author: David Ryan
text: I'm a pro user. The new UI is visually nice but 95% of the complaints would be solved if they just put the entire diary in a single view instead of having to click into individual meals. And reimplementing basic features like moving an entry from one meal to another via long press. I don't want to have to click into the entry (especially now that it's 2 levels deep) to change what meal it's assigned to. I want to move it to another meal when I can see both meals, for planning purposes. Obv 🤦‍♂️

author: Cecily Johnson
text: As a user for well over a decade I had to come and update my review from 5 stars to 1. I only wish it could be zero. This UI update is a complete disaster, removing functionality like swiping left & right to change days and making simple logging take more clicks than before. It is easy to accidentally tap "add yesterday's meal" (which is much larger and more central than the "log" button) forcing you to delete each item individually afterwards. Every part of the app has become painful to use.

author: Raegan Kilpatrick
text: The new update is awful! I hate the layout of the new diary, it's too big yet shows less than the last version. It's too hard to see your daily food choice progress. I loved how you could focus on how well you were doing that day, using the blue curved tracker. It's harder to clearly track protein/fiber/calories. All around, dislike the entire app layout now. I've used MFP for years and I hate to say it but I'm thinking of trying out a different app. I used to recommend it, not anymore sadly.

author: Lee Farrow
text: Edit#3. I've had to come back and change my review after a series of updates that introduced new 'features'. The last bugs were surmountable but this latest complete overhaul of the interface is absolutely hateful. if anything is going to break my 10 year streak and try teamrh instead then it might be this, I'll give it a while to see if I can get used to it or find an older version but I doubt either of those would work.

author: Kim Emberson
text: App is mostly good for logging calories etc. and have been using it for a long time however over the last few months my other half and I are no longer able to see each other's diaries as there is an issue with the app loading to the main website. This is super inconvenient for us as we often copy meals over, we now aren't able to track macros without spending a long time both scanning. There seems to be a real lack of urgency in fixing the issue of Android app not loading to their servers..

author: Shamindra Costa
text: I've been using this app since 2012, however I'm not satisfied with the new user interface with the latest update. I can no longer see all my diary entries for the day on a single pages, I have to tap into each meal. There are now too many steps to log food and exercise. I don't want to see things like water and steps on the main diary pages but I don't have the option to edit the content of the page. I cant easily switch days by swiping left and right but have to select a date from a calendar.

author: Michelle Thompson
text: April '26 - the update is over complicated. Now missing key features I used in every entry, all used to be in the diary page and now scattered in multiple tabs. In addition to the normal 3 macros, I kept tabs on my fibre intake which I had set up on the dashboard along with the macros, and when you flipped your phone you could also view other important nutrition. Can't now. I loved having the nutritional pie atop the diary page with macros percentages. It's now gone. It was perfect before!

author: Beth Jones
text: After the update, my calories keep randomly changing across months of tracking. The help desk just said that I had to delete the incorrect ones manually but that's almost impossible considering how many they are! my daily calorie totals are also wrong. I've been a MyfitnessPal user for over 5 years, premium for most of that, and I would have continued a lot longer if it wasn't now plagued with bugs.

author: Paulius Valinskas
text: Edit: CAN'T LOGIN! Protein total for the day is different in 3 different places now. I can't seem to be able to delete or copy individual or multiple selected foods to other days anymore... this makes the app basically useless to me now! Also, the most recently edited foods no longer go to the bottom of a meal, which makes them hard to find. Only improvement is the ability to copy more than 2 days forward/backward

author: C G
text: The new update / new interface is awful! I've been using this app for more than 10yrs. Since their update all my history is gone, despite being on a 99 day streak. Even yesterday's log is gone! Too many clicks now to see your diary entries. Also no more weight projection when you complete the diary, no warning for logging under 1000 calories. Emailed support, suggested option of users having "classic view" but they said not possible. How about make sure your update works before rolling out.

author: Raising.my.miracles Andrea
