text: the free version is pretty good for the most part however there are a few inconsistencies. I'm doing keto atm and some foods are showing higher carb count than what's on the packaging. It's making it very hard to track accurately. Also none of my devices sync up as a Samsung user so it doesn't register my steps or exercise. It's pretty good for a free app but I wouldn't pay for the full version knowing these faults.

author: Dee Neru
text: I've had this app for about 5 years. It's easy to use, has plenty of functions and that's not even having the premium package. it's great to track daily eating habits as well as keeping you (and only you) accountable to reach your goals whatever they are. The notifications are great for times when you forget to track. Easy setup with phones/watches so logs your workouts, walks, hikes, bikes whatever and adds to your daily calories/daily expenditure. awesome for beginners all the way to advanced

author: Barry Udall
text: Love MFP for tracking. Hate the updated layout of the app. Stop changing things for the sake of changing things, it's almost like a need to justify the existence of certain roles. As bad as going to the supermarket and needing to familiarise yourself with the location of all the produce again even though there was nothing wrong with where it was 🙄

author: Csilla Marton
text: The latest update is just rubbish. it's not easy to see which day you're logging the meals for, what you logged already. I so much preferred the previous version, where everything was so much more transparent and easy to follow. I considered stopping logging because it's just a big chaos, double checking dates, synched activities, meals etc. I don't know who came up with this version but they're definitely not logging their meals. Unusable zero star

author: Vicki O'Regan
text: Previously a premium user, but only when on offer because at full price, its far too expensive. Recent updates have now made this awful to use so now looking for other alternatives. Lack of barcode scanning means that searching through the millions of entries for food is exhausting and nearly impossible to get right. UX is clunky and all exercises from samsung watch is duplicated. Calories left in allowance also changes randomly, which could lead to overeating against calorie goals.

author: Mark Midolla
text: Latest update as of Apr 23, 2026. It now requires more clicks to do anything, including adding food and copying food from another day. You can no longer simply swipe back and forth between days to copy a meal from. You have to use the top bar to select a specific date, but you dont know which day you need to pick as you cant see the meals there. Even the current day only shows you a summary of each meal. Interface is a major downgrade for usability.

author: Maria Llinares
text: Most recent update is an awful experience. The full daily diary view has gone, you cannot toggle easily between days of the week for comparison and the days of the week and sometimes the date are not visible on each screen meaning you can easily track foods to the wrong day/date. In addition the layout of data and the inaccessibility of the text makes it really hard to use and get an overview of what you have tracked. The option to go back to the old version is not available.

author: Jonathan Bastin
text: It serves a purpose for logging your foods. it would be useful that when searching for food items that you can search on cal per 100g. seems some of this mass produced stuff varies between countries. The main complaint I have right now is back in late Jan there was an update that broke app > website sync. Website > App works. This brakes syncing with 3rd party integration and also means any data from the app can be lost easily. I can't believe 2 months later still broken.

author: Tash Tovey
text: was a great app, until the new update. the UI is horrible and not a good experience to use at all. I hate not seeing all the foods logged for a meal, it's hard to delete meals you've logged accidentally, the overview of calories is less legible than before - to just name a few things. I wish there was a way to choose to use the old UI.

author: Matt
text: NOBODY WANTS THIS. Absolutely awful UI update. Previously the app was streamlined, data readily visible, fast and efficient. Ridiculous that now that basic functions seemed locked behind additionalsteps. Example 1: I can no longer swipe left and right to go back and forth through days. I have to repeatedly use the picker at the top. PAINFUL. Example 2: Previously I can see everything I logged for every meal, all from the main screen. Now I see "Basmati rice and 4 more". THAT'S NO USE TO ANYONE.

author: Karl Jason Fajardo
text: App doesn't sync with the website. Also, there's an issue with projected weight loss. It's always the same projected weight loss for each day even though I am over or under my calorie limit. However, I found out that when I logged my food and exercises on the website, the projected weight loss is correct and food diary is syncing to the app correctly. It's just the other way around doesn't work where when I log my food nor exercises on the app it doesn't sync to the website.

author: Dominic O-T
text: New app UI is unusable. Layout makes no sense. Quick add calories really hard to find. First touch button for diary is to copy yesterday's meal. Diary, which is the whole point of the app, no longer has its own page. It's a mess. Every year this app gets worse but this is the final straw for me and I'm moving to another calorie counter.

author: Em
text: No barcode scanner anymore without premium plan (UK based). I'm not paying £15 a month for a barcode scanner, there are alternative much cheaper or free platforms I can use with a barcode scanner. New update is awful and experiencing issues with the database recently. Me and my partner diary share which we can't do anymore, we've deleted and created new accounts which works for a day or two and then stops working again. Deleted my account and I'll be finding an alternative.

author: Jean-Pierre Victor
text: The new update is a bit disappointing. No more bulk delete food items, have to go one by one. Cant move items from breakfast to lunch or dinner or to another date. The only feature it really need was to log food in atleast a whole week ahead for meal preppers. I prefer the older version but with 7 days options to move to, copy to. Not 3 days.

author: Christoph Locher
text: Not a fan of the new UI. Need to be able to swipe from day to day instead of swipe up and click the day. Also need to see the full day and add to breakfast, lunch or dinner without having to click into the individual meal. A full day overview that you can add to any meal was so more user friendly than having all the extra clicks/taps

author: Keith Smith
text: The new update has utterly destroyed the Ui experience. Logging food takes about 5x longer and is more cumbersome having to flip through multiple pages to log things into each meal. I can no longer swipe between days, I have to open the calendar, select the day then press ok. I used to be able to log my food for a day in around a minute, by copy/pasting from day prior and tweaking things here and there. Now I have to press through like 15 different menus to do what took me seconds before.

author: Chris Hagman
text: It's ok for what it does. However, it does not sync to my Fitbit no matter how many times I try. So my diary is off. I'm glad the issue hasn't changed since 2013. it's 2021 now! Update... Well, it's 2024 and still having syncing issues with a different smart watch and supported apps. Good job, folks. update - 2026. same issue is here. Samsung health doesn't sync up to this app. steps are lost, meals don't always get added. even disconnected both apps and tried again.

author: J Matt
text: SO ANNOYED! I started using the free version of the app 8 weeks ago as I started a bootcamp. Things were going okay, then today the app logged me out. When I logged back in, ALL of my entries for the past 8 weeks have gone wrong. Some days the app has recorded me having 52,000 calories! Others 6, or 8,000! The app has added foods to days I certainly didn't eat them, or doubled, quadrupled or even more! Utterly useless 👎🏼🤬

author: Helen Matthews
text: I really like this app. It has not only made me eat more consciously, but I'm also more aware of how much water I drink, my snack intake, as well as the amount I am exercising and the benefits to this as it increases my calorie allowance. I would love a search bar on the discovery recipe section instead of or as well as, suggested headings. Sometimes, I have a specific ingredient I need to use and rather than scrolling through all the recipes before I find it, search would make it much easier

author: jonathan james
text: The recent update is simply dire. I've read the various reviews of the latest version and the responses from MFP. I've been a user for around 13 years, but the new version should simply never have happened. Seeing your meals on a day to day basis has become unbearably opaque. Just revert to the old version and pretend you never screwed it up like this.

author: ann page
text: Great app BUT the new interface is really unfriendly. fiddly to change between dates (no forward and back arrows to move between them) but even more frustrating is that you can no longer see your entire day's food logging on one screen: you have to click into the meal, at which point each food item is then so huge on the screen that you're endlessly scrolling if your meal has more than 3 or 4 components. please, please change it back!

author: Andrew Scott
text: Before the update this was extremely user friendly, now no more swiping to the next day, so many more actions required to achieve what used to be so simple where I never had an issue when needing to enter details, now I put off entering anything because if the work involved, my steps no longer sync from Garmin, that's a massive issue for me, I no longer rely on this for my calorie input/output, I'm actively looking elsewhere now, this has become too much like hard work.

author: Oliver Wiltshire
text: A truly abysmal step backwards for the user interface/experience. The full day used to be on a single page, the moment you opened the app. Input your food for each meal, scroll down for next meal, swipe between days. For some godforsaken reason, you now have to navigate through separate sub-menus for each meal, then exit sub-menus and scroll to the top, and change the day from a calendar. New users: from someone who's used the app for over 10 years, I recommend what I'm doing - find another app

author: Natalia Wrobel
text: I can't believe what a horrible job MFP did with the UI redesign. All in the name of AI? It's people who use your app, not AI! People who struggle with weight already have a hard time logging their food and you just made it harder by adding additional clicks and navigation to log or see anything. Wtaf were you thinking?! The whole point of UI is to make it more efficient and intuative for the user, not to serve AI. Figure out how to integrate without sacrificing the user experience! Braindead!

author: Kenneth Tierney
text: Been using this app daily for nearly two years now and has been fantastic in helping me keep on track as I lost the weight and now maintaining that weight loss. It would be four stars but after getting the update some of the functionality like copying a whole days food log or being able to select what I want to copy across all meals in one go to the next day has been removed and this is something I use everyday to simplify the whole process.

author: Li Aries
text: I absolutely hate the new UI.. This app used to work okay. It glitches from time to time while logging foods, which I had to close and reopen. But it shows your all the info you need at a glance. I used to be straightforward. Now I need to do several actions to navigate info that I used to be able to get in 1 click/scroll.

author: Bogbean19
text: *update. they stuck with their plan for the update and it's bloody useless. If I could get a refund on my premium I would. I cannot see any advantage to these changes nor any improvement since the initial version I saw. I have so many recipes etc saved but tough. I'll be out. March 2026 update is awful. Too big, much less data visible at a glance, more steps to delete an entry, definitely a backward step. Will look at alternatives even though I've paid and have about 10yrs data/recipes in it.

author: BrendaK
text: Was a happy paying customer until the horrible new user interface came about a month ago. I can't track my nutrients as easily anymore without having to click 3 buttons deep. Also, have to manually delete 1 food item at a time instead of being able to mass delete like before. Go back to the old user interface. Will unsubscribe soon if this keeps up.

author: Allison Crilly
text: Not a fan of the new update. Getting to my nutrition page takes extra clicks, why? This is 90% of what I'm paying for. Also I don't want to see the food I've previously logged under each meal, especially when that food was junk food, it's reminding me of food I'd rather be eating. I can't see the point of any of these changes

author: John Isaiah Carmona
text: Known bugs of custom meal duplicating still exist after years (and no way to delete it). Feature parity againts iOS version (missing upload to scan feature which is a dealbreaker for me as I cannot log airplane meals where there is no internet connection). Data syncing issue with health connect (steps are not getting synced, activities are duplicated). Otherwise pretty hefty database for foods (when it comes to macros, but micro-nutrients are usually ignored even for some with barcode foods).

author: Amanda Flood
text: EDIT: the new UI update has spoiled this app. What were you thinking, guys? It was clear and easy to use, now unclear and clunky, with meal items hidden and the font sizing too samey for any at-a-glance assessment. From 5 stars to 3 - please restore it. PREVIOUS: The food diary is great and the database has all foods including a huge number of branded ones. A great way to keep track of your intake. Plus little videos of healthy recipes and helpful tips. Really well thought through.

author: E Marriott
text: I'm not sure why an app that worked fine for so long has decided to redesign everything, but this change is a huge downgrade. Why doesn't the week start on Monday? Why is it more clicks to add multiple items to a meal? Why is it so easy to accidentally repeat a meal? Why is it harder to differentiate base calories and additional calories? I'm not sure I can find one thing that feels like an upgrade. After many years I am going to test alternative apps. This one is no longer good enough.

author: Carl Gillespie
text: Used for years, straight forward to use. Harder to use since update/look. Possibly a way to encourage people to pay for the premium service, & get the most out of it - and that's not a bad thing. Just not a fan of the new updated look, purely personal preference, maybe time will change that.I generally use it when I either have a diet were I need to either ensure I eat enough, or one when I try to make sure I don't eat too much. I've had both paid in the past and free generally. Both are great.

author: Keith Ryan
text: Premium subscriber. New version is annoying. Reducing score to 2. Increase size of text for total allowable calories and calories left. Can barely read it. Monday is the first day of the week for loads of people, not Sunday. Need a setting to change it. Why is relogging yesterday's meal so important and easy to accidentally do? Do you have data showing most people eat the same meal every day? I defo don't.

author: Lewis McLean
text: Used to be pretty good but made a LOT of unnecessary changes to the interface which makes it unusable. The key information isn't made clear like your calories over or under (in small pretty and greyed out) you can't delete full meals or move them now and the dashboard is useless tabs linking to premium features. To do anything you want to do, you now have to click multiple times and jump through hoops. Have now deleted the app along with countless others and moved to a competitor. Sad end.

author: Sam Arnold
text: I cannot express how awful the new update has made this app. It's like they've paid a consultant a bonus fee if they can reck it as much as possible. Shocking user experience, and the best part is there was little wrong with the older set up. It genuinely has to be AI, I refuse to believe anybody tested it and said "yeah, thats great".

author: Sandra Ballester
text: I've been using the paid version of this app for years and always gave it 5 stars, but the April 2026 update is truly awful. Like someone has deliberately vandalised it. I complained via a 2 star review and was encouraged to keep going, and I've tried, but honestly I just lose the will to live. I don't know which bit is worst, but not being able to move foods between meals must be one of the most frustrating things. I won't renew this subscription as I wouldn't even use it for free as it is now.

author: Anya Holgerson
text: the look in the newest update is TERRIBLE. it still 'works' but I may stop using it to find something better. The day completed button is hard to find. if you have 'fat fingers' it is too easy to hit copy meal on the main screen. The total calories available on the main screen is harder to view, adding water is too many touches compared to what it was, and the comment before you add water of 'you must be thristy' is undeeded. You show steps, but this is inaccurate as you cannot manually enter

author: Innessa Taylor
text: Love the barcode scanner and the really simple tracking - made life a lot easier. Meals is great too. A bit glitchy with linking steps (sometimes need to shut down and restart all apps and then reopen for the app to log updated steps. The weekly nutrition settings have stopped working and only show from Sunday, no matter what setting, which is annoying as makes it hard to know how you are progressing over the week and know whether you need to be more or can be less disciplined.

author: Steven Clark
text: The latest app deleted all of my previously logged data. My saved meals have remained but it's really frustrating that my recently added meals/foods are gone, as well as everything I have logged prior to the update. Also, my additional calories after exercise are no longer being added to my daily calorie allowance despite the fact I still have the app link to my Garmin app and the amended calories show correctly on the Garmin app.

author: LoLo
text: New UI is clunky and not compact. Taken out the feature where you can move a recipe via press hold. Now you have to go into the item menu to change it. And I liked seeing my default calorie goal. Now expenditure is calculated into your calorie intake just like Fitbit app, absolutely hate it. New bug: Recipe changes are not saved, tried clearing cache.

author: cd91x
text: I've used this app for years, but the new update is awful. you have took away years of muscle memory for people who log food which is now making it harder to log. the visuals are harder to get - why do i have to click to see my full meal and it doesn't just show me? the way the calories left for the day shows now is smaller and harder to see. PLEASE give users the opportunity to use the old interface. otherwise I am going to have to delete my account and I was so used to this one.

author: Rahul Patel
text: having a major issue with the sync for steps walked with Google fit. I read somewhere to try and uninstall and reinstall the app, which I did and it then synced at that moment. however the rest of the steps for the day have not. I tried the method again and no change. it's very frustrating for tracking purposes. I hope this bug could be fixed ASAP.

author: Tammy
text: It's a good way to track your calories and your exercise. your water intake. It does not talk to Google very well and it's very aggressive if you don't turn off it's notifications. it will harass you all day long until you put something into it. so make sure when you download it you turn off the notifications that way it's on your terms instead of on its terms. edit: 2 out of 5 stars is not a great review. did you even read this? sounds like you have a standard reply for everything.

author: David Gutnik
text: unfortunately I think this is the best app for meal tracking. one major issue they haven't fixed in 10 years, you can't filter your food results when searching. example I had a Tim Hortons almond milk late. you can't select the restaurant and filter the food. if I want to add a missing item it just goes into their mass random search with all the other junk. they need to have a 3 teir system. approved items, ones added by users, and

author: Ichigo Raein
text: Honestly this is the greatest app compared to others. The variety of food you can search for is insane. Cause i am from Malaysia, other apps don't have a lot of Malaysian food options. Even the AI function needs to pay for access. I am not having trouble searching the food i ate cause it will always be available to choose for calorie intake. Name it, nasi lemak, ayam masak merah, rendang, laksa etc. If you are Malaysian please download this app. Worth it!

author: Steve Brown
text: I'll tell you how bad your "update" is. I used to use it for free with its sync to Garmin. It's now so poor I've actually paid for Garmin Connect+. That's right, I'd rather use a paid calorie tracker than yours for free. Well done, give yourselves a pat on the back. Now read the AI generic nonsense response from MFP. Utter trash.

author: James
text: The recent redesign is not intuitive. I miss being able to swipe right or left to view previous daily entries. I also miss having the obvious button to complete my daily journal input. Even logging meals takes more clicks and messing around. I love the service the app provides but the latest changes are just absolutely frustrating and impossible. I have to click around and scroll up and down and it's just a pain to use. Upon reading the dev response - it wasn't broken, why make changes?!

author: Jamie Gibson
text: Simplify it like the old app, too many screens. Before it was simple add food and see what you have added clear and concise. Now you have go into another screen to see what you've added, then go back to add. too many clicks Why do developers always over complicate these things

author: Soph Kerry
text: Have loved this app for years and have been successful with it. Unfortunately, my progress pics haven't been saving recently. I can see them as soon as I take them but when I go to take one the week after the previous week had gone. really disappointing as this used to be a really helpful tool to spur me on.

author: Deena Lawson
text: Dropping the rating from 4 to 3 stars. The "upgrade" has made copyi g meals from one day to another so much more difficult than it was. If I'm copying Wednesday's breakfast to today, I used to go to Wednesday, copy the meal and it would default to the current day. NOW I have to copy the meal, designate a day and if I accidentally hit the wrong day, I have to go back to that wrong day and delete the components one by one and try again. please change that function back!

author: Aloke Das
text: The latest app update introduced a new user interface which is not nice at all. It has added too many extra clicks to make food entries and exercise. Even the overall calorie summary overview lacks clarity and simplicity. Why did you need to complicate things when it was working so well? Earlier you could clearly see the calorie impacts from food and how much of that is mitigated by exercise and then compare the final with my daily target. This simplicity is gone now in the new interface.

author: El Sh
text: I used to love this app. Recently i have started back into tracking again but suddenly I was booted out of the app. I logged back in and everything is different - and it is awful!! I now cant find features I was using. It is clunky and difficult to use now. I am very disappointed and will be looking for a new app to track with instead.

author: Poolé
text: Took away barcode scanner, Boo... Newest update changed the UI.. I intentionally selected the start of my week as Sunday because I want to see my weekly average, Not my last 7 day average, which you have now made the default....

author: Gina Pecotic
text: I am very unhappy with the new interface. I cannot see my entire lineup of meals throughout the day. I have to go into the meals to see what i have. I am unable to scroll across the week. I have to literally press the day I want to see. Seems unclear to me.

author: Emmy Lam
text: MFP has a great database of food. I appreciate the new UI updates with the cleaner and simpler UI. However I do find several tasks much harder to complete. The multi-select feature within meals is now gone, which makes any duplicate entries a pain to delete, since you need to select one by one. The option to copy single items within meals is also gone. The nutrient view when navigated to from a meal also defaults to a weekly view, which is odd, not sure if that's a bug.

author: Andy Li
text: Meal Scan needs a lot of work. The app does a great job if the only thing you eat is boxed meals with bar codes or had the time to insert every single ingredient.

author: Marie-Louise Johansson
text: the latest update made the diary view so much worse. it's a lot harder to get an overview of other things than the macros. before, I could track salt and fiber intake in the same view as the macros.. and now I have to go and search for it every time. 😑

author: Darren Perilli
text: After creating a meal, and then logging that meal, the meal does not transfer completely, missing ingredients and other ingredients incorrectly day 0 calories. Haven't received a response from support yet. So much for "premium support" with the membership...

author: enka cacka
text: broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke. and developer response to visit some generic site just proves how useless this is and lost cause. stay away dont waste time.

author: Danielle Powers
text: I like this app for consistent logging of meals and tracking exercise along with weight this is all free. there are extra things available if you want to pay for it. the free app is all I need. it counts your calories for you when you log your meals. I have not had any issues with this app technically or otherwise.

author: Alycia Davidson
text: you've completey cooked it with this update. I've used this app for over 10 years and its always been amazing. But this latest overhaul is terrible! why fix something that isn't broken? Its so much harder to use now...so stupid! The only reason I continue to use it is because I have literally 10 years of recipes and meals saved. Put it back to what it use to be...pleeeaasee!

author: Michael Shipma
text: What happened to this once fine app? Macros are one set of numbers on one page, a different set on another. Throws off the math to the point that it's useless. If the free version is like this, why would I risk a paid version?

author: Melissa Pepper
text: It's good except I can't find a way to turn off the streak notification. That notification actually discourages me a lot and it's ruining the experience for me. Pressing "I'm committed" every other day reminds me I'm not that committed.

author: Angelina Hand
text: Has stopped logging my food to the website, and my coach can't see what I'm tracking. I reinstalled the app and lost weeks of tracking - it didn't sync despite mfp saying this bug was fixed. It's still not syncing. 0 stars. Update following developer response: why does the website say 'Fixed in 25.41.0 if' this is not the case. You've caused me to lose my food data for weeks by reinstalling.

author: Sarah
text: One star because the new layout is absolutely horrible - been using MFP for years, its always been brilliant for its ease of use, calorie tracking was a breeze. I have to take in less than the recommend goal combined with a lot of exercise.

author: C McCausland

author: Cari Heffner

author: Annabel Nemmers
text: I do not use smart watches. I prefer to have this app sync to Samsung health. well it is absolutely useless and inconsistent about syncing. And it took half a dozen tickets to send it to Level 2, still no solution. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS APP'S PAID VERSION.

author: Anuj

author: Jeff
text: $80+ and this app can't track protein and fiber at the same time. It makes you choose only one :( Developer replied but missed my point completely. The app only offers 3 pre-determined sets of data on the diary dashboard, and none of them allows protein + fiber at the same time.

author: Felix Peng

author: Leah Thorne

author: Zeta Zdravecky

Why fix what was already great? PLEASE change it back.

author: Ben Hadaway
text: the new update automatically happens and it sucks. it's 4 clicks just to get to see all my good for the day. I used to just open app and see it all. I'm looking for another app. it was good while it lasted.

author: J M

WHY??

author: Shai Virani

I'll give it a bit to see if developers listen to feedback, otherwise, I'll be bidding farewell.

author: Denny Ayard
text: The new UI makes the Diary feature way more cumbersome. author: Anthony Walker

I didn't whine when you started charging Americans for the barcode scanner but this is fully unacceptable. Do better.

author: Tanya Love

author: Leanne MB

author: andrew burton

I will not be renewing now and will find a different app that enables me to line it up with my workout apps.

MFP responded to my complaint about it with a canned "get used to it" reply (adding that the old interface is gone for good). I will NOT be getting used to it. I will be spending my premium subscription money (and the money I spend for my family members' subscriptions) elsewhere. This one update is going to be the one that takes down MFP. (GOOGLE IT!!!)

author: Graham Blair
text: Update 06/05 - the UI has been updated to the latest version and it is awful. Case studies need to be written about the fall of myfitnesspal. Once the undisputed king of calorie counting. Now AI slop everywhere, features you pay for not even working, UI is unusable. So bad... so so bad Doesn't sync from android app to web. paid for premium and I have to use a non optimised website that's an absolute joke to add to my diary. Would consider an alternative if you're new to myfitnesspal

author: Margret Marie
text: .I used to really like this app. But this most recent update really sucks. i feel like it used to be user-friendly. And now I have to like go into each of my meals Separately instead of just adding it easier. So it's a lot more time consuming to get through the app. And it also just is not easy to navigate anymore.

author: Kirsty Goodier
text: The recent update is awful. Why would you change something that's been good for years?? You have to click more buttons to see all your logged food than before, the week starts on Sunday without an option to change. I'm going to find a new app after being with MFP for a decade.

author: Rodrigo Velasco
text: I've loved the app for a long time, but their recent update (April 2026) completely destroyed user experience, any action requires additional clicks, relevant info is hidden... I truly hope they revert the changes, otherwise I'll have to explore other options.

author: Jenna Martin
text: Used to be a great website/app that really stood out from competing diet tracking apps. Now it's glitchy. Scanning barcodes works 50% of the time on the first scan. Website no longer syncs with the app, requiring double logging. The quality has really gone down.

author: Tracie S
text: Very disappointed. This app used to be good. Now it's pretty much a paid app. And for some reason, it refuses to remember the password. So I changed it and once again it won't accept my password. Uninstalling and will find another less frustrating app to use.

author: Madison (fabmab)
text: 1) Weekly view now shows sunday - sat instead of the last 7 days. This is much less useful, especially since the calculations still consider the days that haven't happened yet. I see no way to return to the old view. 2) Why doesn't weekly view factor in bonus/lost calories from exercise/low activity? It means the math is entirely incorrect...? Edit: Wow I really miss the old UI, where I could see everything I've logged that day at once. It's so much less efficient now.

author: Kev K
text: The new version is terrible! The old UI was much better. This is not user friendly. for example, I keep hitting the log button on accident, then it adds all of the things for the same meal from the day before. It takes time for me to remove everything.

author: McKenzie Lloyd-Smith
text: Super buggy. Each time I toggle between the "Dashboard" and "Diary" tabs, nothing is displayed and I have to restart the app for anything to work. Crashes frequently. Despite this, I'm being asked to upgrade at a cost of $120 dollars, to use basic features. Crazy

author: Amy Nolan
text: I have been using the free version for years and always loved the app. Today when I logged in, I now have the new version. Its terrible, the layout, the look, everything and it is not at all as user friendly as the original version. Very dissappointing.

author: Stephen
text: Was good then updated. Can no longer add quick calories. Unimpressed. despite the dev response, I have no quick add option following their instructions- I simply can't add a quick add calorie sum as there is no option. No updates pending, never had the problem before.

author: Dylan Young
text: Big fumble, the latest update has made the app significantly worse, I can't see my food in the diary properly, "egg plus 5 other things". Hoping there is a version rollback fee drops as it's a much worse experience. Looks pretty universal that people are unhappy with the new look and feel too.

author: Ben Rowlands
text: bring back the old interface. why can't I see my whole diary view without clicking into each meal individually? the new UI is a strict downgrade, shows less information and requires more clicks to edit and view. you have made the product worse with no benefit, haven't seen a single user who is happy with this.

author: Les M
text: newest update makes the app almost unusable. I am unable to parse recipes, change them, or save them. all my entries from 2 days ago disappeared. Too many steps for logging. I don't know who developed this newest version but they should be fired.

author: Rach
text: The updated diary is awful. For me, as a diabetic, it was worth paying for the app but I'm actively looking for an alternative app. The new diary is so horribly laid out and I can't see the breakdown for each food in a meal. Bring back the old diary, this one sucks!

author: Andrea McOmber
text: MyFitnessPal just did a major overhaul on the main diary page. It's horrific. I can no longer quickly see my day's food. Everything now involves an extra step. I've used it for over 10 years and if they don't revert to the old one I'm leaving.

author: Amanda Hutchinson
text: The new update and layout are terrible. it wish I could give 0⭐️. Clunkier view, less information, more clicking. Can't opt to switch back to the old layout. I've used myfitnesspal for 15+ years, and used to get everyone I know on it! Now we are all deleting it, cancelling our subscriptions, and looking for a different tracking app. The app has been the same for years, worked great before. Don't know why they'd change it. Reddit community hates it too! Replacement app suggestions are welcome!

author: Christopher Moss
text: I like the update. It looks nice and modern. It takes a few moments to find you way around if you are used to the old layout. The only thing I miss is being able to decide which day your week starts. It makes a little difficult to keep track of things on a rolling week or starting on a Monday instead of a Sunday. If you could add that back it would be great!

author: Christina Gaudreau
text: It's a nice app, but what you have to pay for in a premium subscription was once free. Otherwise, it's a pretty comprehensive app for keeping track of nutrients, macros, etc. It's nice you can email and share with others.

author: Jonathan Sullivan
text: I've been using the app for a few years now, so far it has been good, but this recent UI update has made logging food more cumbersome. I like compartmentalization, but this has been more tedious than before, and I wish there was an option to go back to the old format.

author: Darcy Babutzke
text: The new UI is horrible, with way too many unnecessary clicks, hard to quickly locate important information. Would have thought the disastrous soft launch with quick rollback would have taught the devs and business owners a lesson, but apparently not. Will be researching a new app if this monstrosity does not get rolled back soon.

author: MSFTkiLRoy
text: Great app for tracking with a ton of integration in apps and devices. 3* because barcode scanning was removed and now locked behind a pay wall. There is also no family plan. I'm not going to pay $80 a year for every person in my house.

author: Liz Swenk
text: Do NOT like the new update. More steps to log food, the calorie count at the top includes the exercise counted in, instead of my daily goal. I want to ONLY see my daily goal, not include the total of exercise added in! Loved the app prior to yesterday.

author: mike shanks (Bungo jeez)
text: This app was great until the most recent update. Now the UI is super confusing and its hard AF to update and manage the food you log. If a dev reads this, you need to roll back to the previous version where the diary and food items are the first thing you see.

author: Jerry C
text: The latest app design that came out in March 2026 looks really different and not in a good way. It's change for change sake. It's disruptive and clearly not designed by people who use the app or who value a quick eye on the daily calorie total. The need for constant scrolling is just a waste of time. Why click once when you can click and scroll fifteen times? I am not a fan and after a 1,000 straight days of using the app I dread opening it now.

author: Rebecca Braun
text: This new update is awful. I've been using MFP for years... Like 10+ years. I can no longer easily see my daily food log. I don't want my week at a glance as a main feature. The "Today" tab should have the food log for that day.

author: Nicole Weeks
text: the latest update is horrible. Can't swipe from day to day anymore. Can't see the whole day's meals/food, only the first item. I remember when you could scan barcodes for free. Just annoying now to not be able to see your whole day in one screen.

author: Casey Smith
text: Over the years more and more features have been removed and locked behind premium, the UI is less intuitive than ever, and half the time it doesn't properly fetch info from tracking devices. App is no longer worth it since it's inundated with ads and convoluted.

author: Sara Burke
text: They overhauled the UI and it is terrible. My custom dashboard is gone, and flows have steps added. It's flip flopped between the old UI and the new one, which is extremely frustrating. The support team is AI forward, so don't bother. All this is such a shame because I've been using this app for more than a decade, and paying for premium the whole time. It's just not worth it. I broke my nearly 700 day streak and ditched MFP for something that actually works.

author: Matt Leach
text: Useful but some elements are a bit glitchy or poorly designed. Creating your own food is a nuisance, and the way it tracks water consumption is not great; it should automatically accumulate rather than the user having to calculate it with each entry.

author: Sarah Galos
text: Constantly, having the app log me out and losing all of my progress every time. I log back in, it's like I'm starting the app for the first time. All over again, very disappointing, especially when I paid for the premium.

author: Susan Thompson
text: New update to the app and now it's complete garbage. Hard to find foods, difficult to track, can't see the day or macros that I track. Don't bother with this. Was a great app that I paid for for years, now they're pushing AI slop.

author: David
text: There is beauty in simplicity - the MFP team did not get this memo, unfortunately, before tossing out this most recent update upon us. Look, I like where this is trying to go - but it isn't there yet, and you will never get users on side when you remove essentials like at-a-glance entire day tracking. The app requires streamlining. I have submitted constructive app feedback via the Support Form and I sincerely hope you take these on board, or potentially risk losing your user base.

author: Justin Grazioli
text: The new UI is a major downgrade. It takes so many taps to see data that was clearly visible before. the way it shows expended calories isn't as intuitive. Overall a major downgrade. They tried this a few months ago and rolled back the old UI due to backlash. I have moved on to Cronometer and it seems to do everything I liked about the old MyFitnessPal so I don't think I'll be returning to this app

author: Cherry
text: The new update takes the focus off the main features of the app- the food diary and calorie counting. I have been using the app for the last ten years intermittently and this is the first update that's totally ruined the experience, not just an adjustment, and is making me try others.

author: Lauren Crumrine
text: new app is so difficult to use. I never give ratings and needed to add one begging for the old version back. I can't see the full day all at once and quickly add things or copy meals from other days. I may cancel premium subscription.

author: Gwen Prebish
text: I was using this app daily for almost a year. Recently, they have done an update which has changed the format and I'm so unhappy about it. I think it was much more user friendly before and unfortunately I don't find myself using it as consistently anymore ☹️

author: Khadijah
text: Excellent when you search by barcode.. it was very stupid if you use image recognition to see what inside your plate, it will miss most of the ingredients. If it were cooked meals, not salad, it definitely would not recognize the dish. "voice Option" was the worst if your mother tongue is not English.

author: Scott Carpenter
text: New app update is disastrous. So much friction added. Can't view all food items on main daily diary screen. Can no longer swipe left/right between days. Much harder to get weekly calorie total/averages, etc. I will be finding a new tracker app.

author: dagan Smud
text: This app is a great way to help change bad eating habits. It is easy to forget something you ate for breakfast if you have higher priorities in a daily lifestyle and for people who dont count calories, this truly helps track your daily diet and can change your ways into eating healthier. it opened my eyes to my bad eating habits

author: Kyli Foulger
text: I've been using since 2011 and have always liked how a click on the diary shows what I've eaten that day. This latest update requires you to click the individual meal to see what foods you logged so you can't see it all on one page

author: Victoria Duncan
text: The latest update has made this really hard to use. I can't swipe through my diary anymore. The large text means I can't see much on one screen - more annoying scrolling. One click copy to today is gone. Everything is just harder to use. I've used this app for many years, and seen many interface changes. This is the first time it's been so bad I needed to comment.

author: Lauren Hassett
text: The latest update (April 2026) is absolutely horrid. It now takes several additional clicks to log items, find macro data, and exercise impact. The layout is not intuitive at all. The functionality is still there but I'm most likely done with MFP.

author: Matthew Holder
text: I've used the app for years. Please undo the recent interface changes. It was better before. There's no way to copy a whole day of food from one day to another. And it looks like you can't even copy meals once a day has passed. ☹️

author: Amber Hernandez
text: had this app for years but now all the features that I could really use to log are all starting to become premium items. Its already hard to afford to keep healthy. Now I'm expected to may pay more to do so. its beyond ridiculous. Have to find a different solution now. Uninstalling This app soon.

author: Dale Brookes
text: The new update is just awful. Hiding information behind extra clicks that used to be on a single screen and having much less intuitive navigation means I have now started looking at alternative apps. This used to be perfect for my needs but now just feels awkward and less helpful.

author: Daniel Gamble
text: Works very well. Tracks everything you need to nutritionwise. The only miss is it needs a way to manually enter daily steps. Connected trackers are not accurate, and would not update/sync correctly. A manual entry option would have got you 5 stars.

author: sydney lerums
text: most of the foods are the incorrect macros and you have to now pay for a lot of the features that used to be included like scanning barcodes. The 'create a meal' is a good feature and being able to save foods that you adjusted the macros on.

author: Barbara H
text: Been using this app for nearly 12 years so it's obviously something I find useful. It's not perfect. I didn't appreciate when they removed the scanning feature to premium members only. The most recent update however is not syncing up from phone to computer which is extremely frustrating.

author: Anna S
text: awful UI update, you can't even copy specific items from one day to the next anymore you have to copy all of a meal and then delete the pieces you don't need. we need an option to go back to the old UI because I wont be using it if it stays like this

author: The Young Homesteaders
text: let me be clear this used to be a 5 star app I used everyday but then they took basically all functionality and put it in premium, I don't expect yall to work for free but stop taking basic functions away to make them paid. if u want to use premium then this is the app for your calorie and macro tracking hands down but on basic they have stripped it to the bones.

author: Shawn Dru Colony
text: works well. easy to use because it remembers your most entered foods. not the best for net carb tracking.

author: Conner Leahy
text: They've gotten rid of the diary button and added a plan button instead, the problem is you have to pay even extra for the plans, so not only have they made it harder to find my diary they've now added a button that is essentially useless unless you pay more, this is terrible. please revert back to before the update

author: Ravi Shanghavi
text: New layout is garbage, can't easily see meal totals or all macros per item in the main view. This is the worst update in a software I've ever seen Edit: you now have to click each meal. ex Breakfast to see the logged items and their macros. WHY? why is there only a single rolled up total. Add back a more verbose list

author: Tracy Ray
text: ohmygosh. What happened to the app? It’s become impossible to use. You can't easily navigate your b,l,d, meals without accidentally replicating a previous meal. you can't see an individual meal, only view all, with everything jumbled. ugh. please change it back.

author: Jeanne McCumpsey
text: Why have you done this? I have very happily used this for many, many years. Now it is very user UNfriendly. It wasn't broken, why "fix" it so everything is difficult to find and enter without going through so many steps that it's easy to get lost? Update: After reading replies to my and many other dissatisfied reviews, it is obvious the company will ignore current customers and will push ahead with the new format. I have found another app and sadly canceled my subscription to MyFitness Pal.

author: Alex
text: I like the App and use it daily but after the new update and change to the diary I'm finding it frustrating to have to click "View all" under the diary categories instead of just seeing everything the way it was before. I don't understand why this change was made. If it ever gets fixed I'll change my review to reflect that.

author: Audra C
text: I used this app about 5 years ago and recently came back to it. I can't believe that the scan barcode feature is now a premium thing. that made logging food so much easier. until I'm able to find another extensive app, I'll guess I'll continue using this one for now

author: JASON DE FIVE - JD5
text: 6 Feb 2026 Wish the app can connect to more Fitness apps like Mi fitness, Huawei Fit & more. It would be helpful if the sync fits it. 15 Apr 2026 The sync of the app currently only option to connect to is health connect by android, experience lag and delay of app sync. At times notable water tracking intake lost it's data.

author: Ashley Noble
text: the new update is HORRIBLE. so many clicks to enter something, confusing design, i cant see my daily meals on all one page which made it super easy. i had this update for one day a while ago and it reverted back thankfully, is there anyway to allow us to use the old version if we choose? I might have to switch apps if this is what it is going to look like moving forward :/

author: Francesca Francesca
text: awful new update. have been a consistent user for 12 years and now I'm forced to find another app. the inability to see my full diary in one go is a deal breaker. things that used to take one click now take 4. whoever okayed the new UI, sorry but I hope your pillow is warm on both sides. RIP to what was previously an amazing app

author: Colin Matthew
text: So there's a new update that redesigned the UI. now things take longer to log (more taps) and it's not as easy to find the data you want (why do I have to scroll down and tap to see my day's exercise details?). Yes, it looks cleaner which is nice. But it's not very user friendly. If I can make one request, give me the option to change days with a simple tap/swipe on the main screen. I don't want to tap Today in the upper corner, tap the day I want to see, then tap OK. Three extra taps. Why?

author: V S
text: I’ve used this app consistently for nearly 10 years and, until recently, it was excellent—simple, efficient, and genuinely useful for tracking nutrition. Unfortunately, the latest UI update significantly undermines its core function. The ability to review daily intake at a glance has been lost. Previously, I could see all meals (breakfast, lunch,etc) and their nutritional breakdown on a single screen. Now, I’m forced to click into each section individually, which adds friction and detracts.

author: William Haynes
text: A pointless update to food logging, instead of being able to copy meals in one easy step (as previously) you now have to go into each individual meal section to copy and carry over, the ease of scrolling between days is also gone replaced by the idiotic need to have to select the individual day at the top of the app to access the data which is slow and frustrating - surely the idea of an update is to improve user interaction rather than detract from it.

author: Thomas Bonse
text: April '26 version 26.14.0, the changed UX is complete garbage. I've been a paid user for years and the usability keeps going down. First was the removal of multi-add and a few other nice features. Now in 2026, at least two of the 'updates' have made logging more difficult. Earlier, it was the partial breaking of updating times. Now updating timestamps can't be done as a group and even after updating individual item timestamps to be a new (and same time) this update isn't reflected in the parent.

author: Kari Coones
text: I'm loving the app but I work 3rd shift and it would be awesome if there was a "night shift" mode we can switch to where your numbers run from noon until noon instead of midnight to midnight. For me my breakfast is around 7pm midnight is like my noon. my fitness pal clears and starts all over at midnight and my day has just began. sometimes I just save what I ate before midnight and track it after midnight but that just another thing to remember to do that makes it more complicated.

author: C R
text: I like the app, but the recent change of the nutrients window where it shows weekly values instead of daily values by default is annoying. I'm not interested in how many carbs/proteins/fats I ate in a week. I'm trying to see what I have consumed in the day.

author: John Chandler
text: Trying to get in shape for my big 3 month trip to south east asia. I don’t just want to feel good I also want to look good. So I’m hitting the gym, signed up for some workout apps and will start tracking macros again. My Fitness Pal has always been my go-to, works great, well structured and they always keep it updated

author: E C
text: They just RUINED the app with this new update!! I have been using this app contentedly for more than a decade, even paying for the premium features. The latest update completely changed the look of the app and made it almost unusable. I have asked Google for a refund, and you should look elsewhere for a calorie counter.

author: Damon Petite
text: I was super annoyed by MealPlanner. I answered questions across like 10 different screens only to hit a paywall at the very end. I already pay for the app. Why would I pay even more for a feature I haven’t been able to try yet? The MealPlanner icon also takes up a huge amount of space in the app for what is basically a premium “Plus” upsell. Feels like every subscription app is now trying to layer a 2nd subscription on top of the first sub. Hopefully this “Premium Plus” trend end soon.

author: Kim Bradshaw
text: Two days in and I hate the new UI. I've been using myFitnessPal since 2019 to track meals. This update makes it way more time consuming to copy a previous day's meals and to adjust meals to hit macro goals. Hate it enough to look for another app or just use Excel/Sheets.

author: V Winchester (V)
text: the new interface looks nice, will take a bit of getting used to. I just hope you guys finally fixed the notifications

author: Kate Welter
text: Changed my review from 5 stars to 1 (April 28, 2026). I've used this app for 15 years and my husband and I LOVED IT. We created recipes and were able to share and both track them. The new version is horrible and I have reached out to support with a response but nothing they recommended worked. Randomly one day my diary is no linger visible to my husband. MFP support said it's an android bug. We both canceled our premium memberships and are considering different apps. BRING BACK THE OLD VERSION!

author: bugra
text: Best database I have seen so far, but the UI design is a bit clunky. There is no way to select multiple entries to copy, delete etc. The copy from yesterday button is really obstructive and I accidentally keep pressing it. Hopefully the are still figuring out the new UI and can address these issues.

author: Tamara
text: New Update is an unfortunate setback for convenience. Please bring back the diary where you can see everything easily without multiple clicks. This app is supposed to make tracking food easy for busy people. I will keep a hopeful eye out for an update that will fix the new diary's interface!

author: Pat Stewart
text: I'm changing my review from 4 stars to 1. I wish I could give 0. The latest update is terrible. I have to go through 2 screens now just to log water. The previous dashboard was much better. Who thought this was a better layout? I regret renewing my premium membership. My husband just upgraded to premium yesterday & he regrets it as well. Why couldn't you leave well enough alone??

author: Erin N.
text: Latest update is straight garbage. Loved the free version and HATE that it's been so limited to force a subscription. Ok, so perhaps an overreaction on my part. I appreciate the response because everything seems so wildly unfamiliar now, but now I see that it's still there. Rating changed. It's definitely going to take time to adjust to it. Still not sure I like it, but maybe I'm just an old batty broad whose set in my ways.

author: Erin Karl
text: I have been using this app for YEARS. I have recommended it to numerous people because it has, by far, been the best app to track food, calories, macros, exercise, etc. I cannot believe how awful this new update is. It's literally unusable now.

author: Jason Herold
text: Nothing but sync issues over and over again. I spend time fixing sync issues, get it fixed only to have to do it all over again a few weeks later. this last sync issue has proved impossible to resolve an I am done wasting hours resolving sync issues over and over. Good by and good riddance MFP.

author: Walter Kain
text: The app used to sync seamlessly with my other fitness and tracking apps. Since the update it doesn't sync at all. Troubleshooting has done nothing but make the problems worse and the MFP customer service ai is useless to help. Why update a perfectly serviceable app to make it worse?

author: Piotr Wysocki
text: in 2017 this app was great, now it cannot even start. It is stuck at ˝please wait˝ loading screen. It took a while of struggle to make it work, but enabling Garmin premium subscription disabled integration with this app and removed saved data from Garmin. Note: this app is far superior to Garmin's attempt to measure food calories.

author: Laura Allen
text: Really useful for tracking calories and workouts. Makes you more mindful of empty beer calories. Syncs with garmin instinct watch to automatically log tracked run / workout. Haven't used pro macros breakdown but probably will - really well made and maintained app.

author: Henry Hole
text: Recently tried to use again, very buggy. stays stuck on the loading screen when opening the app, requiring a full re-install to login but then the same frozen screen on the 2nd login. Bug prevents logging any food when on the screen. A shame because it used to work mich better.

author: Michael Birk
text: Talk about snatching defeat from victory. The new user interface is ridiculously clunky. Where you used to be able to swipe through days and visually see what you eat for breakfast etc. as you scrolled looking for a meal to copy into today (a great shortcut feature), you now have to guess by choosing a date on a calendar. Took me a ridiculously longer amount of time to do something that usually took seconds. Has whoever redesigned this interface actually used the app. Please roll back!!!

author: Georgia Marshall
text: To your response - the FAQ page is blank! What in the hell is this new layout update??? AWFUL!!! Can't find anything, meals condensed, can't see anything at a glance in diary, please provide option to go back to previous version!!! won't be renewing subscription, looking for alternatives...

author: Christie B
text: The most recent release in April 2026 is not calculating calories correctly from the macros. The calories are consistently low. This needs to be fixed ASAP! The new design took some getting used to, but I am liking it.

author: Rob (Stardarker)
text: Came back to myfitnesspal after some time away. What happened? its got way too complicated. The user food/calories selections has weird calories entered. I used to be able to just open the app. search for food or scan, then update.

author: Darrell Van Meter
text: Over 10 year user and this is the first time it's been anything other than 4-5 stars. The UI update focused on appearance rather than function. Every task now takes at least an extra step, sometimes more. There is a severe disconnect between the users and developers.

author: Suze Quartafeira
text: the app does not synch with server on Android. already deleted and reinstalled app several times. after a few days it goes back to the same issue. really annoying that is that buggy. it could be such a wonderful app with a big global food database but this issue is really problematic.

author: Natalia
text: I really like the changes to the app! Takes some getting used to but it's sleeker and easier to get key info. I like the easy copy from the previous day's meals. I would like the option to add Fiber to the Nutrient summary. I know it's not a Macro, but it's important for my diet.

author: David
text: useful.forntracking and recording calorie intake. barcode scanner is also very useful

author: Ruth Farrell
text: New upgrade = downgrade I've been using this app for probably over 10 years, on and off. it was simple to use with the daily diary easy to see. The new update is horrendous, far more steps to log things. It is making me not want to use it. Please reverse this upgrade. I'm now looking into using other similar apps as this one is just too much of a faff now.

author: Julie Hamlin
text: New Today app interface is major downgrade for loyal users. Huge bubble interface that requires lots of scrolling to view your day, which is super amateurish. It also doesn't provide a calorie breakdown by meal, which for fitness users is a huge oversight. They clearly don't know or don't care about their audience and offer no option to revert back to the old view.

author: Kevin Gundry
text: I started using this app after it was recommended to me Once It was setup for my diet, I was able to accurately track my carbs, fat and protein I lost 25kg in 4 months through diet and 30 minutes a day walking so if you sitting on the fence, don't hesitate, just do it, I love it so much that I bought the premium version, and carry on tracking daily.

author: Broden M
text: I normally dont leave reviews, but this update to the interface was so bad that i had to. My fitness pal is already one of the ugliest and clunkiest food tracking apps out there and this update made it borderline unusable. Their attempt to put everything all on one page has made it absolutely unintelligible. My fitness pal is focusing on fixing the wrong issues and I would recommend one of the many other apps over this.

author: A Google user
text: Hate the redesign... the app is great, however the new layout redesign and layout is horrible. You definitely do not get as much information displayed on the screen that you used to. It really feels off. If you are gonna change the layout then at least give us the option to pick and choose the layout design and fonts... I've been using this for years and it no longer feels informative (at least on a mobile phone screen). I think I may switch to the Samsung Health app instead... such a shame.

author: Megan Henry
text: this new update stinks. in addition, Android doesn't sync to their website so your progress is gone if you uninstall. I emailed and they told me to LOG MY FOOD ON THE DESKTOP WEBSITE. really?!?!? I pay $75+ per year and that's your suggestion? Who the heck is actually doing that on their day to day? ive had MFP for years with an insane streak but I'm so annoyed by this that I'm considering switching apps and losing my streak lol

author: jose acevedo
