It was perfect as it was but now it looks so hard to navigate in, the layout does not make sense at all. one of the wors updates I have ever seen. Its such a shame, as this has always been by far the best app I used.

author: Lukasz Maresz
text: was absolutely fine until they decided to completely change the look, used to have all my food items visible on the main page, not anymore. They also managed to wipe all my recent foods so now I'm having to scan everything again.

author: Fraser Bissett
text: Been having issues for well over a month now where the app will not sync, cannot share meals with my partner because of it. This also means it's not syncing to my PT app. paying for premium subscription and receiving budget service.

author: Alishia Fox
text: user since 2015, I used to LOVE this app and have steered so many to use it, but WHAT is going ON with your updates!?!?!?! I've uninstalled it twice in the last 12 mths and given up, because the updates are dreadful :( Currently it's not even opening my diary, just crashes/freezes. I was hopeful it was just a gap between OS updates on my phone : version of app , but almost 12mths since the lagging and crashing started occurring and it's no better. Really a shame, it's become unusable for me .

author: KD
text: this app is absolutely terrible now. it's so hard to copy meals and delete meals. before I could delete an entire meal, or copy an entire day-now I have to go in and delete each part of the meal one by one. Do your developers even think about UI or customer experience when making these changes? Apps nowadays just iterate and redevelop with no real basis in mind-jist going through the motions. I use this app every day and it's absolutely terrible now after this latest update!

author: Tom
text: The new UI is absolutely appalling. I've used MFP for 15 years but this and paywalling the barcode scanner is the final straw. I recommend a different app tbh as the developers are probably unlikely to bow down to the widespread criticism this has prompted.

author: Linda M.
text: Horrible "upgrade" They totally changed the UI and it's terrible. "Support" is a bot and unhelpful. There's no option to change the diary display. It's highly unlikely I'll renew my subscription.

author: Daniel Collins
text: i have used this app to lose 30 pounds, it was a really helpful tool but then the most recent update changed the format of the app. I don't like the new update and find it harder to track my progress. is there anyway to revert it back to the version before the last update?

author: Jenn Chen
text: *Edit: and their latest UI overhaul has made this app unusable. I'm done, installed a different app, it's time to move on.* MFP quality has gone down significantly over the years. I've been a user for over 15 years and the steep decline should be studied. A core feature on the mobile app has been down since late January and it has still not been fixed. It's been months.

author: Jill Z
text: Tons of bugs for android since 2025. the food will show an amount of protein, calcium, etc but it does not add my my daily totals properly since 2024 or 2025 and I complained and they told me 1 million steps to try to fix it. I do not have the time or mental bandwidth to try to fix it. their developers should troubleshoot and make an update that fixes these problems. I am switching apps. I used this since 2011

author: Jake Cummings
text: As someone that has used this app for about 8 years, the new UI in update is terrible. The consumer has not been considered at all, and it has actually made the app more difficult to use. Less settings can be altered, and now more clicks are required to get what you want done. It is worth the effort of starting again on a new app.

author: Jamie Smith Johnston
text: I do not like the new layout. it's less convenient for how I use the app. and it won't let me delete a food entry once it's in there now without going to the web version. The whole swipe left thing doesn't work.

author: ANDREA POSNER
text: Why do you insist on major revisions for mature apps? I'm sure it's a job security issue for your programmers, but this revision is horrible. I had a set routine that I followed everyday and it has taken me at least a week to figure out where you've even hidden screens that were available with a single tap in the past.

author: Stephanie Rose
text: This is the exact kind of health app that everybody warns you about. They want to be able to harvest all your personal medical information in order to use the app at all. All I want to do is track my sugars, definitely staying far away from this app. It wants all this invasive personal information so it can use its AI and crap to make custom plans for you and try to sell you stuff, no way!

author: Chloe Nash
text: I've used this app for years as it was the easiest and most user friendly to me. The interface has now been "updated" to a horrifically unusable interface, and if this stays as the new normal, this could be the end of this app for me. please, can we undo whatever just ruined the whole user experience of this app??

author: ayangbe1
text: the new UX update is very annoying to navigate, it's added so many more steps just to do simple things like log an item in your meal. it's difficult to provide direct feedback, there is no feedback form easily available either :( so I'm dropping this here.

author: Sara Nowak
text: Changed my rating after the new update. The UI is now rubbish, so much information missing, extra steps required to see data previously available at a glance. Just give it a slight face lift, but don't change it completely!

author: Aaron Flude
text: been enjoying this app for the last few months but as of today the app is freezing on the opening splash screen. if I uninstall app and reinstall (have also tried clearing cache/force stopping app) it lets me log in but then get pop up straight away saying app has stopped responding, then any further attempts to open app gets stuck on splash screen again. not sure what's happened but app is broken as of today...

author: Adrienne Costantino
text: The UI is terrible. I have loved this app and it is the last decade but after trying the new interface I just wanted to delete it. reached out to customer support and was underwhelmed. Glad to see I am not alone. the response I got made it sound like it was my problem for not knowing how to navigate the app. pretty condescending since I'm a long time user. totally it feels like they designed the new UI without any testing by the target audience.

author: Paul
text: Filled out all my info only to be told that they couldn't authenticate my email as username. Waste of time.

author: Sarah Johnson
text: Before today, 5 stars. As of today the app is awful! The update has made it harder to see your day at a glance and harder to see how many calories you have left if you don't want to use your exercise calories. I'll be looking for a different app

author: Michael Winne
text: Somehow they came out with an update that requires you to hit move buttons to get where you want to go. Harder to log than every before... Great info, but new update UI is awful.... was awesome before, but now a bigger pain to use than it was...

author: Valerie Sichi-Krygsman
text: This app is no longer meant for busy adults looking for serious health tracking. The update, while well-intentioned, has ruined the functionality and speed of data entry. Now useless for data-loving premium users. (And *no*, it's not the super-users' personal challenge because "change is hard" (such insulting customer communication re: user feedback!) . This longtime premium user is now looking for a new app.

author: Pam Baumann
text: Hating the new look/ interface, good example of if it's not broken, don't try to fix it. There is no organization, no flow whatsoever rather, it's a very disjointed presentation & labor intensive. Might be time to leave MFP.

author: Lexi Rich
text: changing my review to 1 star, I've used this app for +1,000 days and this update makes it unusable. give the option to use the previous interface. it takes 2x as long to enter my meals and sometimes more because I bump "log yesterday's meal" and have to then delete everything. honestly might stop using it it's that bad

author: Liam
text: New update is terrible and a serious step back in usability and functionality. Cluttered dashboard with additional steps that have to be taken before being able to see breakdown of meals, or planning out the day. Makes it difficult to track and strange choice of fonts, colours, and font sizes. Lack of emphasis on important items like calories and breakdowns which is clearly what this app is primarily for

author: Abbi
text: I don't mind the new app layout, however, I would prefer if the calories left to eat for the day was either a little bit bigger and/or bolder, so it brings attention to how much I have left to eat, rather than me trying to find this small number at the top of my screen

author: Shana Osaki
text: I've been using this app strictly for 600+ days. I recently updated it and oh my god? please revert back to the old version...it's so bad, much more annoying to add your food entries, it's just bad all around and a hassle to see/do anything now.

author: Corrina Romo
text: I have been on MFP since 2015. I loved everything about it. They made changes that made sense but now they just keep shoving premium in your face and if you don't have it, the app is SIGNIFICANTLY less useful and user friendly. I felt like they used to care about their people but all they care about is money now and they aren't getting any of mine. Good-bye MyFitnessPal. Thank you for all the help you've given me. I did lose 80lbs because of you after all.

author: Albert Marais
text: The app doesn't sync anymore, so all my data is lost when I periodically get asked to sign in and I can't share info with my friends. The solution on the website is to use the website and not the app. An app that I had to pay for in advance...

author: Aston Radford
text: Been using the app a long time. I find it very useful and it has helped me lose weight multiple times.. The new UI though is really bad. Things just don't work how you'd expect any more. I gave it some time to try and get used to it, but it really is just a poor design.

author: Amanda Lanker
text: The upgrade is not user friendly. Too many steps, and why do macros and nutrients default to week view? I have to change it to day view every time. I shouldn't have to go out of my way to make an app I paid for function. It is STUPID that the default is average macros for a week, totally useless.

author: Christopher St. John
text: This application has experienced a significant decline in quality. The updated user interface is exceptionally poor, as several features seem to have been removed. Previously, accessing and viewing entries and macros required a single click, but now it necessitates multiple steps. The display of calories, goals, and macros is particularly problematic and renders the application unusable. I have been a user of this application for over ten years, but I will now be uninstalling it.

author: Aidan R
text: looks like a good app, but you can't import body weight data or anything from other apps using .CSV files or anything. You can export, but not import, which seems absurd. So I'll probably find an alternative that can do that

author: Beau-Ashley Coulson
text: I used to use this app religiously years ago. Recently started using it again to track my calories and one of the free features (bar code scanning) is now a paid feature. what absolute parasites. I'll be deleting the app and using an alternative.

author: Devon Austin
text: Previously I had given this app a 4*, I've now reduced it to 1*. "If it ain't broke, don't fix it" is an old adage that holds true. The new UI is, awful, it takes much more effort to find and edit things which were nothing but a simple scroll away. Why have the developers added unnecessary friction to what was a clean interface? Incredibly frustrating!

author: Rachel N
text: Re new update: a whole tab dedicated to the new premium+ feature is just so inconsiderate to loyal premium users. Time to start looking for a new app after 12 years of being a loyal user. When I click my macros, it auto shows the weekly view when I want daily view. Can't bulk delete items. I keep accidentally pressing "log yesterday's meal" when not intended. The mealplan tab is useless for me, I recently renewed premium, why would I repurchase premium+ ??

author: Cheryl McGhee
text: unfortunately, I've been inconsistent in using this app. I do like it and I believe it can be very beneficial. I understand business and it's all about making a profit. when this app first came out, you could scan your foods which was very useful. I don't care that that is no longer free.

author: Lauren j
text: Been using this app for a long time but will be stopping as you can no longer reset the start day for your week. I know Americans use Sundays as the first day of the week but this is so illogical to me and would be so simple to still allow this basic flexibility. The new main screen is less intuitive and a bit clunky but the lack of customisation for something so basic is enough to make me find an alternative. Plus the attitude in all the responses of "get used to it" is incredibly rude.

author: Najma Mohamed
text: paid for the premium - not worth it! does not track accurate step count or accurate calories 😕 very frustrating to use - if you have the app just use the free version no use paying for the premium when the service is so bad!

author: Lori-Dawn Stevenson
text: The app has so many glitches. I was planning to upgrade to premium and really go all in, but 28$?!? thats insane. yes i know its like 10$/mo avg if you do annual, but im just not there yet. and a 7 day free trial is sad...

author: Minna Girl
text: I’ve been using MyFitnessPal to track my meals and it really helps me stay mindful of what I eat every day. Sometimes logging food can feel a bit time-consuming, but overall it’s a very useful app for managing diet and health goals.

author: Josie D
text: The recipes are good but I cannot create meal plans that stay within the range I want unless I spend a lot of time reviewing each and every meal. I paid for the whole year and won't be using this app due to this.

author: Chad Petrucci
text: Great app for health goals! Even the free version. I started with simple weight tracking (have records for 6 years now!), its very interesting to see my trends. Now I use it for nutrition targets by logging meals (its very easy) and made plans to hit my target weight.

author: Dan Burcea
text: it's ok for ready meals, but if it's homemade meals then you're left with basic kcals only to add macros you have to pay premium.. I find that utterly nonsense because if it's a ready meal the macros are added... doesn't make sense at all 🤣😂

author: leon page
text: Developers hang your heads in shame! As a user of 10 yrs, right now I'm so gutted about the latest interface update - it's absolutely terrible... more clicks to do the same thing, busy confusing screens and clunky navigation - literally as far from intuitive as you could possibly get! Yes, new users won't know the difference but way-to-go on alienating a huge number of loyal legacy users. if I can't figure out how to rollback then I'll have to start again elsewhere ☹️ 1/10 at best - #ROLLBACK

author: Michael Keenan
text: they updated their user interface and it's absolutely horrible. I've used this app for years and this is so irritating, they should let people choose if they want to use the old interface. now I have to look at other apps for calorie tracking, so annoying.

author: Sue Zeee
text: I've been using myfitnesspal for almost 15 years and had recommended it to many people. I can't do that anymore. The new update changed the format, it's clunky, doesn't make sense and isn't intuitive. I'll be looking for a new one. With this big of a change, I may as well just start using a new app

author: Dr. Atalie Ashley West
text: I left a 5 Star review in 2017 and now I wish I could leave 0 stars. The new interface is useless - I've been using MFP to track macros for years and now I can't customize in the same way even with a premium subscription. This is now a waste of time and money

author: Kathleen
text: Used to sync with Garmin but the exercise calories from steps etc don't sync at all now, making any calculations pointless. Update - oh wow, just updated to the new layout. What a catastrophe, this is an utter mess. How can we roll back to previous version?

author: Lyn Madin
text: I have used this app for years & this update is terrible. It doesn't show me what I entered just 1 item & 3 more?. doesn't list cal used at each meal. hard to find scan function. I'm looking for something easier than this has become

author: Bertie Redfern
text: Don't bother unless you need the additional premium features. Was after a simple free food/exercise tracking app but you have to pay Premium to scan barcodes. Massive oversight when FitBit does it for free.

author: Astrid W
text: Reduced the rating due to the recent update. I hate the new app interface! It is really not as user-friendly as the previous one was. The daily calorie goal bar is horrible, and less clear to see the remaining calories for the day at a glance. And the new diary layout is ugly and clunky. It worked well before, why did you need to mess with it?!

author: Jennifer C20H10N2
text: Different screens don't match . main screen has one set of macros, but suddenly when I tap that menu, my macro consumption has doubled or more. challenging to measure progress when the "goal line" moves. did I have 200g carbs or 550? I may never know unless I record it all on paper. or use another app.

author: Jonas (Privat)
text: currently not able to login with newest update. Can't reset password, can't recognize Facebook login or Google login. I also couldn't create a new user.

author: empoppe
text: I've been using MFP for 7-8 years now but will be looking elsewhere after this update. Completely counterintuitive and a pain to log any food or water. Looks like I'm definitely not alone in my feelings!

author: A
text: Well, coming back was a mistake. Nearly all my old data is gone, including recipes and meals. Barcode scanning is locked away now?! And THE ADS, wow. Embarrassing how far these folks have fallen. Enshittification.

author: Nicholas Lim
text: Good, but you need to include more sports options with the relevant calories burned. Sometimes creating sports/exercises may not be that accurate. Eg. No Muay Thai selection available. But love the app!

author: Hammad 786
text: I like the app but the workout features are not that flexible. I request the developers to also add an option to link the Hevy workout app to the app so the calories can be measured more effectively. Please add Hevy app.

author: Alan Hollingsworth
text: Absolutely hate this new version. I don't know where I am and can't see at a glance where my entries have gone. You obviously never heard the expression if it's not broke, don't fix it. I'm only four months into the premium version and I'm considering dumping it.

author: Maggie Burch
text: new update is terrible, you can't see your daily calories for each meal unless you change tabs. The daily macros automatically shows the weekly and you have to close the app for it to sync to foods input. Doesn't show fiber of foods

author: Gemma Hallifax
text: Had a functionality issue, did the chat bot help which suggested uninstall and reinstall. It didn't mention you lose everything. So my issue was a non functioning Weekly Digest and now I have no tracking data at all. Time to switch apps

author: Aurora Sakeagak
text: the newest update RUINED the app. the judgmental comments regarding carb intake are uncalled for. the interface is difficult to use. I have used MFP for nearly ten years. as a loyal user, I am considering switching to a different app. very disappointed.

author: dolten rockey
text: This app was amazing before the new UI changes. Now, it takes extra time to log foods and exercises. I've been using this app for years, and if we don't get a way to get the old UI back, I'll be finding a new app that's actually convenient to use.

author: TJ Hooker
text: Does not separate natural sugar from added sugar. Does not let you see a friend's diary unless they enter it on the website and it gets transferred to the app. Many problems that they have known about since 2016. Do not pay for premium.

author: Team Bagpipe
text: Not enjoying the new version of the app, even though I know updates can be hard at first. Really hard to actually view/notice some aspects as they're no longer as obvious. Calories against goal or exercise is much harder to recognise/see somehow. Prefer the old version of the app by far.

author: Fiona Mclean
text: Stopped using the app as items logged via the app don't sync with the website (ongoing for months and just I just revisited the app and found problem not fixed). I end up having to redo the whole meal on the website.

author: Theodis Wright
text: Since the latest update I can't even get the app to open anymore. It hangs on the logo screen me

author: Angie Martens
text: I can't upload my steps unless I sign up to premium, but that's my only reservation. otherwise, a great app!

author: Tess Cwell
text: I have used MFP for years, and have loved it (honestly was a 5 star experience - especially given i primarily used the free version)! BUT this new update is horrible- the layout/interface feels more clunky and honestly doesn't look ANY better. makes me want to change apps completely, which would be a bummer given all the time I have put into building my history in this one.

author: Jay Birb
text: Long time user who is completely baffled by the new update. I keep ending up on totally the wrong day when trying to log and the app can keep it's commentary on my macros to itself! You have no idea what my medical conditions are!

author: Kirsty Jayne
text: I have used MFP for years and the functionality has dwindled to almost unusable for the free version. I have had premium in the past but 15.99 a month just so I can add my own macros in grams is too much! trying a competitor

author: Ariel Pinkerton
text: for some reason my water intake never saves. it says it saves and then when I go back in later to add more it is no longer saved. super frustrating. the exercise info also fluctuates and doesnt stay current.

author: Luke
text: this review is purely based on the recent updated layout of the app. In all honesty 1 star is generous as that is the minimum we can give, there should be a no star option. The new layout is awful, everything has changed design and moved around. There was nothing wrong with the old layout, why fix something that wasn't broken. Seriously, who in their right mind decided this was a good idea, I would say monkeys did this but thats offensive to all monkeys and apes. Put it back to the way it was.

author: H S
text: I've been using this app off and on for years and the recent UI change is horribly clunky and cumbersome. It's much harder to get a good view of your daily calories now. Not sure why they decided to mangle something that wasn't broken to begin with.

author: Marcella Van Wagner
text: I used this app for years, I even kept using it after they put the barcode scanner behind a paywall but this redesign is really bad. Not nearly as seamless to use, I'll probably switch to pen and paper.

author: Dusti Taylor
text: I like that MyFitnessPal links up with Map My Bike...I also enjoy the daily health articles! *UPDATE MAY 16, 2026* Stopped syncing with My Fitness Walk after all these years. I've repeatedly uninstalled, unlinked...reinstalled, relinked, rebooted my phone...nothing reestablishes syncing...super frustrated. Don't bother installing ...Waste a lot of time on this...

author: Brian Curcio
text: Paying for pro and the app does not work for more than 1 month. What kind of service does not acknowledge and reimburse its users? you should treat this seriously by treating your paying users well. I don't need a link to support email, thet were already unhelpful.

author: Anca.Buliga Buliga
text: Not user friendly if you want to change portion size or add food that is not on the list.

author: Alan Brice (The Angry Dwarf)
text: So frustrating that you let complete idiots enter whatever values they like for foods to lie to themselves, and in doing so break the database for anyone actually wanting accurate data. Your "Report Food" function doesn't allow ridiculous custom portion sizes to be corrected to default 100g values. So many foods in "cups", because we all know how well the US copes with obesity and food measurement. GET SCIENTIFIC, GET ACCURATE! I'm not going to renew premium until you address this.

author: Heidi Forster
text: Hate hate hate the new layout. I've used MyFitnessPal since 2014 and got on really well with it, easy to use and see daily calories at a glance. The new update has wrecked it and I cannot get on with it at all so I've uninstalled it and gone with a competitor app which meets my needs better, similar to the old MyFitnessPal.

author: Yousef Ahmed
text: Reliability has declined and support has been disappointing. After 10+ years of use, the app feels far less stable. Duplicate food entries and random deletions have been an ongoing issue for some time. A recent problem even corrupted my data with no way to recover it. Support replies felt generic, repetitive, and didn’t address the details I provided. As a paid Premium+ user, I was offered no real fix, compensation, or explanation. Overall, it feels like quality has significantly dropped.

author: Lisa Pastore
text: The new UI in the last update is beyond awful. I'm a premium subscriber that has been using the app for years. Please restore the old version. Logging now takes too long and the info is chopped up with too many clicks to find it.

author: Jonathan Moore
text: I've been using MyFitnessPal for over five years. I pay for the premium subscription. The April UI change is simply disrespectful to the user base. It regresses functionality and adds clicks to the remaining features. Myfitnesspal is responding to the mountain of negative reviews asking for feedback as though they don't already know what's wrong with the update. Their responses give the appearance of caring about customer feedback, but don't address their true motives.

author: Kamil Khan
text: The price of $110 a year and $28 if you want to go monthly is insane. That is far too much for this product. They also recently updated the user interface and it is truly terrible. Lost all semblance of intuitive usage. This app is shooting itself in the foot.

author: Oscar Feliciano
text: Pops up a reminder every night saying that I haven't logged anything for the day despite logging all day.

author: Dave Miller
text: This is an absolute great app. However, hydration is treated as a cosmetic feature. You can log it, but you can't analyze it, export it, or use it meaningfully outside outside the app -- even as a paying customer.

author: Stephen
text: Horrible interface changes for slightly faster response in the menus. If you need an app people are using chronometer instead now. The only thing holding me to this app is the years of data since I've started using it in 2013.

author: Sydney Rhody
text: I am so disappointed in the new updates. They sacrificed usability for sleek aesthetics. As a registered dietitian this was my go-to app for clients, but now it's such a mess. It is such a pain to navigate now. Please go back to how it was. There is an obvious difference in the functionality and how user-friendly it is.

author: Shelly
text: Massive changes, cannot find things, alot of the app isn't working, and there is no phone support. Apparently, I have to chat to fix oroblems, but you can't chat AND use the app at the same time.

author: Ali Kord
text: Good app, works well and the UX design is great, but giving four stars because paying 30 bucks a month and still having to pay more to get features like meal planning, makes it possibly the most expensive app I've ever subscribed for.

author: Neil Tattersall
text: Just as they update the app and it starts to accurately adjust my results based on Strava and Fitbit data, today, it just wiped nearly a whole year of my diary entries. Apparently, I'm starting again. Sigh.

author: Kieran O'Neill
text: Not a fan of the changes recently made to the UI. The homescreen used to be customizable and allowed you to put what you want to focus on at the top. Now, they have taken all that away. it's a downgrade imo that just looks more modern

author: M G
text: I always get kicked out and keep telling me I'm logged off, even i have wifi on. since the update, the design changed, which looks a little better, but every day my calorie intake is different. so I have to keep an eye on it every time...pretty annoying

author: Teenie Ostrowski
text: when i 1st started using MyFitnessPal, I could scan the bar code...along the way, they stopped that, now it's an upgrade you have to pay for. that was a great tool & should be brought back!

author: Becky Robinson Bates
text: MFP logged me out over a year ago, spinning upon trying to log back in. Support was no help in troubleshooting. I got a new phone and MFP works for one month and then just stalls at the loading screen. I'm sure this is an issue with the March 17th update. They should roll it back.

author: Natasha Huggins
text: the visuals and the tracking keeps me accountable. I have been able to stay on track.

author: szforro
text: great app, I really appreciate it. It is fairly simple to use. The problem is that many of the options are submitted by others and are not always correct. It is quite confusing when I try to add new data. It has issues with syncing with other apps. But it really is a great app.

author: thegson1
text: been using it for years, its a great calorie tracking app. not a huge fan of the new update/layout but it still works great

author: Candice Anderson
text: I used to love this app and have used it on and off for 8 years. IF YOU ARE NEW DO NOT GET THIS APP! They changed the interface it is awful!! There are so many better tracking apps. Now that they've made these changes I would never recommend. They ruined something good by trying to make it better?

author: shay-lynn gosselin
text: The update that happened April 22 2026 is dreadful. The dashboard was way better before before. The overall daily details were way more intuitive on the prior version and there's no options to revert back to the original view.

author: Still Ugly After 2 A.M.
text: The app does not register the steps from Samaung health automatically. I continually have to log in and out of the app several times for it to recognize my steps. Then it will skip days if I forget to go through all of the steps listed before.

author: Josh Stancombe
text: Can't update goals, can't take photos of barcodes - used to work great!

author: John Gibson
text: Recent updates have broken the app entirely. Most functionality isn't working... all buttons to add food do nothing. Deleting an reinstalling the app did nothing. Deleting cache and data did nothing. I'm reading other reviews reporting the same thing.

author: Val B
text: The new interface is lacking and is not intuitive. Was the UX team on vacation when this got approved? it wasn't even clear where to enter the water intake, hate that I can't see everything entered at once like before. But of course you shoved a bunch of trendy "AI" in instead. Yuck

author: CDT EGALLOY MIKE EGIEL
text: Completely trash. I was trying to sign up for an account, and it kept telling me that it couldn't let me create one. I tried other sign-in methods, but it always crashes afterward. Deleting this app!

author: Jaime C
text: I hate the updates (4/2026). Used to be able to navigate easily between views and see everything you needed. It used be 5 stars for me as I've been using it since 2016 and didn't feel like others complaints impacted me. But now I can't find anything.

author: Joe M.
text: i'm loving this app. free version was fine but I knew I wouldnt keep up with having to do everything manually. got premium and the barcode scan/meal scan are super helpful. they even have home chef meals and restaurant meals set which makes logging them super easy. very happy I went this route

author: Claire Sellers
text: since the most recent update the app is extremely unstable, inconsistent behaviour and unreliable. I have tried logging out and logging back in. I have tried uninstalling and installing. Every day I wake up to a new unreliable app. Extremely disappointed

author: Sabrina Sloan
text: I was using this app continuously and everything was fine. this latest update is terrible. usually I can search something generic like "roast beef" and find something. Now it is telling me that there are No Results or that my spelling could be wrong. So either this only works for paid plans/paid customers or this is a terrible feature update. author: Minda Williams
text: I've been using MFP for a decade and with the exception of a few occasional bugs, it was easy to use and did what I needed, which was log my food and aggregate my nutrition. The new UI is so clunky and unintuitive. It takes a lot more clicks to log food and edit your food diary. At the end of the day when I'm trying to dial in my last snack, I have to click back and forth into and back out of the meal to see my total calories and macros. It's awful. And I'm very annoyed I just paid for a year.

author: Janine Wells
text: I've used this app off and on for about 15 yrs (maybe a bit more). I have loved it! The new update/format is not easy to use; I know you can get used to new things and find them to be great, but this is not it. The app keeps adding in exercises and giving me more calories per day even though I've deleted the exercise repeatedly and also do not have the setting selected to add more calories to my goal even with exercise. frustrating. Makes tracking more difficult every day.

author: Kenzie Mintus
text: I was a big fan until the most recent update. All I want is to track calories. The most effective way to accomplish this goal is to see the breakdown of each item and meal quickly. I want to see the sum for the day, sum for each meal, and total for each item on the same page. This separated MFP from other calorie tracking apps. Now there is so much unnecessary clicking to see things, add things, or delete things.

author: Lisa Hillier
text: The recent interface update pushed me over the edge to cancel. Been using this for easily a decade or two? It was the gold standard and I referred friends and family to it. Seems they got rid of the UX team or something because the new UI is bulky, too many clicks to get things done that were easy to see and do before. I can no longer see everything eaten in a day, have to click in meal by meal. Date and logging info are unclear. The only redeeming benefit is the large database. Not worth it.

author: Kalyna Vang
text: I don't usually leave reviews, but I would like to state this update absolutely bugged my calories (UI prior was fine too). It was perfectly fine this morning and now every day I've logged has 5,000 calories in surplus. I've tried reinstalling but that didn't work-- it's permanently logged multiple entries that weren't there before. I understand I'm one frustrated out of many, many long-term users who may be fine with this, but I'm not. I'm moving onwards; good luck, MFP.

author: Rondi
text: I've had the app for over a year and loved it... Until the recent update. It seems the feature to move one food to a different meal is no longer available, you can only move the WHOLE meal contents. It takes way more clicks to move a single item now. Everything is also scaled to be too big, so I have to scroll so much more to see the amount of information that used to fit on screen.

author: Richard Cardenas
text: The latest version is terrible to use. Requires way too many adjustments to meals that were much simpler, and quicker, before. Which I used for a number of years. Can no longer change time for groups of food at one time, doesn't copy to other days at same time, and too many back buttons to get an overall view of changes. I am not pleased with this update and would prefer the previous view. If this isn't corrected, I may look at a different app. Poorly executed update MtFitnessPal.

author: Deborah Gilliard
text: I've been using this app since 2013 and am pretty tech savvy. However this latest update is not an improvement. It's time consuming. I don't have time to individually log every food item. The ability to go to another day hit the edit & select the ones I want is gone along with the ability to do the same to delete multiple items at once. Not being able to see all my food items at a glance without clicking view all is an inconvenience. The weight added to the page is overriding every other day.

author: skedaddle
text: I've been using MyFitnessPal since 2020, and although the app did have some flaws, the new update makes it impossible to use. I keep accidentally adding meals I had previously into a the new logs, you can no longer move meals in between meal times, and the meal search button is way hidden. When I want to look at a meal I had last week, then move the bar back to this week, it immediately sets it at the day you were looking at last week. How annoying! I accidentally put all my meals on May 23rd.

author: Scott Seder
text: The last free version was far more useful, and I averaged 28+ fays login food. It really helped getting a picture of my calories and macros. The UI was a good and made it a tool I relied upon. This newest version is clearly designed to push you to a paid plan; no pie charts for macros at a glance, poor UI, lack of data on a daily basis (how many grams of protein have I had/ need to meet my daily goal?) weekly data is fine but you get there one day at a time.

author: Carly Vondrell

author: Pamela Goff
text: This app was previously 5 stars from both myself and my spouse. We even upgraded to the premium subscription. When I opened the app today the format was completely changed and NOT for the better! It is almost completely unusable. So much so that if it isn't changed back we will cancel our subscriptions, delete the app, and search for a new one. Way to go, My Fitness Pal.

author: Jessica Ferguson
text: My phone finally forced an update through for the app and I hate it. Why, in 2026, are we going back to a drop down menu to pick days in the food diary when it's had swiping for the past 10 years or so? Having the macro totals at the top instead of rotating the phone is kind of nice, but why have the logged foods all become tiny blurbs unless you click on them? I want to see all the food nicely arranged in my meals. The app is about tracking food, and I would like to SEE that still.

author: Kelly R
text: 4-24-26. The update from a few days ago sucks. Previously we could select foods to copy day to day on a select all or individual basis. if you chose select all you could individually deselect options too. This function made it a breeze to fill in each day. Now you can only copy each meal (lunch, snacks, etc). They also removed the ability to highlight a food item and move it to a different meal (i.e. from lunch to dinner) now you have to do extra steps. The point is ease and they made it harder.

author: Emil Mudura
text: I'm compare it to lose it. way better app. main issue is the search tool and even after you add and used an entry if it passes 2 weeks I think it won't remember it. you have to search for it again and often can't find it. also can't make corrections. author: Katherine Lapid
text: Latest update is awful. Can't see all of my food for the day on one screen. You have to click into each meal to see every item logged. Hate it and will be looking at alternatives to switch.

author: Tinca Bevk
text: This new update is so clunky and difficult to use. Everything now takes at least 3 or 4 extra clicks, there's no way to see my full food diary in a single view anymore. You've made food tracking so frustrating and annoying that it's no longer useful and I'm finally willing to give up my 15+ years of historical data and recipes to switch to a better app.

author: Janis Haydt

NO I don't want add a food, that's what I use this app for!!! Go back to the previous system before this horrible update. Ya didn't have to fix something that wasn't broken.

author: Jesse Avery
text: it is an overall alright app but some things need to change. you can't always quick add meals because you don't always know the calories, you would use the scanner for that. author: Jacob

It used to be obvious how many calories I had left with dashboard, now it is this tiny little number. I've used this app for years, I was always afraid an update like this would happen.

author: Christina Hulett
text: I'm a premium user & really enjoyed this app when I started using it in 2013. Simple, everything on the home screen & easy to view, especially foods eaten & weight (the two most important things). There have been some updates over the years, but the most recent one was disappointing. Can't view all foods eaten w/o multiple clicks, weight is hidden way at bottom, overall much less user friendly. Feels like they're moving away from its original purpose. Not sure I'll keep using this app.

text: The update is awful for people who like to plan out meals and adjust portions/ selections based on calorie totals. Ex: the 'diary view' only shows that breakfast is 465 calories (each item is hidden, only 1 shows) - so you have to swipe over to 'full view' to see each ingredient & its calories ... but there's no total calories in that view. So, if my goal was to have 400 calories for breakfast, I have to adjust items in the full view page THEN go back to the diary to check the total cals.

author: Elena Griego
text: I love the macro counting and the amount of food choices and the nutrition but I ABSOLUTELY HATE the new update. It is not easy to toggle back and forth. Other than that, they have lots of food items in the database making tracking easy.

author: Robyn F (ReezyRobyn)
text: changed the layout and it's frustrating to use. it used to show in really big numbers how many calories I have left in the day, now it shows how many calories I've already eaten with the amount I have left in tiny text. way less useful. it's already a hassle to try to keep track of all my food and now I have to struggle with an overly aesthetic less useful interface.

author: Alex Maklary
text: I'm only leaving the 2 stars because of basic functionality. The new layout with having everything on the home screen gives me a headache and isn't the big reveal you believe it is. Being able to directly access the diary and see the data right in front was much more user friendly without all the other distracting elements such as the graph at the top. I don't even recall there being this "home screen" that you're marketing. Also way too many clicks to be able to access what need.

author: Sam Rivera
text: The app is fantastic. I've been in the fitness industry for almost 20 years,and I recommend it to all my clients. there's things I really love about the update. As in go to dinner and be able to select each individual Item, move it to lyour breakfast/lunch or the next day. Rather than having to move the entire meal and then delete it individually.

author: Andrew Faust
text: The light gray subtext on the dark theme is very difficult to read and doesn't stand out. Please consider changing the colors to something easier to read. author: Brett Davis
text: 5/16/26 see most recent reviews, still bad, can't swipe days, etc. 4/25/26:updated review: horrible update. hard to navigate. Actually harder to log meals, too many clicks, not intuitive. I've literally been logging in this thing for 6 years straight.

author: Jessica Fredette
text: I’ve had ongoing issues where I need to uninstall and reinstall the app about once a week for it to work properly. Syncing stops to other apps, and I lose several days of data that I have to re-enter. The smiley face on the home screen often stops updating, showing it isn’t syncing with other apps. I contacted support a month ago and was told a ticket was submitted, but the issue still isn’t resolved. It is frustrating, but the app is useful when it works.

author: Adam Engstrom
text: I'm all for design refreshes, but the new update really makes understanding the dashboard and logging food a pain. I am a UX researcher by trade, and I really wonder if the UI was user tested because there are some glaring issues. Calorie totals for meals do not get logged correctly, recipes will not save in app or on the web, app keeps losing connection with its database even though no other app has internet issues.

author: Carol Harris
text: 4.23.26 - The new update is awful. You can't easily see your macros at a glance anymore to balance them out, adding meals is tedious, there's no easy way to visually track your status through the day or plan ahead. I'm seriously considering disputing the fee for my membership because I'm not going to use this anymore The website offers minimal features. The premium subscription is not worth the money at all. Everything is so difficult to find and tedious to create.

author: Sierra Blume
text: unfortunately, one of the glitchiest apps ive used. ive used this app for over 10 years and always loved it. in the last year it gets worse and worse. randomly deleting weeks or months worth of logs, duplicating weeks worth of entries so it looks like I went way over my goal, or even randomly adding things to my days that I never even logged, ruining months of data. if you are serious about your calorie deficit and like to look at past trends to interpret data from, this is NOT the app for you.

author: Patti Lockamy
text: 3/14/2026 update: It got better for a while, but it's logged me out twice TODAY! The app keeps logging me out, which is a pain when I just want to add something to the food diary. And the constant requests to upgrade are getting very old. If I want to upgrade, I will, but the ads for it make me determined NOT to upgrade.

author: Jim Fleckenstein
text: This app has gone rapidly downhill lately. it doesn't sync with the web app consistently. It "forgets" foods recently listed while remembering foods that haven't been consumed in years. I've been using it since 2014 and am strongly considering opting out at renewal time. Get your 💩 together, folks!!!

author: Mike D. Underwood
text: I began using MFP last August. I loved how easy it was to use and the interface, tabs, ect. were perfect in my opinion. This new update is far from that. Why "fix" what isn't broken? To add, it DOUBLE logs my workouts that are tracked/linked with my Samsung Health app. So when I track a walk on my Samsung Health app, it logs the workout TWICE. I had to go back each day for the last week to delete these additional logs. It's quite clear that EVERYONE dislikes the new update. Listen and fix it.

author: AJ Perry
text: im done. been using this app daily for nearly 10 years. maybe more. every so often, they decide to completely change the whole app, then I have to re learn it again. the original version was absolutely awesome. it gets worse and worse with every generation. wake up this morning and again, its a totally different app. I am NOT renewing my 50 plus dollar subscription anymore. if your goal was to ruin the app and drive people away, congratulations.

author: Geoffrey Whipple
text: They have in the past year put some key features (Barcode scanning) which I fell in love with behind the paywall but it's still a really good and reliable app. Update: this latest update has removed the edit/check box selection feature making deleting multiple items from my phone impossible. I don't like it. Please restore.

author: John Denson
text: With the new update I will give it a try. Seems like the app is pushing harder for people to switch to the paid version. In fact after every search or food log. Hard to believe that still charging for bar code scan feature when numerous sites are doing it for free. At least now it syncs with the web version. I've been using this for over a decade but am presently migrating over to a new site. it might take a month to get all my foods there but it might be time well spent.

author: Cassie
text: the absolute worst step tracker. doesn't sync properly and even forcing sync doesn't work most times. I hate this app so much. I'm in a step league at work and have missed many days because the stupid app WONT SYNC. I wanna throw my phone every time I try to figure out what's going on. I'm letting my team down and I'm so freaking mad about it.

author: Candace Crow

To try to correct the missing data, I uninstalled and reinstalled. Now it won't even load. Been using this app for over 15 years. It used to be great, but over time, more and more functions have been taken away (like bar code scan) and the overall functionality has greatly diminished - and now it's unusable.

author: Marcin Sieniek
text: I used to like this app to the extent that I have many years of weight and meals logged in it. But the fact that syncing with Fit, Fitbit and Accupedo are all broken prevents me from getting a holistic view of my wellness in any single app, which is super annoying. I'll probably just have to start logging my progress elsewhere, e.g. in Fit. EDIT: Still broken as of 2026

author: Jenn Y

author: A.
text: I've been using this for over 10 years and now I feel like trying something else. 🤷 I'm disappointed in the recent update. The interface feels cluttered and there's unnecessary prompts (like to track water). You can no longer see your diary data at a glance as it's abbreviated, so finding data is more cumbersome than simply swiping. For free users the interface now has ads you have to scroll past ads take up space and disrupt your tracking. It still functions, just not as smartly as before.

author: G
text: I've had this app a very long time. It's extremely frustrating. It glitches out frequently and is slow. It is the ONLY app that does this. Their solution is to empty out the cache. I'd be doing that multiple times a day. They know it's an issue but have done absolutely nothing for their consumers. I'd switch to another one but I have everything saved from years of use. Then we have premium. Why would I pay for this if the above problems have never been fixed. Internet is not slow. Do better!!!

author: Robert Skolinsky

author: Benjamin Douglass
text: **Edit** most of the services it provides either no longer work or have been pay walled behind premium options. It no longer tracks nutrition or calories beyond the day to day, making long term trends completely invisible and useless. Combined with many foods being delisted, I'm exploring other options to track my food intake.

author: James Christopher
text: I love this app. I have been using it for about 2 months now and its great. I found that getting Premium seems to be very helpful in scanning bar ones more easily. my only reason for 3 stars is that the latest update seems clunky. The option to copy my meal from yesterday is too easy. Yesterday I tried logging my dinner 4 times and every time it copied what I had the day prior and then I had to delete each item individually. I think this is partially user error, but think it worked great before.

author: Maranda Rorie
text: IMHO the premium is worth the cost. I love how user friendly this app is and how much information it gives you. The barcode scanner and the ability to import recipes makes it easy to track. This app keeps up with all of the nutrients you eat each day making it easier to hit my goals. Out of all the calorie tracking apps I've tried, this one is the best. A lot of the other apps are moving to AI for tracking but I don't find that accurate and hate using it. So glad MFP doesn't use it.

author: J Taylor
text: Terrible Support! I have the Premium version. Things synced for a week or so and then suddenly stopped. Nothing is syncing to MFP. Reached out to support after trying all the uninstall/reinstall, disconnect/reconnect things only to find out they only have support by email and only email every few days. It's been over a week since it broke and support is still clueless about why their app broke. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

author: Sean
text: The new food log is awful. It feels it's following the horrible UX trend of hiding core features behind extra clicks to look "pretty." It's useless to show a single food "and more" under each meal. The View All link is small and unnoticable. When you do view each meal, the extremely low information density makes it more difficult to get a detailed picture of your entire day. It feels like a Fisher-Price redesign, and I mean no offense to Fisher-Price.

author: Manuel Jimenez
text: This used to be a great app until they put most things behind a paywall. I understand needing to make money to maintain and improve things, but this level of greed is I guess typical of any app companies now a days. Tried to add some food and a simple option of inputting the basic macros was blocked off to do things that it used to be able to do.

author: Robert Freeman
text: Absolutely hate the navigation in the new update (4/2/26). Things that used to take 1-2 clicks now take twice as many. The edit time > use last time function only shows the current time and I have to go into each food to update it properly. What happened to the home button? Why is there a "Plan" button now? I already subscribe, so that button should take me to information about me, but instead it's just an advertisement for the premium+ tier. It's so frustrating that I will not be renewing.

author: justin Sprayberry
text: please make it to where you can set it to pounds at the start instead of automatically setting it to kilograms, also please allow us to TYPE our weight in instead of having to constantly scroll down. Like I said the app sets your weight to kilograms by default so I when I set it to pounds I had to scroll down manually from like 5,000 and if your finger so much as grazes anywhere else on the screen the tab will close and you'll have to start scrolling from the beginning again.

author: Gina F
text: this new update is horrible. I was able to track my fiver for the day and you no longer have the ability to track custom nutrients on the diary page. you added the ability to track GLP1, but removed the ability to track fiber, that is contradictory functions. I am not sure what type of research or user testing you did before making and releasing this update, because it looks like none of that was done based on all the horrible reviews this version is getting. p

author: Natalie Hogan
text: Overall a great app, but it suddenly started crashing and after I reinstalled the app, all of my previous entries were completely gone. I checked my account online and they were also missing despite my account syncing automatically and multiple months of my entries being listed online previously. Support was of no help.

author: Jeremey Unger
text: The new update is terrible. Everything I liked about the app has been removed or made more complicated. You can no longer add foods in the order you intend to eat them, you can no longer see your day at a glance easily and you have to jump through hoops to add foods to each meal.

author: Douglas Bennett
text: The latest update absolutely botched the interface. Search results are much worse, everything is in a different place, Log and + are used interchangeably (but never in the way you expect), and it keeps defaulting to weekly views rather than the day you're actually in. Looking for a replacement app after over a decade here.

author: dandan Hansen
text: not a great tracker the info is jumbled and the data hard to get to. do not use paid. You have to pay to see "Net Carbs" tracked at which point you realize they list total carbs as net carbs everywhere but the overall macros (except when they don't), which means you never actually know which you are going to get. plus they do not do net on the computer at all. i have created 5 foods, all of them added great, but then two days after i added them all the sugar alcohols were gone.

author: Vladimir Valdez
text: This latest update is horrible, it makes things look prettier at the expense of usability. I can't delete multiple items at once. I can't copy an item or multiple items from past days without selecting all. I can't swipe to look at the previous day. The Log previous meal box is too big and easily wrongly pressed causing me to have to delete every item one by one. The AI support is horrible.

author: Brian Trapp
text: The most recent update to the UI is clumsy and hard to use. You have to go through more screens and more steps just to log food, and it's not intuitive at all. Updates should reduce the number of steps to complete basic functions in the app, not add more! Go back to the old UI for logging food.

author: Steven Martel
text: Pretty much useless if you use custom macros. Have used this for years but now I have a nutritional coach providing me with custom calories and macros. Familiar enough with app to know how to use app and adjust calories and macros but calculations are all off both in the Dashboard macros and Diary. I literally have to know exactly what my daily goals are and do my own math. Really wished I hadn't paid for another year! Switching to Cronometer is a no brainer at this point.

author: Mythdefied
text: used this app twice before and would've given it 4 stars (not 5 because you have to hand over money for features and they kept hiding more features behind the paywall each year) this time, but yesterday I opened it and they'd ruined it. they rolled out an "upgrade" that had apparently been getting negative feedback for months, complete with an AI no one wants. changed the look, the function, everything, and called it good. I'll be finding another app

author: Tressa Shea
text: HATE the new update!!! And I pay for premium. Hate the first page. I want to immediately be in the day I'm on and not have so many options. Hard to just get on and quicky add to our meal. I dont want to see the whole week. Too many steps to see macros. And can't move to other meal anymore. HATE it now!

author: Pamela Spears-Bradford
text: I sort of like it! It's easy to add foods but if you make a mistake on the date, time, amounts or adding photos it's hard to edit. Even though I am pretty text savvy for a 71 year old woman. I think $19 a month is a little steep due to the functionality. I'm in the comparison stage with another app.

author: Yana Cherkashova
text: UPDATE: I emailed to the same email they asked me to email here. the customer service rep LITERALLY copied and pasted what FAQs say. THEY ARE NOT HELPING. THEY ARE QUICK TO RESPOND HERE BUT IN REALITY THEY WON'T DO ANYTHING YOU I submitted a ticket and no one responded. my subscription is supposed to be running until November of this year but it's not showing up in the app and it's asking me to purchase again. their AI assistant is of no help, just keeps giving you a run around. so frustrating.

author: Annie N.
text: From 5 stars to 1 star. I definitely DON'T like the new changes!! I love the way it was set up before. Calorie goal - food + exercise = remaining. I don't like that they separated it. The calorie tracking makes no sense. It was such a good app. Please go back to the format it had before...

author: Tim T.
text: took several days to get my steps to sync with the app and after finally getting them to sync they don't fully sync, one day it said I walked 6,987 steps but in reality I walked 19,655 steps which is kind of a huge difference. Would be nice if it would at least backlog so the days it missed and also the days it got wrong would be updated when it finally catches up with itself.

author: preston
text: I've been using this app for years and would typically give it five stars. it is BS that you used to be able to scan the barcode of food and now you can only do that with the upgraded paid subscription. that's fine, what's more irritating is this new update or new appearance that the app has. it's absolutely horrible compared to what it was. whoever made the decision to do that should be fired immediately. put it back how it was

author: M M
text: From 5 stars to 1. New format update is terrible. Definitely more complicated. Bouncing from tab to tab just to add food and it WAS very simple to delete a food or meal. Now it's like a hidden feature, and simply adding calories also hidden in the new format. No one likes a new updated complicated app, the original was more straightforward and very easy to navigate. Please change it back.

author: Jordan Thomas
text: I tried to use this app after some time away. it's a lot worse now. just another money hungry service, locking most features behind a subscription service. Classic long-con bait and switch tactic. everything you try to do comes with a popup saying "give me money, once a month, forever.".

author: Allan Levy
text: Changes recently made complicate what was a simple and straightforward use of the app. Too many steps involved. That is what I said in 2015. Once again Fitness has complicated what was a simple experience of logging in your food and making it more time consuming. Ultimately all will figure it out, but without the simplicity people will be less apt to use it.

author: Lia Heisig
text: This app used to be awesome for tracking macros & water intake. The developers recently (about 1 week ago) made changes to it and has become an impractical, ineffective, useless, convoluted app. You can no longer see all the items/foods logged for the day in the same screen. You have to click so many times to see or to log what you want.. why would you change it to something useless & annoying???

author: Sneh Modi
text: I don't know what the bug is, but every few days, the app stops loading. I have cleared the cache, deleted data, uninstalled and reinstalled, nothing works. keeps asking me to log in, and when I do it just gets stuck on the loading page, every time! Really getting tired of this issue.

author: Andrea Cisneros
text: I use to love this app and always recommended it but I won't anymore. I log food with calories in it and it doesnt discount it from my daily calorie total, and once logged it says its zero calories when it isn't. It's very annoying, makes it inaccurate, and honestly I am now looking for an alternative app.

author: Mathew Myrup
text: With the "add yesterday's meal" (or even "add [7 days ago]'s meal) option, the latest UI makes it so confusing trying to figure out what meals I've logged (or haven't logged) for the current day. Terrible design. Too many needless clicks to access information that used to be upfront.

author: Stephanie Ronghi
text: Terrible upgrade. It was a completely functional, user-friendly app but now it's more difficult to log food, cannot see the entire day's log details. I just canceled my subscription. It says my subscription is good through November. I should be getting a refund since they made the app unusable

author: Ashley Whiteside
text: I hate this app. the new UI sucks. you took away the quick add macro add. getting to the point where there's many other apps that work just as well if not better and cheaper. I'm going to start looking around soon if y'all can't be bothered to improve the app and in ways people are actually asking for. not some new useless interface no one asked for update: barcode scanner constantly not working correctly why am I paying for this?! beyond frustrating. I pay more for this app then any other

author: Allen Kennedy
text: update: 4/22/26. They changed the UI and now the app is totally unusable - back to pen and paper. App won't open unless you're connected to the internet. Shittiest design ever. I understand getting food data, it synching your account to save, but if you're just opening to look, or quick adding calories, the locally cached copy could be more than sufficient. The devs are lazy and poor software architects. If the owner wants to hire me to help fix the architecture, I am available for consulting.

author: Cyndi Marton
text: April 2026: This update completely broke MyFitnessPal. What used to be simple and reliable is now confusing and frustrating. Features like chat and groups don’t work, and even basic tracking takes more effort. I’m a paid subscriber, and the app no longer delivers what I paid for. I am requesting a refund. Do not download until this is fixed.

author: Michael Doran
text: got the new update, seems different and a little difficult, but new things are, so ill give it some time, but I exclusively track food so I dont go over 2k sodium, and before it had a running total and remainder for the day so I knew how much I had left, when im considering adding several ingredients, I dont wanna have to do the math to see how much I have left, the sodium section is already like the red head step child, seems like the nutrients page would show, but it isn't updating real time.

author: Phillip Vano
text: Nice, might not always hit my goals, but the fact that its right there keeps it in my mind Lately have had syncing issues, emailed UA, no response yet. Lowering rating until its fixed edit: i dont care for the update...it is much more difficult to copy meals than it used to be. you camt see what is in the actual meal until its copied. if you just brought that back..display the items in each meal from the diary page that would answer my biggest issue

author: Meagan Berry
text: The new diary UX is terrible. I have to click into every meal to see what was actually logged and the breakdown of the meal. it recommends logging meals from yesterday but I can't click on it and see the full meal to know if I actually want to log it. I have to log it and then delete everything. Not a fan at all. Please bring back the old diary UX.

author: Andrew Verdun (Srelio)
text: Pretty deep into using the app now, and honestly I forgot I posted a neutral review, I'd gotten so used to everything I just kind of figured out how to use the app better and it was fantastic. Then they updated the UI and made it as un-user friendly as possible. It's slow, it shows significantly less information, and it's just unappealing. Everything was pretty much visible at a glance on the old UI, now it's buried in menus. Thanks for changing it so I remembered to drop this a star.

author: Kevin
text: They have ruined a staple app many of us have used for over a decade with unnecessary and downright greedy changes. I have had premium for several years... and woke up to a confusing unintuitive mess, whoever greenlit these massive changes should be fired. Then looked into it and saw they are paywall gating the most basic features (like barcode scanning).... and bombarding people with ads like every other obnoxious app not worth downloading out there. Not a good look MFP...

author: John Zaccarini
text: The May update ruined the food diary. It's a nightmare to navigate now. I'm copying, adding and deleting foods from/to the wrong day so it's mangling my diary history. The only thing the old diary needed was a way to search your diary history for a specific food. Instead, I pay for Premium, and you've made it HARDER to use. WHY?

author: Angela Lawrence
text: Changing my 5 star from 2016 to 1 star. The new update is ridiculous. It's unintuitive, and a severe departure from what mfp has always done best (which is be a simple, easy to use calorie counting app). If I hadn't already paid for my subscription for the year I'd drop it immediately.

author: Griz “Christopher” Grzybinski
text: Absolutely hate the new redesign. iIt used to be very intuitive to use. now it shows a plus button and a log, but you can only use the log if you don't want yesterday's meal. switching between days was just a matter of swiping left or right, but now I have to go to the top of the screen and select the day individually. it feels like a developer just used AI to try to modify it for no good reason.

author: Cindy Mooney
text: I used to love this app until they started charging for it way back when. Today I thought I would try again &. downloaded app. Nope it is worse than before. Can't use basic calories counts. They are only allowing percentages. I tried to enter a meal & it would only give me food lists from the food lists I used way back in 2017ish. I eat a lot differently than I used to. I am so disappointed in what used to be a wonderful program.

author: Noah McLennan
text: Update: canceled my subscription, moved to Macrofactor, and I'm never looking back. Nothing is at a glance anymore, the 'calories left' number is in tiny font, in a faint color, smaller than 'calories eaten', and it 4 taps to see the day's nutrients. I had used MFP for over a decade, and I'm not coming back, especially seeing how MFP is responding to its rightfully upset loyal, paying users. Wouldn't have found a better app if it weren't for this though, so thanks for ruining your app I guess!

author: kharissa smith
text: I used this a few years ago but now it has completely changed. why can't I just track what I eat? why does it hide the list of foods eaten? it makes adding things very onerous, and drags out the process. Show me the list, broken down chronologically by meal/snack. the macros tracking is nice, too. those used to be the main thing so I downloaded it again, only to find they have made the app completely useless.

author: Yvette Wood
text: What a shame everything is behind a plan now. This used to be the best app for weight loss but features have been scaled back and just straight up don't work in the free version. If you use the free version it won't load to your diary anymore. I had so many recipes loaded to this app for my daily routine but if it won't load to my diary it's worthless. I uninstalled.

author: T Boo
text: I love(d) using MyFitnessPal to log daily calories and exercise. The new format is not as good as previous version. There are items I never/rarely use and I have to scroll down through a bunch of sections to get to exercise. And dashboard (Today) is no longer customizable. I prefer the charts/visual layout of the previous version - specifically seeing callorie goal for the day with exercise calories seperate/visible. I will not be renewing my subscription. What a shame.

author: M B
text: Update: Once again the search all function isn't working when trying to log food. Tells me there are no results when I try to search for anything. Highly annoying. All of a sudden I can't do a search all for foods. When I type something in, no foods load. It tells me no results found. I logged out,logged back in. Even uninstalled the app and reinstalled it. Still won't populate any foods when using search. Very disappointed!

author: Jessica Commers
text: I feel its over all easy to use. for being the most recommended food log app im surprised at how inconsistent it is. the food calories are all over the bored. I have to good first. and then find the one closest. the my recipe tab is not what I like. you cant edit recipes once finished. I've messed up on a few and I want to edit them. over all WW was an amazing app and its still tracking calories/macros, just with a points scale. I would pay for my fitness pal if it was a smoother app like WW.

author: alexandra Santiago
text: I had been using this for years. they dropped the ball. you used to be able to use so many things for free, you juat had to deal with ads. now they want to charge you for everything now. you used to be able to scan your food with the barcode now you cant unless you pay. also now when I search for food most od the time it doesnt work says there is nothing under that search so im done. I will be Uninstalling.

author: Jason Tilley
text: I've been using MFP for well over 10 years at this point, but the new UI is genuinely awful. I've accidentally added yesterday's meal multiple times (why is the BIGGEST button the copy button?), and the flow for adding meals is either tap the tiny "Log" button or the big + at the bottom and then the meal can't be automatically selected, so you have to manually set it every time. People have the thought process of "For dinner, I had x, y, z." they do not think "I had xyz. it was dinner."

author: Nic
text: I can't understand why developers feel like they HAVE to change things around when the app already worked fine. Now it takes me twice as long to log my meals because if I log the meal well after I ate it and forget to adjust the time it will log all the items at the time of writing then I need to go in and change every single item manually. Not worth it. Most of all the app is not really helping me to lose weight. Don't think I'll renew the premium membership.

author: Isaiah Nabua
text: It was great, but I hate the new updated interface. It was not necessary, and it made it convoluted. They made it so that the food you've logged is hidden in a tab. So it takes another click to see the food you logged in one meal, instead of seeing the full day lof in one page.Also, half of the meal tab is a button that automatically logs the food you ate yesterday, so unless you meal prep, they made it way too easy to accidentally press that button, requiring you to delete the logged food.

author: L M
text: Saved Foods are still being deleted. Still having to re-create food entries. Even foods I use every day. Have become used to it though. The other thing is, when you add a food, you enter the Vitamin D for each food. But in the Nutrition tab at the bottom of the daily Diary, it doesn't even show Vitamin D in daily totals. It shows all other categories entered when you create a food except Vitamin D. Other than those two issues, this is a good app. Really like that you can use it offline as well.

author: Laura
text: I've been using the app for years, but the new layout is terrible. The old layout allowed for a quick review of foods logged and a summary of calories at the top (with the base target calories and exercise credited calories clearly separated). The new layout requires entering the meal view to see what has been logged and only made things easier if you eat the extact same meal every day. The new design is unnecessarily bulky, you can only see a few logged items on the screen without scrolling.

author: Shem A.
text: I used to LOVE this app. But stopped using it recently because they drastically changed the ui and it's very confusing and unhelpful. I've never paid for an app but honestly if there had been a way to keep the previous, extremely helpful way the app was, especially without the tons of ads, I would've paid. as far as I can tell there isn't, so its back to struggling with my weight until hopefully finding a new app I can use!

author: Neifert Cornejo
text: Why change the interface?! Seriously! The most important caloric data points are how many you've had so far and how many you have remaining. The two data points were equally highlighted before but now the remaining calories are a tiny gray number while the consumption number is huge. Both should be equally visible like before. Having all the food logged in a visible list by meal with caloric and serving data is more helpful and efficient than having to click into each individual meal.

author: Ex Con DX
text: Every single time. When you update your app you don't properly beta test it to see errors and fix them. What now? Well the user loses streaks displayed on their phone UNLESS you log a meal on your phone. Phone in the shop, log meals on your computer, streak gone. Absolutely pathetic. We are actively looking for a different service to log our meals. Steaks are what keep many people engaged in their weight loss journey and somehow you have f'd that up. Great Job!

author: Joan Herting
text: Been a user for at least a decade and this new update makes me feel so betrayed. It's clunky UI, hard to navigate, and glitchy af! I tracked a whole day of food for Thursday and signed in to the app today and for some reason it was all there for today's meal. Had to delete it one by one. If you're going to completely overhaul the UI of your app, it might be a better idea to ease people into it or see if they even *want* a new interface. I sure didn't. Deciding if I even want to stay on this app

author: Stas Wright
text: How about you put all the costs up front before I answer 150 questions. I HATE apps like this! There is no way to move ahead with the App on initial setup unless you agree to the free trial AFTER you added a bunch of personal information. Once I had agreed to the 7 day free trial, and I could put in food I've eaten. The app asks if I would like meal ideas. Fill out 100 more questions, and just when I get to see their meal ideas the price goes up to 99/yr. put that stuff up front. Data miners!!!

author: Ivan Salinas
text: I was a long-time user, but the most recent UI update frustrated me enough to delete. It's difficult to differentiate between a suggestion and a logged meal. I suspect designers were prioritizing meal-preppers, but I didn't appreciate accidentally logging previous meals with one click and having to delete each item individually. As if logging isn't already tedious, every change made it more difficult to use the app except in very specific situations. I wish there were a setting to go back.

author: Brea Little
text: This is better than the previous update, but there's still some unintuitive quirks in my opinion. Example, when you open the page for a meal, breakfast for example, youre given clear options to copy from, copy to, and save a meal, the "try barcode scan", and the search for food button (the most used feature, right?) is the most diminutive and easily overlooked option. Ive personally rarely copied a meal, and never saved one. To have these be more front facing than the log food.. 🤷‍♀️

author: Marie Williams
text: I've been using this app for the last 2 years but since Jan, it has stopped showing my friends data and vice versa - mine doesn't show up for him. my friend lives in my house & eats the same meals I do, so being able to share the meals back and forth is what makes the app useful. we've tried all the troubleshooting things including syncing, restarting device & app, Uninstalling the app etc and it still is not working.

author: Laura Sears
text: Omg, first you got rid of all of the users old info from when I first started using MFP. So I can't look back to what was working for me before. And now the new update has made things more difficult to see all your information. It was better when you could see all your info on one page and your diary on one page. It was easy to see when you ate, what you burned, and the diary had the break down for each meal in one place. why did what wasn't broken??
